p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
p.Parent = dummy
local w = Instance.new("Weld")
w.Part0 = torso
w.Part1 = p
w.C0 = spec.Offset
w.Parent = torso
end
return dummy
end
local function SolveExecutionBonePose(execPhase, elapsed)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, lf * 16, -6, 10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, kf * 22, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightFoot, -lf * 8, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, -lf * 14, 6, -10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, kf * 18, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFoot, lf * 10, 0, 0)
if execPhase == 1 then
local stabAlpha = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.35, 0, 1)
local liftAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 0.35) / 0.75, 0, 1)
local rightArmPitch = 65 + stabAlpha * 30 + liftAlpha * 22
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (18 - liftAlpha * 28), -12, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-8 - liftAlpha * 14), 10, -6)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-10 - liftAlpha * 18), 12, -10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightClavicle, af * 24, -10, 18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * rightArmPitch, -6, 8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (12 + liftAlpha * 14), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightHand, ef * 10, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (22 + liftAlpha * 35), 24, -22)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 48, 12, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * 55, 0, 0)
elseif execPhase == 2 then
local phaseTime = elapsed - 1.10
local isRippingPull = (phaseTime >= 0.55)
local ripOsc = math.sin(elapsed * 45) * 14
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (-10 + (isRippingPull and -14 or 6)), isRippingPull and -22 or 14, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-14), isRippingPull and -16 or 12, isRippingPull and 18 or -12)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-18 + ripOsc * 0.4), isRippingPull and -18 or 14, isRippingPull and 22 or -14)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * 116, -8, 10)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 20, 0, 0)
if not isRippingPull then
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 96, -24, -8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 38, -16, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftHand, ef * 45, -12, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * 78, 0, 0)
else
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (38 + ripOsc), 58, -54)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (74 + ripOsc), 28, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftHand, ef * 65, 20, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * 85, 0, 0)
end
elseif execPhase == 3 then
local hoistAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 2.35) / 0.85, 0, 1)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (-22 - hoistAlpha * 12), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-24 - hoistAlpha * 14), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-32 - hoistAlpha * 16), math.sin(elapsed * 28) * 6, 0)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG, 0, 0)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (118 + hoistAlpha * 26), -18, 14)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (34 + hoistAlpha * 28), -16, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (118 + hoistAlpha * 26), 18, -14)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (34 + hoistAlpha * 28), 16, 0)
elseif execPhase == 4 then
local biteThrash = math.sin(elapsed * 64) * 24
local biteSide = math.cos(elapsed * 48) * 18
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (-16 + biteThrash * 0.35), biteSide * 0.4, biteSide * 0.25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (-18 + biteThrash * 0.5), -biteSide * 0.6, biteThrash * 0.4)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-22 + biteThrash), biteSide, biteThrash * 0.85)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
local jawChomp = (math.sin(elapsed * 58) * 0.5 + 0.5) * CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * jawChomp, 0, 0)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (132 + biteThrash * 0.3), -28, 18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 76, -24, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (132 - biteThrash * 0.3), 28, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 76, 24, 0)
else
local throwAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 4.25) / 0.45, 0, 1)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * (28 * throwAlpha), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (18 * throwAlpha), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (24 * throwAlpha), math.sin(elapsed * 35) * 10, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (130 - throwAlpha * 85), -12 + throwAlpha * 38, 25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (70 - throwAlpha * 50), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (130 - throwAlpha * 85), 12 - throwAlpha * 38, -25)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (70 - throwAlpha * 50), 0, 0)
end
end
-- MODÜL 09 (DEVAM): 5 AŞAMALI VAHŞİ İNFAZ ÇALIŞTIRICI VE KURBAN KİNEMATİĞİ
local PlayProceduralHorrorSound -- İleri bildirim (Modül 11'de tanımlanır)
local TriggerVHSGlitchPulse     -- İleri bildirim (Modül 11'de tanımlanır)
local function PerformLocustExecution()
local now = os.clock()
if EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging then
return
end
if (now - EntityState.LastExecTime) < CONFIG.EXECUTION_COOLDOWN then
return
end
local targetModel = ScanNearestPreyAndTargetHead(CONFIG.EXECUTION_RANGE)
EntityState.IsExecuting = true
EntityState.ExecPhase = 1
EntityState.ExecStartTime = now
EntityState.LastExecTime = now
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.55)
local prevWalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
Humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.EXECUTION_WALK_SPEED
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("EXECUTION_START", RootPart, 1.0)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(0.85, 0.55)
end
local victimClone = nil
local victimTorso = nil
local victimHead = nil
local victimArms = {}
local victimLegs = {}
local allVictimLimbs = {}
local hiddenRealParts = {}
local targetHum = nil
if targetModel then
targetHum = targetModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local targetRoot = targetModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
or targetModel:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
or targetModel:FindFirstChild("Torso")
if targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
local lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, RootPart.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)
if (lookTarget - RootPart.Position).Magnitude > 0.2 then
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(RootPart.Position, lookTarget)
end
end
local origArch = targetModel.Archivable
targetModel.Archivable = true
local okClone, cloned = pcall(function()
return targetModel:Clone()
end)
targetModel.Archivable = origArch
if okClone and cloned then
victimClone = cloned
end
for _, desc in ipairs(targetModel:GetDescendants()) do
if (desc:IsA("BasePart") or desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture")) and desc.Transparency < 1 then
hiddenRealParts[desc] = desc.Transparency
desc.Transparency = 1
end
end
end
if not victimClone then
victimClone = BuildFallbackVictimDummy()
end
if victimClone then
victimClone.Name = CONFIG.VICTIM_CLONE_NAME
for _, desc in ipairs(victimClone:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or desc:IsA("Humanoid") or desc:IsA("Animator") then
desc:Destroy()
elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") then
desc.CanCollide = false
desc.CanQuery = false
desc.CanTouch = false
desc.Massless = true
local nl = string.lower(desc.Name)
if nl == "torso" or nl == "uppertorso" or nl == "humanoidrootpart" then
if not victimTorso or nl == "torso" or nl == "uppertorso" then
victimTorso = desc
end
elseif nl == "head" then
victimHead = desc
elseif string.find(nl, "arm") or string.find(nl, "hand") then
table.insert(victimArms, desc)
table.insert(allVictimLimbs, desc)
elseif string.find(nl, "leg") or string.find(nl, "foot") then
table.insert(victimLegs, desc)
table.insert(allVictimLimbs, desc)
end
end
end
if not victimTorso then
victimTorso = victimClone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
if victimTorso then
victimTorso.Anchored = true
victimTorso.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, -3.6)
end
victimClone.Parent = Workspace
table.insert(EntityState.CreatedInstances, victimClone)
end
local function DetachAndLaunchLimbGroup(limbList, baseCF, upwardBoost, lateralSpeed)
for idx, limbPart in ipairs(limbList) do
if limbPart and limbPart.Parent then
for _, j in ipairs(limbPart:GetJoints()) do
j:Destroy()
end
for _, ch in ipairs(limbPart:GetChildren()) do
if ch:IsA("Motor6D") or ch:IsA("Weld") or ch:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
ch:Destroy()
end
end
limbPart.Anchored = false
limbPart.CanCollide = true
local sideSign = (idx % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
limbPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = baseCF.RightVector * (sideSign * (lateralSpeed or 22))
+ Vector3.new(0, upwardBoost or 16, 0)
+ baseCF.LookVector * 8
limbPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
math.random(-28, 28),
math.random(-28, 28),
math.random(-28, 28)
)
SpawnBloodBurst(limbPart.Position, 10, 1.45, baseCF.RightVector * sideSign)
end
end
end
task.spawn(function()
local startTime = os.clock()
local legsRipped = false
local armsRipped = false
local devoured = false
local carcassThrown = false
while EntityState.IsExecuting and (os.clock() - startTime) < 4.85 do
local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
local entityForwardCF = RootPart.CFrame
if elapsed < 1.10 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 1
local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.42, 0, 1)
local liftY = 0.5 + alpha * 2.8
local distForward = -3.6 - alpha * 0.65
if victimTorso then
local panicKick = math.sin(elapsed * 42) * 0.08
local targetVictimCF = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(0.55, liftY, distForward)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(12 + panicKick * 45), math.rad(180), math.rad(panicKick * 32))
victimTorso.CFrame = victimTorso.CFrame:Lerp(targetVictimCF, 0.42)
if math.random() < 0.45 then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 4, 1.15, -entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
end
elseif elapsed < 2.35 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 2
if victimTorso then
local ripShake = math.sin(elapsed * 58) * 0.11
local targetVictimCF = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(0.38 + ripShake, 3.3, -4.15)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(16), math.rad(180), math.rad(ripShake * 52))
victimTorso.CFrame = victimTorso.CFrame:Lerp(targetVictimCF, 0.45)
end
if elapsed >= 1.55 and not legsRipped then
legsRipped = true
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.48)
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("LIMB_RIP", RootPart, 1.15)
end
if victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0), 20, 1.75, -entityForwardCF.RightVector)
end
DetachAndLaunchLimbGroup(victimLegs, entityForwardCF, 15, 24)
end
if elapsed >= 1.95 and not armsRipped then
armsRipped = true
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.52)
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("LIMB_RIP", RootPart, 0.92)
end
if victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), 22, 1.95, entityForwardCF.RightVector)
end
DetachAndLaunchLimbGroup(victimArms, entityForwardCF, 18, 26)
end
elseif elapsed < 3.30 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 3
local hoistAlpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 2.35) / 0.85, 0, 1)
local smoothHoist = hoistAlpha * hoistAlpha * (3 - 2 * hoistAlpha)
if victimTorso then
local targetMouthCF = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(0, 3.3 + smoothHoist * 2.35, -4.15 + smoothHoist * 2.15)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18 + smoothHoist * 64), math.rad(180), 0)
victimTorso.CFrame = victimTorso.CFrame:Lerp(targetMouthCF, 0.38)
end
elseif elapsed < 4.25 then
EntityState.ExecPhase = 4
if victimTorso then
local crunchJitter = Vector3.new(
math.sin(elapsed * 75) * 0.18,
math.cos(elapsed * 62) * 0.18,
math.sin(elapsed * 54) * 0.14
)
victimTorso.CFrame = entityForwardCF
* CFrame.new(crunchJitter.X, 5.55 + crunchJitter.Y, -1.95 + crunchJitter.Z)
* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(82), math.rad(180), math.rad(math.sin(elapsed * 60) * 35))
end
if not devoured then
devoured = true
EntityState.CameraTrauma = 1.0
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("DEVOUR_CRUNCH", RootPart, 1.0)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(1.0, 0.75)
end
if victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 38, 2.6, entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
if targetHum and targetHum.Parent then
pcall(function()
targetHum:TakeDamage(99999)
targetHum.Health = 0
end)
end
if victimHead and victimHead.Parent then
victimHead.Transparency = 1
end
elseif math.random() < 0.65 and victimTorso then
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 6, 1.6, entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
else
EntityState.ExecPhase = 5
if not carcassThrown then
carcassThrown = true
if victimTorso and victimTorso.Parent then
victimTorso.Anchored = false
victimTorso.CanCollide = true
victimTorso.Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 12, 16)
victimTorso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = entityForwardCF.LookVector * 65 + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0)
victimTorso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(35, -20, 40)
SpawnBloodBurst(victimTorso.Position, 18, 2.0, entityForwardCF.LookVector)
end
end
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
end
if victimClone and victimClone.Parent then
Debris:AddItem(victimClone, 3.0)
end
if targetHum and targetHum.Parent and targetHum.Health > 0 then
for inst, trans in pairs(hiddenRealParts) do
if inst and inst.Parent then
inst.Transparency = trans
end
end
end
EntityState.ExecPhase = 0
EntityState.IsExecuting = false
Humanoid.WalkSpeed = EntityState.IsSprinting and CONFIG.SPRINT_SPEED
or (EntityState.IsCrawling and CONFIG.CRAWL_SPEED or prevWalkSpeed)
end)
end
-- MODÜL 10: ÖZEL KORKU YETENEKLERİ ([Q] ANALOG ÇIĞLIK, [R] YIRTICI ATILMA, [F] GÖLGE & ESP)
-- [Q] ANALOG KORKU ÇIĞLIĞI VE DUYUSAL BOZULMA (PSYCHOLOGICAL SHRIEK)
local function PerformAnalogHorrorShriek()
local now = os.clock()
if EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging then
return
end
if (now - EntityState.LastShriekTime) < CONFIG.SHRIEK_COOLDOWN then
return
end
EntityState.IsShrieking = true
EntityState.ShriekStartTime = now
EntityState.LastShriekTime = now
EntityState.CameraTrauma = 1.0
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("ANALOG_SHRIEK", RootPart, 1.0)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(1.0, 1.35)
end
local shockRing = Instance.new("Part")
shockRing.Name = "LocustShriekWave"
shockRing.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
shockRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
shockRing.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 12, 22)
shockRing.Transparency = 0.25
shockRing.Size = Vector3.new(0.25, 2.0, 2.0)
shockRing.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
shockRing.Anchored = true
shockRing.CanCollide = false
shockRing.CanQuery = false
shockRing.CanTouch = false
shockRing.Parent = GoreFolder
TweenService:Create(shockRing, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 56, 56),
Transparency = 1,
}):Play()
Debris:AddItem(shockRing, 0.9)
task.delay(1.35, function()
EntityState.IsShrieking = false
end)
end
local function SolveShriekBonePose(elapsed)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local tremor = math.sin(elapsed * 78) * 14
local archProgress = math.clamp(elapsed / 0.30, 0, 1)
local spineArch = (elapsed < 0.28) and (-18 * archProgress) or (28 + tremor * 0.35)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * spineArch, tremor * 0.25, tremor * 0.2)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Neck, hf * (24 + tremor * 0.5), tremor * 0.4, tremor * 0.4)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (32 + tremor), tremor * 0.65, tremor * 0.75)
if #RigBones.Jaw > 0 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Jaw, -hf * CONFIG.JAW_UNHINGE_MAX_DEG, 0, 0)
end
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * (75 + tremor * 0.6), 42, 48 + tremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * (35 + tremor * 0.5), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightFingers, ef * (80 + tremor), 0, tremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * (75 - tremor * 0.6), -42, -48 - tremor)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * (35 - tremor * 0.5), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftFingers, ef * (80 + tremor), 0, -tremor)
end
-- [R] YIRTICI ATILMA VE ÇİFT PENÇE DEŞME (PREDATORY LUNGE & SCISSOR SLASH)
local function PerformPredatoryLunge()
local now = os.clock()
if EntityState.IsExecuting or EntityState.IsShrieking or EntityState.IsLunging then
return
end
if (now - EntityState.LastLungeTime) < CONFIG.LUNGE_COOLDOWN then
return
end
EntityState.IsLunging = true
EntityState.LungeStartTime = now
EntityState.LastLungeTime = now
EntityState.CameraTrauma = math.min(1.0, EntityState.CameraTrauma + 0.65)
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("PREDATORY_LUNGE", RootPart, 1.05)
end
local lungeDir = RootPart.CFrame.LookVector
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = lungeDir * CONFIG.LUNGE_IMPULSE_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0)
task.delay(0.28, function()
local hitTarget = ScanNearestPreyAndTargetHead(12)
local slashPos = (RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, -4.2)).Position
SpawnBloodBurst(slashPos, 18, 1.75, lungeDir)
if hitTarget then
local hum = hitTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
pcall(function()
hum:TakeDamage(45)
end)
end
end
end)
task.delay(0.68, function()
EntityState.IsLunging = false
end)
end
local function SolveLungeBonePose(elapsed)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local isSlash = (elapsed >= 0.24)
if not isSlash then
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * 32, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-18), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * 124, 34, 28)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 28, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 124, -34, -28)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 28, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, -lf * 36, 0, 8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, kf * 48, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, lf * 28, 0, -8)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, kf * 36, 0, 0)
else
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Spine, sf * 42, 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.Head, hf * (-10), 0, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, af * 78, -46, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightLowerArm, ef * 64, -28, 0)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 78, 46, 18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 64, 28, 0)
end
end
-- [F] GÖLGE TİTREMESİ (SHADOW FLICKER) VE AV KALP ATIŞI GÖRÜŞÜ (PREY HEARTBEAT ESP)
local function UpdatePreyHighlights(now)
if not CONFIG.ENABLE_PREY_ESP or not EntityState.IsShadowStalking then
for model, hl in pairs(EntityState.PreyHighlights) do
if hl and hl.Parent then
hl.Enabled = false
end
end
return
end
local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * 9.5)
for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("Humanoid") and obj.Health > 0 then
local m = obj.Parent
if m and m:IsA("Model") and m ~= Character and m ~= locustModel and m.Name ~= CONFIG.VICTIM_CLONE_NAME then
local hl = EntityState.PreyHighlights[m]
if not hl or not hl.Parent then
hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
hl.Name = "LocustPreySenseHighlight"
hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
hl.Parent = m
EntityState.PreyHighlights[m] = hl
table.insert(EntityState.CreatedInstances, hl)
end
hl.Enabled = true
hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 12, 22)
hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 75)
hl.FillTransparency = 0.55 + pulse * 0.28
hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.1 + pulse * 0.35
end
end
end
end
local function ToggleShadowStalkMode()
EntityState.IsShadowStalking = not EntityState.IsShadowStalking
if PlayProceduralHorrorSound then
PlayProceduralHorrorSound("SHADOW_TOGGLE", RootPart, 0.9)
end
if TriggerVHSGlitchPulse then
TriggerVHSGlitchPulse(0.55, 0.35)
end
if not EntityState.IsShadowStalking then
for i = 1, #allMeshParts do
if allMeshParts[i] and allMeshParts[i].Parent then
allMeshParts[i].Transparency = 0
end
end
UpdatePreyHighlights(os.clock())
end

+ breathe * 0.05

- (EntityState.AmbushBlend * 2.1)

-- MODÜL 13: BİREYSEL 10 PARMAK BOĞUMU (PHALANGE) VE PENÇE KİNEMATİK ÇÖZÜCÜSÜ
local PhalangeRegistry = {
Right = {
Thumb = {},
Index = {},
Middle = {},
Ring = {},
Pinky = {},
Generic = {},
},
Left = {
Thumb = {},
Index = {},
Middle = {},
Ring = {},
Pinky = {},
Generic = {},
},
}
local function IndexIndividualPhalanges()
local function classifyFingerSide(boneList, targetTable)
for idx, bone in ipairs(boneList) do
local n = string.lower(bone.Name)
local depth = GetLimbDepthByKeyword(bone, "finger", "hand", "thumb")
local entry = {
Bone = bone,
Depth = math.clamp(depth, 1, 3),
PhaseOffset = idx * 0.68,
}
if string.find(n, "thumb") or string.find(n, "pollex") then
table.insert(targetTable.Thumb, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "index") or string.find(n, "point") or string.find(n, "f1") then
table.insert(targetTable.Index, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "mid") or string.find(n, "f2") then
table.insert(targetTable.Middle, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "ring") or string.find(n, "f3") then
table.insert(targetTable.Ring, entry)
elseif string.find(n, "pink") or string.find(n, "little") or string.find(n, "f4") then
table.insert(targetTable.Pinky, entry)
else
table.insert(targetTable.Generic, entry)
end
end
end
classifyFingerSide(RigBones.RightFingers, PhalangeRegistry.Right)
classifyFingerSide(RigBones.LeftFingers, PhalangeRegistry.Left)
end
IndexIndividualPhalanges()
local function SolveDetailedPhalangeArticulation(now, walkBlend, runBlend, isExecuting, execPhase, isShrieking)
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local preyFactor = math.clamp(1.0 - (EntityState.NearestPreyDist / 26), 0, 1)
local function applyFingerChain(chainList, sideSign, fingerIndex, baseCurlDeg, spreadDeg)
for _, item in ipairs(chainList) do
local b = item.Bone
local d = item.Depth
local wave = math.sin(now * (5.5 + runBlend * 8.0) + fingerIndex * 0.95 + item.PhaseOffset)
local microTwitch = HorrorMath.SpasmPulse(now + fingerIndex * 0.31, fingerIndex * 3.7, 0.38) * 24
local curl = baseCurlDeg * (0.65 + d * 0.22) + wave * (9 + preyFactor * 14) + microTwitch
local splay = spreadDeg * sideSign * (1.0 - (d - 1) * 0.35)
if isExecuting then
if execPhase == 1 then
curl = 12 + d * 8
elseif execPhase == 2 then
curl = 78 + math.sin(now * 48 + fingerIndex) * 18
elseif execPhase == 3 or execPhase == 4 then
curl = 68 + d * 12
else
curl = 15
end
elseif isShrieking then
curl = -12 + math.sin(now * 65 + fingerIndex) * 28
splay = splay * 2.4
end
local rest = BoneRestRot[b] or CFrame.new()
local rot = CFrame.fromOrientation(
math.rad(ef * curl),
math.rad(splay * 0.5),
math.rad(splay)
)
BoneTargetTransforms[b] = rest:Inverse() * rot * rest
end
end
local baseCurl = CONFIG.CLAW_CURL_BASE_DEG + walkBlend * 14 + runBlend * 26 + preyFactor * 22
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Thumb, 1, 1, baseCurl * 0.75, 18)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Index, 1, 2, baseCurl * 1.05, 10)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Middle, 1, 3, baseCurl * 1.15, 2)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Ring, 1, 4, baseCurl * 1.10, -7)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Pinky, 1, 5, baseCurl * 0.95, -15)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Right.Generic, 1, 6, baseCurl, 4)
applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Thumb, -1, 1, baseCurl * 0.75, 18)

applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Ring, -1, 4, baseCurl * 1.10, -7)

applyFingerChain(PhalangeRegistry.Left.Generic, -1, 6, baseCurl, 4)

-- MODÜL 14: OMURGA OMUR DALGALANMASI (VERTEBRAE WAVE) VE OMUZ ÇIKIĞI (DISLOCATION) MOTORU
local ShoulderDislocationState = {
RightPopDeg = 0,
LeftPopDeg = 0,
RightTargetDeg = 0,
LeftTargetDeg = 0,
NextDislocationClock = 0,
}
local function UpdateVertebraeWaveAndShoulderDislocation(now, dt, walkBlend, runBlend, isExecuting)
if isExecuting then
ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg = 0
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg = 0
elseif now >= ShoulderDislocationState.NextDislocationClock then
ShoulderDislocationState.NextDislocationClock = now + math.random(40, 130) / 100
if math.random() < 0.48 then
local which = math.random(1, 3)
local intensity = CONFIG.HORROR_TWITCH_INTENSITY
if which == 1 or which == 3 then
ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg = math.random(-24, 32) * intensity
end
if which == 2 or which == 3 then
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg = math.random(-24, 32) * intensity
end
else
ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg = 0
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg = 0
end
end
local popAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-18 * dt)
ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg = ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg
+ (ShoulderDislocationState.RightTargetDeg - ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg) * popAlpha
ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg = ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg
+ (ShoulderDislocationState.LeftTargetDeg - ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg) * popAlpha
if math.abs(ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg) > 0.5 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightClavicle, 0, 0, ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg)
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.RightUpperArm, ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg * 0.4, 0, ShoulderDislocationState.RightPopDeg * 0.6)
end
if math.abs(ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg) > 0.5 then
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftClavicle, 0, 0, -ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg)
AddGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg * 0.4, 0, -ShoulderDislocationState.LeftPopDeg * 0.6)
end
local spineCount = #RigBones.Spine
if spineCount > 1 and not isExecuting then
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
for idx, sBone in ipairs(RigBones.Spine) do
local chainRatio = (idx - 1) / math.max(1, spineCount - 1)
local undulationWave = math.sin(now * (3.2 + runBlend * 5.0) - chainRatio * 2.4)
local breathExpansion = math.sin(EntityState.IdleClock * 2.0 - chainRatio * 1.2) * (2.2 + runBlend * 3.5)
local deltaRot = CFrame.fromOrientation(
math.rad(sf * breathExpansion),
math.rad(undulationWave * (3.5 + walkBlend * 4.5)),
math.rad(undulationWave * 2.2)
)
local rest = BoneRestRot[sBone] or CFrame.new()
local localDelta = rest:Inverse() * deltaRot * rest
BoneTargetTransforms[sBone] = (BoneTargetTransforms[sBone] or CFrame.new()) * localDelta
end
end
end

-- MODÜL 16: DUVARA ÖRÜMCEK TIRMANMA [V] VE KURBAN YAKALAYIP SÜRÜKLEME [B] MEKANİĞİ

WallNormal = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
DraggedVictimModel = nil,
DraggedVictimRoot = nil,
}
local WallRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
WallRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local function UpdateSpiderWallClimbAndVictimDrag(dt)
WallRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character, locustModel, GoreFolder }
-- [V] Duvara Tırmanma Aktifse Kafanın Baktığı Yöndeki (RootPart.LookVector) Duvarı Algıla
if WallClimbState.Enabled and not EntityState.IsExecuting then
local origin = RootPart.Position
local forwardRay = RootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 4.5
local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, forwardRay, WallRayParams)
if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide and math.abs(hit.Normal.Y) < 0.45 then
WallClimbState.IsClimbingWall = true
WallClimbState.WallNormal = hit.Normal
local moveInput = Humanoid.MoveDirection
local climbUpSign = (moveInput.Magnitude > 0.1) and 1 or 0
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X * 0.5,
climbUpSign * (CONFIG.WALK_SPEED * 1.25),
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z * 0.5
) - hit.Normal * 6
else
WallClimbState.IsClimbingWall = false
end
else
WallClimbState.IsClimbingWall = false
end
-- [B] Yakalanmış Kurbanı Kafa Yönünde Sürükleme
if WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot and WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.Parent and not EntityState.IsExecuting then
local holdCF = RootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.9, 1.4, -3.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(65), 0, 0)
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.CFrame = WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.CFrame:Lerp(holdCF, 1 - math.exp(-18 * dt))
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
else
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimRoot = nil
WallClimbState.DraggedVictimModel = nil
end
end

or targetModel:FindFirstChild("Torso")

local lShoulder = GetAverageBoneWorldPos(RigBones.LeftUpperArm)

local function ApplyPoseTableInterpolated(poseA, poseB, alpha)
local af = CalibratedAxes.ArmForwardSign
local ef = CalibratedAxes.ElbowInwardSign
local sf = CalibratedAxes.SpineForwardSign
local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign
local kf = CalibratedAxes.KneeBackwardSign
local hf = CalibratedAxes.HeadPitchForwardSign
local function lerpVal(a, b)
return a + (b - a) * alpha
end
local function blendGroup(group, key, pitchSign)
local pA = poseA[key]
local pB = poseB[key]
if not pA or not pB then return end
local p = lerpVal(pA.Pitch, pB.Pitch) * pitchSign
local y = lerpVal(pA.Yaw, pB.Yaw)
local r = lerpVal(pA.Roll, pB.Roll)
SetGroupTargetRotation(group, p, y, r)
end
blendGroup(RigBones.Spine, "Spine", sf)
blendGroup(RigBones.Neck, "Neck", hf)
blendGroup(RigBones.Head, "Head", hf)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightUpperArm, "RightUpperArm", af)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightLowerArm, "RightLowerArm", ef)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, "LeftUpperArm", af)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, "LeftLowerArm", ef)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightUpperLeg, "RightUpperLeg", lf)
blendGroup(RigBones.RightLowerLeg, "RightLowerLeg", kf)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftUpperLeg, "LeftUpperLeg", lf)
blendGroup(RigBones.LeftLowerLeg, "LeftLowerLeg", kf)
end

end

if HorrorPoseLibrary.IsTaunting then

KEYFRAME_POSES.ANALOG_CONTORTION_POSE,
KEYFRAME_POSES.PREDATORY_JUMPSCARE_POSE,

)

local lf = CalibratedAxes.LegForwardSign

SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 155, 14, -18)
SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftLowerArm, ef * 28, 0, 0)
elseif HorrorPoseLibrary.SpineFinisherPhase == 2 then

SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 68, 22, -14)

else

SetGroupTargetRotation(RigBones.LeftUpperArm, af * 115, -42, -28)

print("💀 [The Locust V4 - Modül 19 & 20 Aktif] [T] Jumpscare Taunt ve [G] Spine-Snap Finisher hazır!")
local function CleanupAndRestoreNormalCharacter()
EntityState.Alive = false
for _, c in ipairs(EntityState.Connections) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
EntityState.Connections = {}
for _, inst in ipairs(EntityState.CreatedInstances) do
pcall(function()
if inst and inst.Parent then inst:Destroy() end
end)
end
EntityState.CreatedInstances = {}
if locustModel and locustModel.Parent then
pcall(function() locustModel:Destroy() end)
end
if GoreFolder and GoreFolder.Parent then
pcall(function() GoreFolder:Destroy() end)
end
if screenGui and screenGui.Parent then
pcall(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
end
for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
if string.find(effect.Name, "LocustHorror_") then
pcall(function() effect:Destroy() end)
end
end
local curChar = TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.Character
if curChar then
for _, desc in ipairs(curChar:GetDescendants()) do
if SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] ~= nil then
pcall(function() desc.Transparency = SavedOriginalTransparencies[desc] end)
elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
pcall(function() desc.Transparency = 0 end)
elseif desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture") then
pcall(function() desc.Transparency = 0 end)
end
if SavedOriginalCanCollide[desc] ~= nil and desc:IsA("BasePart") then
pcall(function() desc.CanCollide = SavedOriginalCanCollide[desc] end)
end
if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
pcall(function() desc.CastShadow = true end)
end
end
local curHum = curChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if curHum then
curHum.WalkSpeed = (SavedWalkSpeed and SavedWalkSpeed > 4) and SavedWalkSpeed or 16
curHum.JumpPower = (SavedJumpPower and SavedJumpPower > 10) and SavedJumpPower or 50
curHum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
end
end
if IsSelfTarget then
pcall(function()
RealLocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = SavedMaxZoom or 128
RealLocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = SavedMinZoom or 0.5
if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = SavedFOV or 70
end
end)
end
end
return {
Player = TargetPlayer,
Model = locustModel,
State = EntityState,
Cleanup = CleanupAndRestoreNormalCharacter
}
end
function Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer(targetPlayer, enableState, fromP2P)
local plr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
if not plr then return end
local pName = plr.Name
local existingSession = State.LocustPlayers[pName]
if not enableState then
if existingSession and type(existingSession.Cleanup) == "function" then
pcall(existingSession.Cleanup)
end
State.LocustPlayers[pName] = nil
TableDB.LocustUsers = TableDB.LocustUsers or {}
TableDB.LocustUsers[pName] = nil
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(pName, "LOCUST V4", false)
if not fromP2P then
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("LOCUST_OFF", pName, "0")
end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"LOCUST NORMALIZE EDİLDİ",
string.format("%s normale döndü! (The Locust V4.2 kaldırıldı)", pName),
Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
3.5
)
end
return
end
if existingSession and type(existingSession.Cleanup) == "function" then
pcall(existingSession.Cleanup)
State.LocustPlayers[pName] = nil
end
task.spawn(function()
local ok, session = pcall(function()
return Engine.SpawnLocustV4InstanceForPlayer(plr)
end)
if ok and session then
State.LocustPlayers[pName] = session
TableDB.LocustUsers = TableDB.LocustUsers or {}
TableDB.LocustUsers[pName] = true
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(pName, "LOCUST V4", true)
if not fromP2P then
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("LOCUST_ON", pName, "1")
end
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"THE LOCUST V4.2 AKTİF",
string.format("%s -> The Locust V4.2 Analog Horror dönüştürüldü! (Normale döndürmek için tekrar ;locust \"%s\" yazın)", pName, pName),
Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
4.0
)
end
else
warn("[BERK'S ADMIN · LOCUST V4] Yukleme hatasi:", session)
end
end)
end
function Engine.ToggleLocustV4OnPlayer(targetPlayer)
local plr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
if not plr then return end
local isCurrentlyLocust = (State.LocustPlayers[plr.Name] ~= nil)
if isCurrentlyLocust then
Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer(plr, false, State.IsExecutingFromP2P)
else
Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer(plr, true, State.IsExecutingFromP2P)
end
end
end

function UI.OpenBanKickModal(mode, targetPlr)
State.BanKickMenuMode = (mode == "KICK") and "KICK" or "BAN"
if typeof(targetPlr) == "Instance" and targetPlr:IsA("Player") then
selectedTargetName = targetPlr.Name
elseif type(targetPlr) == "string" and #targetPlr > 0 then
selectedTargetName = targetPlr
end
State.BanKickMenuOpen = true
BanKickFrame.Visible = true
PlayUiSound("drawerOpen")
RefreshBanKickModalView()
end

	function UI.RefreshLanguageUI()
		if UI.TopLeftBadge then
			local tlTitle = UI.TopLeftBadge:FindFirstChild("Title")
			if tlTitle then
				tlTitle.Text = Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer)
					and UI.Tr("★ B1rkt Panel & Ranklar", "★ B1rkt Panel & Ranks")
					or "Berk's Admin v6.5"
			end
		end
		if UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent and State.ServerInfoOpen then
			pcall(UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent)
		end
		if UI.RefreshBanKickModalView and State.BanKickMenuOpen then
			pcall(UI.RefreshBanKickModalView)
		end
	end

			local nextLang = (State.Language == "TR") and "EN" or "TR"
			Engine.SetScriptLanguage(nextLang)
			notify("Berk's Admin Language", nextLang == "EN" and "Switched to English (EN)" or "Türkçe (TR) diline geçildi")
		end)

		local ranksBtn = makeSettingsButton(
			Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) and UI.Tr("★ B1rkt Panel & Ranklar", "★ B1rkt Panel & Ranks") or UI.Tr("Sunucu Rankları", "Server Ranks"),
			getcustomasset("infiniteyield/assets/settings.png")
		)
		ranksBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 265)
		ranksBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25)
		ranksBtn.Name = "BerksRanksPanel"
		ranksBtn.Parent = SettingsHolder
		ranksBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Engine.ToggleServerRanksAndScriptInfoModal()
		end)
	end

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- [SECTION 9] LIGHTWEIGHT LIVE LOOP (P2P SCANNER + ADMINMODE + CONTROL + JAIL + LASEREYES)
	-- ZERO CONFLICT WITH INFINITE YIELD FLY / NOCLIP / FREECAM / ORBIT / ESP!
	-- ==========================================================================
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

		-- 60 FPS P2P Animator Track Scanner
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
				local pHum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local pAnim = pHum and pHum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
				if pAnim and Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed then
					for _, trk in ipairs(pAnim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
						if trk.Speed >= 8.0 and trk.Speed <= 8500.0 then
							Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, trk.Speed, trk)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- AdminMode Immunity Shield
		State.AdminModePlayers = State.AdminModePlayers or {}
		State.AdminModeSafeCF = State.AdminModeSafeCF or {}
		for amPlrName, isProtected in pairs(State.AdminModePlayers) do
			if isProtected then
				local amPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(amPlrName)
				local amChar = amPlr and amPlr.Character
				local amHrp = amChar and amChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local amHum = amChar and amChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if amHum then
					amHum.MaxHealth = math.huge
					amHum.Health = math.huge
					amHum.PlatformStand = false
				end
				if amHrp then
					if amHrp.Position.Y > (Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 65) and amHum and amHum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
						State.AdminModeSafeCF[amPlrName] = amHrp.CFrame
					elseif amHrp.Position.Y < (Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 45) then
						amHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						amHrp.CFrame = State.AdminModeSafeCF[amPlrName] or CFrame.new(0, 35, 0)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Real-Time P2P Character Possession (;control / ;uncontrol)
		if State.ControllingTarget then
			if State.ControllingTarget.Parent ~= Players or not State.ControllingTarget.Character then
				State.ControllingTarget = nil
				State.ControlSavedCFrame = nil
			else
				local targetHum = State.ControllingTarget.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if targetHum and cam and cam.CameraSubject ~= targetHum then cam.CameraSubject = targetHum end
				if myHrp and State.ControlSavedCFrame then
					myHrp.Anchored = false
					myHrp.CFrame = State.ControlSavedCFrame
					myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.01, 0)
				end
				if targetHum and myHum then pcall(function() targetHum:Move(myHum.MoveDirection, false) end) end
			end
		end
		if State.PossessedByController then
			if State.PossessedByController.Parent ~= Players or not State.PossessedByController.Character then
				State.PossessedByController = nil
			elseif myHum and myHrp then
				local ctrlHum = State.PossessedByController.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if ctrlHum then
					myHrp.Anchored = false
					myHum.PlatformStand = false
					myHum:Move(ctrlHum.MoveDirection, false)
					if ctrlHum.Jump or ctrlHum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then myHum.Jump = true end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Hollow Neon Jail Keep-Inside Loop
		for jailedName, centerPos in pairs(State.JailedPlayers) do
			local jPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(jailedName)
			local jHrp = jPlr and jPlr.Character and jPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if jHrp and centerPos then
				local offset = jHrp.Position - centerPos
				if math.abs(offset.X) > 3.9 or math.abs(offset.Z) > 3.9 or offset.Y < -3.5 or offset.Y > 5.2 then
					jHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					jHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
				end
			end
		end

		-- Laser Eyes Raycast Visual Loop
		for plrName, active in pairs(State.LaserEyesPlayers) do
			if active then
				local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
				local char = p and p.Character
				local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if head then
					local rigName = "BerksLaserRig_" .. plrName
					local rig = Workspace:FindFirstChild(rigName)
					if not rig then
						rig = Instance.new("Model")
						rig.Name = rigName
						rig.Parent = Workspace
					end
					local leftOrigin = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.26, 0.16, -0.55)).Position
					local rightOrigin = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.26, 0.16, -0.55)).Position
					local aimTargetPos = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -140)).Position
					if p == LocalPlayer then
						if IYMouse and IYMouse.Hit then aimTargetPos = IYMouse.Hit.Position
						elseif cam then aimTargetPos = cam.CFrame.Position + (cam.CFrame.LookVector * 160) end
					end
					for idx, origin in ipairs({ leftOrigin, rightOrigin }) do
						local beamName = "Beam_" .. tostring(idx)
						local beam = rig:FindFirstChild(beamName)
						if not beam then
							beam = Instance.new("Part")
							beam.Name = beamName
							beam.Anchored = true
							beam.CanCollide = false
							beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
							beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
							beam.Parent = rig
						end
						local dist = math.min((aimTargetPos - origin).Magnitude, 180)
						beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, math.max(0.2, dist))
						beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, aimTargetPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist * 0.5)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Disco / Rainbow / Topk3k Auxiliary Visual States
		if State.DiscoMode then
			local hue = (tick() * 0.45) % 1
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.3) % 1, 0.85, 1)
		end
		for plrName, active in pairs(State.RainbowPlayers) do
			if active then
				local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
				if p and p.Character then
					local col = Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.6) % 1, 0.85, 1)
					for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
						if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then part.Color = col end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if State.LevitateMode and myHrp then
			myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 2.2 + math.sin(tick() * 3.5) * 2.5, myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
		end
	end)

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- [SECTION 10] REGISTER ALL BERK'S ADMIN EXCLUSIVE COMMANDS INTO INFINITE YIELD!
	-- (Populates CommandList + CommandRegistry for P2P + IY addcmd() & addcmdtext()!)
	-- ==========================================================================
	local function RegisterBerksCommand(def)
		def.CmdIndex = #CommandList + 1
		table.insert(CommandList, def)
		local lowerName = string.lower(def.Name)
		CommandRegistry[lowerName] = def
		local aliases = def.Aliases or {}
		for _, al in ipairs(aliases) do
			CommandRegistry[string.lower(al)] = def
		end

		-- Register directly into Infinite Yield's native command engine & searchable CMDsF list!
		addcmd(lowerName, aliases, function(args, speaker)
			local rawSel = (args and args[1]) or "me"
			local argSpec = string.lower(tostring(def.Args or ""))
			local singleCall = (def.SingleCall == true) or (argSpec == "" or (not string.find(argSpec, "oyuncu") and not string.find(argSpec, "player")))
			if singleCall then
				local targetPlr = LocalPlayer
				if args and args[1] and args[1] ~= "" then
					local resolved = ResolveTargetPlayers(args[1])
					if #resolved > 0 then targetPlr = resolved[1] end
				end
				local char = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
				local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not State.IsExecutingFromP2P and def.UsesAnimateSync then
					Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand(def, args or {}, { targetPlr }, rawSel)
				end
				def.Action(targetPlr, args or {}, hrp, hum, Workspace.CurrentCamera)
			else
				local targets = ResolveTargetPlayers(rawSel)
				if #targets == 0 then targets = { LocalPlayer } end
				if not State.IsExecutingFromP2P and def.UsesAnimateSync then
					Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand(def, args or {}, targets, rawSel)
				end
				for _, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
					local char = tPlr and tPlr.Character
					local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					def.Action(tPlr, args or {}, hrp, hum, Workspace.CurrentCamera)
				end
			end
		end)

		local displayText = lowerName
		if def.ArgsEn and def.ArgsEn ~= "" then
			displayText = displayText .. " " .. def.ArgsEn
		elseif def.Args and def.Args ~= "" then
			displayText = displayText .. " " .. def.Args
		end
		addcmdtext("[BA] " .. displayText, lowerName, "[Berk's Admin] " .. tostring(def.DescriptionEn or def.Description or lowerName))
	end

do
local reverseOpcodes = {
["01"] = "HANDSHAKE", ["02"] = "KICK", ["03"] = "BAN", ["04"] = "FREEZE", ["05"] = "THAW",
["06"] = "JAIL", ["07"] = "UNJAIL", ["08"] = "KILL", ["09"] = "BRING", ["10"] = "FLING",

["23"] = "ORBITFLING", ["24"] = "GIANT", ["25"] = "TINY", ["26"] = "NORMALSCALE",

["31"] = "SEIZURE", ["32"] = "UNSEIZURE", ["33"] = "GLITCH", ["34"] = "UNGLITCH",
["35"] = "SINK", ["36"] = "UNSINK", ["37"] = "ELEVATE", ["38"] = "EARTHQUAKE",
["39"] = "TORNADO", ["40"] = "METEOR", ["41"] = "SHOCKWAVE", ["42"] = "PREFIX_SYNC",
["43"] = "FULL_SYNC", ["44"] = "ADMINMODE_ON", ["45"] = "ADMINMODE_OFF", ["46"] = "LOCUST_ON", ["47"] = "LOCUST_OFF", ["48"] = "POLARIA_SYNC", ["49"] = "POLARIA_OPEN", ["50"] = "TOPK3K_OPEN", ["51"] = "REAL_FLOOD", ["52"] = "VOID_CLEAR_TERRAIN", ["53"] = "PATRICK_HORROR", ["54"] = "PRIMADON_ON", ["55"] = "PRIMADON_OFF", ["56"] = "PRIMADON_STOMP", ["57"] = "F3X_SYNC", ["58"] = "POLARIA_ACTION", ["59"] = "TOPK3K_ACTION", ["60"] = "HEADSCALE", ["61"] = "ANIM_SYNC", ["62"] = "INSTANT_RESPAWN"
}
local function RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, lastSignalName)
if not sender then return 1 end
if sender.Name ~= ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME and (not TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] or TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] <= 1) then
if not (TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername and TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[sender.Name]) then
TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] = 9
end
end
local senderRank = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(sender)
local isFirstDiscovery = (State.ActivePeers[sender.Name] == nil)
State.ActivePeers[sender.Name] = {
RankLevel = senderRank,
PersonalPrefix = ResolvePersonalPrefix(sender.Name),
LastSignal = lastSignalName or "HANDSHAKE",
Effects = TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[sender.Name] or {}
}
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(sender)
if isFirstDiscovery and sender ~= LocalPlayer then
print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P] Yeni Script Kullanicisi (Peer) Baglandi: %s (Tier %d)", sender.Name, senderRank))
if not State.HandshakedPeers[sender.Name] then
State.HandshakedPeers[sender.Name] = true
task.delay(0.15, function()
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("HANDSHAKE", "ALL", tostring(State.LocalRankLevel))
end)
end
end
return senderRank
end
local function HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(sender, opcode, targetSlotOrUid, speedParam)
if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
local actionName = reverseOpcodes[opcode] or "HANDSHAKE"
local senderRank = RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, actionName)
if actionName == "HANDSHAKE" or actionName == "FULL_SYNC" then
if sender.Name ~= ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME and speedParam and speedParam >= 1 and speedParam <= 10 then
TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] = math.clamp(math.floor(speedParam), 1, 10)
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(sender)
end
if State.AdminModePlayers and State.AdminModePlayers[LocalPlayer.Name] then
task.delay(0.2, function()
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("ADMINMODE_ON", LocalPlayer.Name, "1")
end)
end
if State.LocustPlayers then
for locPlrName, _ in pairs(State.LocustPlayers) do
task.delay(0.3, function()
BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("LOCUST_ON", locPlrName, "1")
end)
end
end
return
end
-- Sunucu capli (World/Action) P2P opcodelari tum istemcilerde dogrudan 1 kez calistirilir:
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
State.CurrentP2PSender = sender
if actionName == "REAL_FLOOD" then
if Engine.ExecuteRealWaterFlood then
Engine.ExecuteRealWaterFlood(true, tonumber(speedParam) or 1)
end
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
return
elseif actionName == "VOID_CLEAR_TERRAIN" then
if Engine.ExecuteTrueVoidClearTerrain then
Engine.ExecuteTrueVoidClearTerrain(true)
end
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
return
elseif actionName == "F3X_SYNC" then
if Engine.HandleIncomingF3XSync then
Engine.HandleIncomingF3XSync(sender, tonumber(speedParam) or 1)
end
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
return
elseif actionName == "POLARIA_ACTION" then
if Engine.Polaria_RunActionById then
Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(tonumber(speedParam) or 1, sender, true)
end
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
return
elseif actionName == "TOPK3K_ACTION" then
if Engine.Topk3k_RunActionById then
Engine.Topk3k_RunActionById(tonumber(speedParam) or 1, sender, true)
end
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
return
end
local affectedPlayers = {}
local slotNum = tonumber(targetSlotOrUid)
if slotNum and slotNum >= 0 and slotNum <= 99 then
affectedPlayers = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, slotNum)
elseif type(targetSlotOrUid) == "string" and Players:FindFirstChild(targetSlotOrUid) then
table.insert(affectedPlayers, Players:FindFirstChild(targetSlotOrUid))
elseif slotNum then
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if p.UserId == slotNum then
table.insert(affectedPlayers, p)
end
end
end
if #affectedPlayers == 0 then
affectedPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
end
print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P] %s -> Opcode: %s (%d hedef oyuncu)", sender.Name, actionName, #affectedPlayers))
local isLocalAffected = false
for _, tPlr in ipairs(affectedPlayers) do
-- PRIMADON_ON / PRIMADON_OFF / PRIMADON_STOMP / GIANT / TINY / NORMALSCALE / HEADSCALE / ANIM_SYNC / INSTANT_RESPAWN gorsel replikasyonlari engellenmez!
local isVisualMorphOrScale = (actionName == "PRIMADON_ON" or actionName == "PRIMADON_OFF" or actionName == "PRIMADON_STOMP" or actionName == "GIANT" or actionName == "TINY" or actionName == "NORMALSCALE" or actionName == "HEADSCALE" or actionName == "LOCUST_ON" or actionName == "LOCUST_OFF" or actionName == "ADMINMODE_ON" or actionName == "ADMINMODE_OFF" or actionName == "POLARIA_OPEN" or actionName == "TOPK3K_OPEN" or actionName == "ANIM_SYNC" or actionName == "INSTANT_RESPAWN")
if (not isVisualMorphOrScale) and (not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, tPlr)) then
if tPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"ADMIN KORUMA KALKANI",
string.format("%s üzerinizde %s denedi (Koruma Kalkanı · Engellendi!)", sender.Name, actionName),
Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
2.5
)
end
else
if tPlr == LocalPlayer then
isLocalAffected = true
end
if actionName == "SETRANK" then
local newLvl = math.clamp(math.floor(speedParam or 1), 0, 10)
if tPlr.Name ~= ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME then
TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}
TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[tPlr.Name] = newLvl
TableDB.RanksByUsername[tPlr.Name] = newLvl
end
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(tPlr)
elseif actionName == "FLING" or actionName == "SKYFLING" or actionName == "VOIDFLING" or actionName == "ORBITFLING" then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "FLUNG", true)
if tPlr.Character and tPlr ~= LocalPlayer then
Engine.ApplyPhysicalFlingToCharacter(tPlr.Character)
end
elseif actionName == "FREEZE" then
Engine.SetPlayerFrozenState(tPlr, true)
elseif actionName == "THAW" then
Engine.SetPlayerFrozenState(tPlr, false)
elseif actionName == "JAIL" then
Engine.CreateNeonJailAroundPlayer(tPlr, true)
elseif actionName == "UNJAIL" then
Engine.CreateNeonJailAroundPlayer(tPlr, false)
elseif actionName == "RAGDOLL" then
Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(tPlr, true, true)
elseif actionName == "UNRAGDOLL" then
Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(tPlr, false, true)
elseif actionName == "INSTANT_RESPAWN" then
if Engine.PerformInstantVisualRespawn then
Engine.PerformInstantVisualRespawn(tPlr, nil, true)
end
elseif actionName == "ANIM_SYNC" then
if Engine.HandleIncomingMorphAnimationSync then
Engine.HandleIncomingMorphAnimationSync(tPlr, tonumber(speedParam) or 1)
end
elseif actionName == "GIANT" and tPlr.Character then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GIANT", true)
local exactScale = (tonumber(speedParam) and tonumber(speedParam) > 1) and (tonumber(speedParam) / 20.0) or 3.0
Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, exactScale)
elseif actionName == "TINY" and tPlr.Character then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "TINY", true)
local exactScale = (tonumber(speedParam) and tonumber(speedParam) >= 1 and tonumber(speedParam) <= 999) and (tonumber(speedParam) / 20.0) or 0.4
Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, exactScale)
elseif actionName == "NORMALSCALE" and tPlr.Character then
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GIANT", false)
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "TINY", false)
Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, 1.0)
elseif actionName == "HEADSCALE" and tPlr.Character then
local hs = (tonumber(speedParam) and tonumber(speedParam) >= 1) and (tonumber(speedParam) / 20.0) or 2.5
if Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor then
Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, hs, true, tPlr)
end
elseif actionName == "RAINBOW" then
State.RainbowPlayers[tPlr.Name] = true
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "RAINBOW", true)
elseif actionName == "UNRAINBOW" then
State.RainbowPlayers[tPlr.Name] = nil
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "RAINBOW", false)
elseif actionName == "DISCO" then
State.DiscoMode = true
elseif actionName == "UNDISCO" then
State.DiscoMode = false
elseif actionName == "SEIZURE" then
State.SeizurePlayers[tPlr.Name] = true
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "SEIZURE", true)
elseif actionName == "UNSEIZURE" then
State.SeizurePlayers[tPlr.Name] = nil
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "SEIZURE", false)
elseif actionName == "GLITCH" then
State.GlitchPlayers[tPlr.Name] = true
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GLITCH", true)
elseif actionName == "UNGLITCH" then
State.GlitchPlayers[tPlr.Name] = nil
RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GLITCH", false)
elseif actionName == "SINK" then
Engine.SetP2PSinkPlayer(tPlr, true)
elseif actionName == "UNSINK" then
Engine.SetP2PSinkPlayer(tPlr, false)
elseif actionName == "ELEVATE" then
Engine.ElevateTargetViaP2P(tPlr, tonumber(speedParam) or 35)
elseif actionName == "TORNADO" then
Engine.StartP2PTornadoVortex(tPlr)
elseif actionName == "METEOR" then
Engine.SpawnP2PMeteorStrike(tPlr)
elseif actionName == "SHOCKWAVE" then
Engine.EmitP2PShockwavePulse(tonumber(speedParam) or 65)
elseif actionName == "ADMINMODE_ON" then
if Engine.SetAdminModeOnPlayer then Engine.SetAdminModeOnPlayer(tPlr, true, true) end
elseif actionName == "ADMINMODE_OFF" then
if Engine.SetAdminModeOnPlayer then Engine.SetAdminModeOnPlayer(tPlr, false, true) end
elseif actionName == "LOCUST_ON" then
if Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer then Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer(tPlr, true, true) end
elseif actionName == "LOCUST_OFF" then
if Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer then Engine.SetLocustV4OnPlayer(tPlr, false, true) end
elseif actionName == "POLARIA_OPEN" then
if tPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SetPolariaWindowOpen then
UI.SetPolariaWindowOpen(true)
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("POLARIA HUB (P2P)", sender.Name .. " ekranınızda Polaria Hub menüsünü açtı!", Color3.fromRGB(129, 26, 255), 3.5)
end
end
elseif actionName == "TOPK3K_OPEN" then
if tPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SetTopk3kWindowOpen then
UI.SetTopk3kWindowOpen(true)
if UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification("Topk3k (P2P)", sender.Name .. " ekranınızda Topk3k menüsünü açtı!", Color3.fromRGB(58, 106, 204), 3.5)
end
end
elseif actionName == "PATRICK_HORROR" then

function Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(sender, cmdIndex, targetSlot, numericArg, customArgsTable)
if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
local resolvedCmd = CommandList[cmdIndex]
if not resolvedCmd then return end
RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, resolvedCmd.Name)
local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
if #targets == 0 then
targets = { sender }
end
print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P KOMUT] %s -> ;%s (Hedef: %d oyuncu)", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name, #targets))
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
State.CurrentP2PSender = sender
local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local isPermissionSyncCmd = (resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktallow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktdeny" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktallowall" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktdenyall")
for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
local allowedOnB1rkt = Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, targetPlr)
if isPermissionSyncCmd and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(sender) then
allowedOnB1rkt = true
end
if not allowedOnB1rkt then
if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"ADMIN KORUMA KALKANI",
string.format("%s üzerinizde ;%s denedi fakat koruma kalkanınız engelledi!", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name),
Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
3
)
end
else
local tChar = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local secondArgVal = numericArg and tostring(numericArg) or nil
if numericArg and numericArg >= 9901 and numericArg <= 9995 then
local secPlrs = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, numericArg - 9900)
if secPlrs and secPlrs[1] then
secondArgVal = secPlrs[1].Name
end
end
local synthArgs = customArgsTable or {
[1] = (numericArg and numericArg <= 9900 and tostring(numericArg)) or (targetPlr and targetPlr.Name or "me"),
[2] = secondArgVal
}
pcall(function()
resolvedCmd.Action(targetPlr, synthArgs, tHrp, tHum, cam)
end)
if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
UI.SendNotification(
"P2P · " .. string.upper(resolvedCmd.Name),
string.format("%s sizin uzerinizde ;%s calistirdi!", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name),
GetTierData(ResolvePlayerRankLevel(sender)).Color,
2.5
)
end
end
end
State.PendingPeerNumericArg[sender.Name] = nil
State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
end
function Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, speedVal, trackObj)
if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return end
if type(speedVal) ~= "number" or speedVal < 8.0 or speedVal > 8500.0 then return end
local packetInt = math.floor(((speedVal - 8.0) * 1024.0) + 0.5)
if packetInt < 100 or packetInt > 7999999 then return end
State.SeenAnimationTracks = State.SeenAnimationTracks or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
if trackObj then
if State.SeenAnimationTracks[trackObj] == packetInt then
return
end
State.SeenAnimationTracks[trackObj] = packetInt
end
local dedupKey = plr.Name .. "_" .. tostring(packetInt)
local now = tick()
local dedupWindow = (packetInt >= 220000 and packetInt <= 410000) and 0.04 or 0.52
if State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] and (now - State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey]) < dedupWindow then
return
end
State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] = now
-- 1) TEK KANAL ATOMIK BIT-PACKED PAKETLER (1,000,000 .. 7,999,999):
if packetInt >= 1000000 and packetInt <= 7999999 then
local rem = packetInt - 1000000
local opcodeNum = math.floor(rem / 100000)
local rem2 = rem % 100000
local targetSlot = math.floor(rem2 / 1000)
local paramVal = rem2 % 1000
local opcodeStr = string.format("%02d", opcodeNum)
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcodeStr, targetSlot, paramVal)
return
end
-- 2) GERCEK ZAMANLI F3X CANLI GIZMO (MOVE/RESIZE/ROTATE/PAINT/SURF/ANCHOR/FX/CLONE/DEL) PAKETLERI (200,000 .. 499,999):
if packetInt >= 200000 and packetInt <= 499999 then
if Engine.HandleIncomingF3XRealtimePacket then
Engine.HandleIncomingF3XRealtimePacket(plr, packetInt)
end
return
end
-- 3) SAYISAL ON-PAKET (80,000 .. 89,999):
if packetInt >= 80000 and packetInt <= 89999 then
State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name] = packetInt - 80000
return
end
-- 4) EVRENSEL KOMUT & KLASIK OPCODE PAKETLERI (100 .. 79,999):
local cmdCode = math.floor(packetInt / 100)
local targetSlot = packetInt % 100
if cmdCode >= 701 and cmdCode <= 765 then
local opcodeStr = string.format("%02d", cmdCode - 700)
local paramVal = State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name]
State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name] = nil
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcodeStr, targetSlot, paramVal)
elseif cmdCode >= 1 and cmdCode <= #CommandList then
local paramVal = State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name]
Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(plr, cmdCode, targetSlot, paramVal, nil)
end
end
local function HookPlayerAnimateBridge(plr)
local function onCharAdded(char)
task.defer(function()
UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(plr)
end)
local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not hum then return end
local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
if not animator then return end
animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
if not track then return end
local anim = track.Animation
local animId = tostring(anim and anim.AnimationId or "")
local prefixStr = "rbxassetid://9900"
if string.sub(animId, 1, #prefixStr) == prefixStr then
local payload = string.sub(animId, #prefixStr + 1)
local opcode = string.sub(payload, 1, 2)
local targetUidStr = string.sub(payload, 3)
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcode, targetUidStr, track.Speed)
return
end
if track.Speed >= 8.0 then
Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, track.Speed, track)
else
local conn
conn = track:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Speed"):Connect(function()
if track.Speed >= 8.0 then
if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, track.Speed, track)
end
end)
task.delay(0.35, function()
if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
end)
end
end)
end
if plr.Character then
task.spawn(onCharAdded, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharAdded)
if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
local peerPfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(plr.Name)
local defPfx = TableDB.DefaultPrefix or ";"
local clean = nil
if string.sub(msg, 1, #peerPfx) == peerPfx then
clean = string.sub(msg, #peerPfx + 1)
elseif string.sub(msg, 1, #defPfx) == defPfx then
clean = string.sub(msg, #defPfx + 1)
elseif string.sub(msg, 1, 1) == ";" or string.sub(msg, 1, 1) == "!" then
clean = string.sub(msg, 2)
else
local lmsg = string.lower(string.gsub(msg or "", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
if string.sub(lmsg, 1, 6) == "locust" or string.sub(lmsg, 1, 9) == "adminmode" then
clean = msg
end
end
if not clean then return end
clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
if clean == "" then return end
local parts = Engine.ParseCommandTokensWithQuotes(clean)
local cmdName = string.lower(parts[1] or "")
table.remove(parts, 1)
local resolvedCmd = CommandRegistry[cmdName]
if not resolvedCmd then
for _, c in ipairs(CommandList) do
for _, alias in ipairs(c.Aliases) do
if string.lower(alias) == cmdName then
resolvedCmd = c
break
end
end
if resolvedCmd then break end
end
end
if resolvedCmd and resolvedCmd.CmdIndex then
local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(parts[1] or "me")
if resolvedCmd.Name == "uncontrol" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unfollow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unorbit" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unloopgoto" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unbackpack" then
slot = 0
elseif parts[1] == nil or string.lower(parts[1]) == "me" or string.lower(parts[1]) == "ben" then
slot = 98
end
Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(plr, resolvedCmd.CmdIndex, slot, tonumber(parts[2] or parts[1]), parts)
end
end)
end
end
_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners = _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners or {}
_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners[LocalPlayer.Name] = function(senderPlr, packetType, a, b, c)
if not senderPlr or senderPlr == LocalPlayer then return end
if packetType == "OPCODE" then
HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(senderPlr, a, b, c)
elseif packetType == "CMD" then
local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(b or "me")
if b == nil or string.lower(tostring(b)) == "me" then slot = 98 end
if string.lower(tostring(b)) == "all" then slot = 0 end
Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(senderPlr, a, slot, tonumber(c and (c[2] or c[1])), c)
end
end
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
HookPlayerAnimateBridge(plr)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(HookPlayerAnimateBridge)
end
