  -- Her parca icin hareket etse veya boyutu degisse bile ASLA degismeyen deterministik PartId (1..999) uretir:
  function Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return 0 end
    local existingId = part:GetAttribute("F3X_PartId")
    if existingId and existingId >= 1 and existingId <= 999 then
      F3XState.PartRegistryById[existingId] = part
      return existingId
    end

    -- 1) Spawn edilen F3X / Topk3k bloklari: Topk3k_P2PBlock_<N> -> 701..999
    local blkIdx = string.match(part.Name, "^Topk3k_P2PBlock_(%d+)$")
    if blkIdx then
      local pid = 701 + ((tonumber(blkIdx) - 1) % 298)
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
      F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid] = part
      return pid
    end

    -- 2) Oyuncu karakter uzuvlari (Head, Torso, Arm, Leg vb.) -> 501..699
    local charModel = part.Parent
    local charPlr = charModel and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(charModel)
    if not charPlr and charModel and charModel.Parent then
      charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(charModel.Parent)
      if charPlr then charModel = charModel.Parent end
    end
    if charPlr then
      local slot = math.clamp(Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(charPlr.Name), 1, 15)
      local limbCode = F3XLimbCodes[part.Name] or ((string.byte(part.Name, 1) or 1) % 12 + 1)
      local pid = 500 + ((slot - 1) * 13) + limbCode
      pid = math.clamp(pid, 501, 699)
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
      F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid] = part
      return pid
    end

    -- 3) Harita parcalari: Ilk dokunulmamis koordinati ve boyutundan 1..500 arasi sabit ID:
    if not part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosX") then
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_InitPosX", math.floor(part.Position.X + 0.5))
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_InitPosY", math.floor(part.Position.Y + 0.5))
      part:SetAttribute("F3X_InitPosZ", math.floor(part.Position.Z + 0.5))
    end
    local ix = part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosX") or 0
    local iy = part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosY") or 0
    local iz = part:GetAttribute("F3X_InitPosZ") or 0
    local b1 = string.byte(part.Name, 1) or 65
    local b2 = string.byte(part.Name, #part.Name) or 90
    local hash = (math.abs(ix + 4096) * 97 + math.abs(iy + 1024) * 53 + math.abs(iz + 4096) * 29 + b1 * 13 + b2 * 7) % 499 + 1
    part:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", hash)
    F3XState.PartRegistryById[hash] = part
    return hash
  end

  function Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(partId, senderPlr)
    local pid = tonumber(partId) or 0
    if pid <= 0 then
      if senderPlr and F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name] then
        local cached = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name]
        if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local direct = F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid]
    if direct and direct.Parent then
      return direct
    end
    -- Eger 701..999 arasi bir F3X blogu ise:
    if pid >= 701 and pid <= 999 then
      local blkNum = pid - 700
      local foundBlk = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_P2PBlock_" .. tostring(blkNum))
      if foundBlk and foundBlk:IsA("BasePart") then
        foundBlk:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", pid)
        F3XState.PartRegistryById[pid] = foundBlk
        return foundBlk
      end
    end
    -- Tum Workspace'te tara ve ID eslesmesini bul:
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
      if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
        if Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(obj) == pid then
          return obj
        end
      end
    end
    if senderPlr and F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name] then
      local fallback = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[senderPlr.Name]
      if fallback and fallback.Parent then return fallback end
    end
    return nil
  end

  local function F3X_SendPacket(packetInt, channelIdx)
    if Engine.BroadcastRawP2PPacketInt then
      Engine.BroadcastRawP2PPacketInt(packetInt, channelIdx or 1)
    elseif Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack then
      Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, channelIdx or 1)
    end
  end

  -- Secili parca karakter veya model ise onlari da 1:1 olcekleyen yardimci:
  local function F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(part, newSizeVec, axisDir, snapOffset, fromP2P, senderPlr)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return end
    local sx = math.clamp(newSizeVec.X, 0.2, 240)
    local sy = math.clamp(newSizeVec.Y, 0.2, 240)
    local sz = math.clamp(newSizeVec.Z, 0.2, 240)
    part.Size = Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz)
    if axisDir and snapOffset then
      part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(axisDir * (snapOffset * 0.5))
    end
    -- Eger buyutulen parca bir oyuncunun Kafasi (Head) ise SpecialMesh / HeadScale de guncellensin:
    local charPlr = part.Parent and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part.Parent)
    if charPlr and part.Name == "Head" then
      local headFactor = math.clamp(sy / 1.0, 0.25, 12.0)
      local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
      if mesh then
        if not mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleX") then
          mesh:SetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleX", mesh.Scale.X)
          mesh:SetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleY", mesh.Scale.Y)
          mesh:SetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleZ", mesh.Scale.Z)
        end
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(
          (mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleX") or 1.25) * (sx / 2.0),
          (mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleY") or 1.25) * headFactor,
          (mesh:GetAttribute("OrigHeadMeshScaleZ") or 1.25) * (sz / 1.0)
        )
      end
      if not fromP2P and Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor then
        Engine.ApplyHeadScaleFactor(charPlr.Character, headFactor, false, charPlr)
      end
    end
  end

  -- Gercek Zamanli F3X P2P Paket Alicisi (200,000 .. 449,999):
  function Engine.HandleIncomingF3XRealtimePacket(sender, packetInt)
    if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
    local pkt = tonumber(packetInt) or 0
    if pkt < 200000 or pkt > 499999 then return end

    -- 1) [200,000 .. 209,999] +Part Spawn (Renk + PartId):
    if pkt >= 200000 and pkt <= 209999 then
      local rem = pkt - 200000
      local colIdx = math.clamp(math.floor(rem / 1000), 1, #F3XPalette)
      local assignedId = rem % 1000
      local spawned = Engine.Topk3k_SpawnP2PBlock(sender, colIdx, assignedId)
      if spawned then
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = spawned
      end
      return
    end

    -- 2) [210,000 .. 210,999] Parca Secimi (Peer Selection Sync):
    if pkt >= 210000 and pkt <= 210999 then
      local pid = pkt - 210000
      local targetPart = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if targetPart then
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = targetPart
        pcall(function()
          if F3XState.PeerSelectionBoxes[sender.Name] then
            F3XState.PeerSelectionBoxes[sender.Name]:Destroy()
          end
          local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
          sb.Name = "F3X_PeerBox_" .. sender.Name
          sb.Adornee = targetPart
          sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
          sb.LineThickness = 0.04
          sb.Parent = Workspace
          F3XState.PeerSelectionBoxes[sender.Name] = sb
        end)
      end
      return
    end

    -- 3) [220,000 .. 249,999] Canli Move Delta (Axis 0..2, Sign 0..1, MagTen 1..4999):
    if pkt >= 220000 and pkt <= 249999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local rem = pkt - 220000
      local axisIdx = math.floor(rem / 10000)
      local rem2 = rem % 10000
      local signIdx = math.floor(rem2 / 5000)
      local magTen = rem2 % 5000
      local delta = (magTen / 10.0) * ((signIdx == 1) and 1 or -1)
      local moveVec = (axisIdx == 0 and Vector3.new(delta, 0, 0))
        or (axisIdx == 1 and Vector3.new(0, delta, 0))
        or Vector3.new(0, 0, delta)
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(moveVec)
      return
    end

    -- 4) [250,000 .. 269,999] Kesin Konum Senkronu (Sender HRP'ye gore X/Y/Z offset):
    if pkt >= 250000 and pkt <= 269999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      local sHrp = sender.Character and sender.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not p or not p.Parent or not sHrp then return end
      local code = pkt - 250000
      local qx = math.floor(code / 729)
      local rem = code % 729
      local qy = math.floor(rem / 27)
      local qz = rem % 27
      local ox = (qx - 13) * 2.0
      local oy = (qy - 13) * 2.0
      local oz = (qz - 13) * 2.0
      local rotOnly = p.CFrame - p.CFrame.Position
      p.CFrame = CFrame.new(sHrp.Position + Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz)) * rotOnly
      return
    end

    -- 5) [270,000 .. 299,999] Canli Resize Delta (Axis 0..2, Sign 0..1, MagTen 1..4999):
    if pkt >= 270000 and pkt <= 299999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local rem = pkt - 270000
      local axisIdx = math.floor(rem / 10000)
      local rem2 = rem % 10000
      local signIdx = math.floor(rem2 / 5000)
      local magTen = rem2 % 5000
      local delta = (magTen / 10.0) * ((signIdx == 1) and 1 or -1)
      local dVec = (axisIdx == 0 and Vector3.new(delta, 0, 0))
        or (axisIdx == 1 and Vector3.new(0, delta, 0))
        or Vector3.new(0, 0, delta)
      local ns = p.Size + dVec
      F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, ns, nil, nil, true, sender)
      return
    end

    -- 6) [300,000 .. 339,999] Kesin Boyut Senkronu (Exact Size X/Y/Z veya Karakter Olcegi):
    if pkt >= 300000 and pkt <= 339999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local code = pkt - 300000
      local qx = math.floor(code / 1024)
      local rem = code % 1024
      local qy = math.floor(rem / 32)
      local qz = rem % 32
      local sx = math.max(0.5, qx * 1.5)
      local sy = math.max(0.5, qy * 1.5)
      local sz = math.max(0.5, qz * 1.5)
      F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz), nil, nil, true, sender)
      return
    end

    -- 7) [340,000 .. 369,999] Canli Rotate Delta (Axis 0..2, Deg 0..359):
    if pkt >= 340000 and pkt <= 369999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      if not p or not p.Parent then return end
      local rem = pkt - 340000
      local axisIdx = math.floor(rem / 10000)
      local deg = rem % 10000
      if deg > 180 then deg = deg - 360 end
      local rad = math.rad(deg)
      local rotCF = (axisIdx == 0 and CFrame.Angles(rad, 0, 0))
        or (axisIdx == 1 and CFrame.Angles(0, rad, 0))
        or CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad)
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * rotCF
      return
    end

    -- 8) [370,000 .. 389,999] Model / Karakter Tam Olcek (Uniform Scale 0.2x .. 25.0x):
    if pkt >= 370000 and pkt <= 389999 then
      local p = F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name]
      local scaleVal = math.clamp((pkt - 370000) / 20.0, 0.1, 30.0)
      if p and p.Parent then
        local charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p.Parent)
        if charPlr and charPlr.Character then
          Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(charPlr.Character, scaleVal)
        else
          F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, Vector3.new(6 * scaleVal, 6 * scaleVal, 6 * scaleVal), nil, nil, true, sender)
        end
      end
      return
    end

    -- 9) [390,000 .. 414,999] Paint (Renk Degisimi: partId * 20 + colIdx):
    if pkt >= 390000 and pkt <= 414999 then
      local rem = pkt - 390000
      local pid = math.floor(rem / 20)
      local colIdx = (rem % 20)
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and F3XPalette[colIdx] then
        p.Color = F3XPalette[colIdx].Color
      end
      return
    end

    -- 10) [415,000 .. 431,999] Surface / Material (partId * 15 + matIdx):
    if pkt >= 415000 and pkt <= 431999 then
      local rem = pkt - 415000
      local pid = math.floor(rem / 15)
      local matIdx = (rem % 15)
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and F3XMaterials[matIdx] then
        p.Material = F3XMaterials[matIdx]
      end
      return
    end

    -- 11) [432,000 .. 434,999] Anchor Toggle (partId * 2 + anchorBit):
    if pkt >= 432000 and pkt <= 434999 then
      local rem = pkt - 432000
      local pid = math.floor(rem / 2)
      local isAnc = (rem % 2) == 1
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p then
        p.Anchored = isAnc
      end
      return
    end

    -- 12) [435,000 .. 436,999] FX Toggle (Fire + PointLight):
    if pkt >= 435000 and pkt <= 436999 then
      local pid = pkt - 435000
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p then
        local fl = p:FindFirstChild("F3X_Fire")
        if fl then
          fl:Destroy()
          local pl = p:FindFirstChild("F3X_Light")
          if pl then pl:Destroy() end
        else
          local fire = Instance.new("Fire", p)
          fire.Name = "F3X_Fire"
          fire.Size = 8
          local pl = Instance.new("PointLight", p)
          pl.Name = "F3X_Light"
          pl.Range = 24
          pl.Brightness = 3
          pl.Color = p.Color
        end
      end
      return
    end

    -- 13) [438,000 .. 439,999] Clone Part:
    if pkt >= 438000 and pkt <= 439999 then
      local pid = pkt - 438000
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and p.Parent then
        State.SpawnedBlocksCount = (State.SpawnedBlocksCount or 0) + 1
        local newId = 701 + ((State.SpawnedBlocksCount - 1) % 298)
        local cl = p:Clone()
        cl.Name = "Topk3k_P2PBlock_" .. tostring(State.SpawnedBlocksCount)
        cl.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, p.Size.Y, 0)
        cl:SetAttribute("F3X_PartId", newId)
        cl.Parent = Workspace
        F3XState.PartRegistryById[newId] = cl
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = cl
      end
      return
    end

    -- 14) [440,000 .. 441,999] Delete Part by F3X_PartId:
    if pkt >= 440000 and pkt <= 441999 then
      local pid = pkt - 440000
      local p = Engine.F3X_ResolvePartById(pid, sender)
      if p and p.Parent then
        table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, {
          Part = p,
          Parent = p.Parent,
          CFrame = p.CFrame,
          Transparency = p.Transparency,
          CanCollide = p.CanCollide,
          Anchored = p.Anchored
        })
        p.Parent = nil
        PlayUiSound("explosion")
      end
      return
    end

    -- 15) [449,999] Undo:
    if pkt == 449999 then
      Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedParts()
      return
    end
  end

  function Engine.HandleIncomingF3XSync(sender, opCode)
    local code = tonumber(opCode) or 1
    if code >= 10 and code <= 19 then
      local spawned = Engine.Topk3k_SpawnP2PBlock(sender, code - 9)
      if spawned and sender then
        F3XState.PeerSelectedParts[sender.Name] = spawned
      end
    elseif code == 20 then
      Engine.Topk3k_DeletePartByHash(sender, nil)
    elseif code >= 100 and code <= 8999 then
      Engine.Topk3k_DeletePartByHash(sender, code)
    elseif code == 30 then
      Engine.Topk3k_BuildP2PTrowelWall(sender)
    elseif code == 40 then
      Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedParts()
    end
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    local pid = Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(part)
    if pid > 0 then
      F3X_SendPacket(210000 + pid, 1)
    end
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(axisVec, deltaStuds)
    if math.abs(deltaStuds) < 0.05 then return end
    local axisIdx = (math.abs(axisVec.X) > 0.5 and 0) or (math.abs(axisVec.Y) > 0.5 and 1) or 2
    local signedDelta = (axisIdx == 0 and (axisVec.X * deltaStuds))
      or (axisIdx == 1 and (axisVec.Y * deltaStuds))
      or (axisVec.Z * deltaStuds)
    local signIdx = (signedDelta >= 0) and 1 or 0
    local magTen = math.clamp(math.floor(math.abs(signedDelta) * 10 + 0.5), 1, 4999)
    F3X_SendPacket(220000 + (axisIdx * 10000) + (signIdx * 5000) + magTen, 2)
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(axisVec, deltaStuds, part)
    if math.abs(deltaStuds) < 0.05 then return end
    local axisIdx = (math.abs(axisVec.X) > 0.5 and 0) or (math.abs(axisVec.Y) > 0.5 and 1) or 2
    local signedDelta = (axisIdx == 0 and (axisVec.X * deltaStuds))
      or (axisIdx == 1 and (axisVec.Y * deltaStuds))
      or (axisVec.Z * deltaStuds)
    local signIdx = (signedDelta >= 0) and 1 or 0
    local magTen = math.clamp(math.floor(math.abs(signedDelta) * 10 + 0.5), 1, 4999)
    F3X_SendPacket(270000 + (axisIdx * 10000) + (signIdx * 5000) + magTen, 2)
  end

  local function F3X_BroadcastRotateDelta(axisVec, degDelta)
    if math.abs(degDelta) < 1 then return end
    local axisIdx = (math.abs(axisVec.X) > 0.5 and 0) or (math.abs(axisVec.Y) > 0.5 and 1) or 2
    local signedDeg = (axisIdx == 0 and (axisVec.X * degDelta))
      or (axisIdx == 1 and (axisVec.Y * degDelta))
      or (axisVec.Z * degDelta)
    local normDeg = math.floor(signedDeg + 0.5) % 360
    if normDeg < 0 then normDeg = normDeg + 360 end
    F3X_SendPacket(340000 + (axisIdx * 10000) + normDeg, 3)
  end

  local function F3X_ClearGizmos()
    if F3XState.SelectionBox then pcall(function() F3XState.SelectionBox:Destroy() end); F3XState.SelectionBox = nil end
    if F3XState.MoveHandles then pcall(function() F3XState.MoveHandles:Destroy() end); F3XState.MoveHandles = nil end
    if F3XState.ArcHandles then pcall(function() F3XState.ArcHandles:Destroy() end); F3XState.ArcHandles = nil end
  end

  local function F3X_AttachGizmos(part)
    F3X_ClearGizmos()
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Parent then return end
    Engine.F3X_GetOrAssignPartId(part)
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or UI.ScreenGui
    if not pg then return end

    local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
    sb.Name = "F3X_SelectionBox"
    sb.Adornee = part
    sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 0)
    sb.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 0)
    sb.SurfaceTransparency = 0.85
    sb.LineThickness = 0.04
    sb.Parent = pg
    F3XState.SelectionBox = sb

    if F3XState.Mode == "Move" or F3XState.Mode == "Resize" or F3XState.Mode == "Scale" then
      local h = Instance.new("Handles")
      h.Name = "F3X_Handles"
      h.Adornee = part
      h.Style = (F3XState.Mode == "Move") and Enum.HandlesStyle.Movement or Enum.HandlesStyle.Resize
      h.Color3 = (F3XState.Mode == "Move") and Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
        or (F3XState.Mode == "Scale" and Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94))
      h.Parent = pg
      F3XState.MoveHandles = h

      h.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        if F3XState.SelectedPart then
          F3XState.DragStartCF = F3XState.SelectedPart.CFrame
          F3XState.DragStartSize = F3XState.SelectedPart.Size
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap = 0
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap = 0
          F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        end
      end)

      h.MouseDrag:Connect(function(face, distance)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent or not F3XState.DragStartCF then return end
        local snap = math.floor((distance / F3XState.Step) + 0.5) * F3XState.Step
        local dir = Vector3.FromNormalId(face)
        local now = tick()
        if F3XState.Mode == "Move" then
          p.CFrame = F3XState.DragStartCF * CFrame.new(dir * snap)
          local diff = snap - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(diff) >= 0.5 and (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.045 then
            F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap = snap
            F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
            F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(dir, diff)
          end
        elseif F3XState.Mode == "Resize" then
          local axisDelta = Vector3.new(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y), math.abs(dir.Z)) * snap
          local newSize = F3XState.DragStartSize + axisDelta
          p.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.5, newSize.X), math.max(0.5, newSize.Y), math.max(0.5, newSize.Z))
          p.CFrame = F3XState.DragStartCF * CFrame.new(dir * (snap * 0.5))
          local diff = snap - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(diff) >= 0.5 and (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.045 then
            F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap = snap
            F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
            local absDir = Vector3.new(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y), math.abs(dir.Z))
            F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(absDir, diff, p)
          end
        elseif F3XState.Mode == "Scale" then
          local charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p.Parent)
          local factor = math.clamp(1.0 + (snap * 0.15), 0.2, 20.0)
          if charPlr and charPlr.Character then
            Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(charPlr.Character, factor)
            if (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.08 then
              F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
              Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(charPlr, factor)
            end
          else
            local newSz = F3XState.DragStartSize * factor
            p.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.5, newSz.X), math.max(0.5, newSz.Y), math.max(0.5, newSz.Z))
            if (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.08 then
              F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
              F3X_SendPacket(370000 + math.clamp(math.floor(factor * 20 + 0.5), 2, 600), 2)
            end
          end
        end
      end)

      h.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function(face)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent then return end
        local dir = face and Vector3.FromNormalId(face) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        if F3XState.Mode == "Move" and F3XState.DragStartCF then
          local totalMoved = (p.Position - F3XState.DragStartCF.Position)
          local projected = totalMoved.X * dir.X + totalMoved.Y * dir.Y + totalMoved.Z * dir.Z
          local remDiff = projected - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedMoveSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(remDiff) >= 0.1 then
            F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(dir, remDiff)
          end
        elseif F3XState.Mode == "Resize" and F3XState.DragStartSize then
          local absDir = Vector3.new(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Y), math.abs(dir.Z))
          local totalSized = (p.Size.X - F3XState.DragStartSize.X) * absDir.X
            + (p.Size.Y - F3XState.DragStartSize.Y) * absDir.Y
            + (p.Size.Z - F3XState.DragStartSize.Z) * absDir.Z
          local remDiff = totalSized - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedResizeSnap or 0)
          if math.abs(remDiff) >= 0.1 then
            F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(absDir, remDiff, p)
          end
          F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, p.Size, nil, nil, false, LocalPlayer)
        end
      end)
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Rotate" then
      local ah = Instance.new("ArcHandles")
      ah.Name = "F3X_ArcHandles"
      ah.Adornee = part
      ah.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22)
      ah.Parent = pg
      F3XState.ArcHandles = ah

      ah.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        if F3XState.SelectedPart then
          F3XState.DragStartCF = F3XState.SelectedPart.CFrame
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg = 0
          F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        end
      end)
      ah.MouseDrag:Connect(function(axis, relativeAngle)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent or not F3XState.DragStartCF then return end
        local degSnap = math.floor((math.deg(relativeAngle) / 15) + 0.5) * 15
        local radSnap = math.rad(degSnap)
        local axisVec = Vector3.FromAxis(axis)
        local rotVec = axisVec * radSnap
        p.CFrame = F3XState.DragStartCF * CFrame.Angles(rotVec.X, rotVec.Y, rotVec.Z)
        local diffDeg = degSnap - (F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg or 0)
        local now = tick()
        if math.abs(diffDeg) >= 15 and (now - F3XState.LastDragPacketTick) >= 0.045 then
          F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg = degSnap
          F3XState.LastDragPacketTick = now
          F3X_BroadcastRotateDelta(axisVec, diffDeg)
        end
      end)
      ah.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function(axis)
        local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
        if not p or not p.Parent then return end
        local diffDeg = (F3XState.LastBroadcastedRotDeg or 0)
        if axis and math.abs(diffDeg) > 0 then
          F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(p)
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  local function F3X_NudgeSelected(axisVec, sign)
    local p = F3XState.SelectedPart
    if not p or not p.Parent then return end
    F3X_BroadcastSelectPart(p)
    local stepVal = F3XState.Step * sign
    local d = axisVec * stepVal
    if F3XState.Mode == "Move" then
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(d)
      F3X_BroadcastMoveDelta(axisVec, stepVal)
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Resize" then
      local ns = p.Size + d
      F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, ns, nil, nil, false, LocalPlayer)
      F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(axisVec, stepVal, p)
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Scale" then
      local charPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p.Parent)
      if charPlr and charPlr.Character then
        local curScale = charPlr.Character:GetAttribute("BerksAppliedScale") or 1.0
        local nextScale = math.clamp(curScale + (0.25 * sign), 0.2, 20.0)
        Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(charPlr, nextScale)
      else
        local ns = p.Size * ((sign > 0) and 1.2 or 0.8)
        F3X_ApplyResizeToPartOrCharacter(p, ns, nil, nil, false, LocalPlayer)
        F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), ns.X - p.Size.X, p)
        F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), ns.Y - p.Size.Y, p)
        F3X_BroadcastResizeDelta(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), ns.Z - p.Size.Z, p)
      end
    elseif F3XState.Mode == "Rotate" then
      local deg = 15 * sign
      local ang = math.rad(deg)
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(axisVec.X * ang, axisVec.Y * ang, axisVec.Z * ang)
      F3X_BroadcastRotateDelta(axisVec, deg)
    end
  end

        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then F3XState.Mode = "Resize"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then F3XState.Mode = "Scale"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then F3XState.Mode = "Rotate"; F3X_AttachGizmos(F3XState.SelectedPart)

    local eerieLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", blackFrame)
    eerieLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 120)
    eerieLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.42, 0)
    eerieLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    eerieLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    eerieLabel.TextSize = 24
    eerieLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 18, 38)
    eerieLabel.TextWrapped = true
    eerieLabel.Text = ""
    eerieLabel.ZIndex = 11

    -- Hareketi tamamen kilitle (Istesek de hareket edemeyelim!)
    pcall(function()
      local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
      CAS:BindActionAtPriority("Polaria_PatrickLockControls", function()
        return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
      end, false, 999999,
        Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterForward,
        Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterBackward,
        Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterLeft,
        Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterRight,
        Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterJump,
        Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.D, Enum.KeyCode.Space,
        Enum.KeyCode.Up, Enum.KeyCode.Down, Enum.KeyCode.Left, Enum.KeyCode.Right
      )
    end)

    local myStartPos = (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position) or startPos
    local pullConn = nil
    local touchedMouth = false
    local currentPullPos = myStartPos
    local totalStartDist = math.max(1, (mouthPos - myStartPos).Magnitude)

    pullConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
      if touchedMouth then return end
      local c = LocalPlayer.Character
      local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hm = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

      if hm then
        hm.WalkSpeed = 0
        hm.JumpPower = 0
        pcall(function() hm.JumpHeight = 0 end)
        hm.AutoRotate = false
        hm.PlatformStand = true
      end

      local toMouth = mouthPos - currentPullPos
      local dist = toMouth.Magnitude
      local pullStep = math.min(dist, dt * 13.5)
      if dist > 0.05 then
        currentPullPos = currentPullPos + (toMouth.Unit * pullStep)
      end

      if h then
        h.Anchored = true
        h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        h.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(currentPullPos, mouthPos)
      end

      if cam then
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        local shake = Vector3.new(
          (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
          (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
          (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45
        )
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(currentPullPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0) + shake, mouthPos)
      end

      -- Patrick'e yaklastikca ekran gittikce siyahlassin!
      local progress = math.clamp(1 - (dist / totalStartDist), 0, 1)
      blackFrame.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - (progress ^ 1.15), 0, 1)

      if dist <= 5.5 then
        touchedMouth = true
        if pullConn then pullConn:Disconnect(); pullConn = nil end
        blackFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        eerieLabel.Text = "O SENİ YUTTU.\nKARANLIĞIN İÇİNDE NEFES ALDIĞINI DUYABİLİYORUM...\n5..."
        Engine.Topk3k_PlaySyncedSound("9043345732", 10, 0.52, false, true, true)

        task.spawn(function()
          for sec = 5, 1, -1 do
            eerieLabel.Text = string.format(
              "O SENİ YUTTU.\nBacakların neden hareket etmedi sanıyorsun? Onlar artık senin değil.\n[%d]",
              sec
            )
            task.wait(1)
          end
          pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ContextActionService"):UnbindAction("Polaria_PatrickLockControls")
          end)
          LocalPlayer:Kick(
            "\n[0x17161264706 // PATRICK_CONSUMPTION_PROTOCOL]\n" ..
            "Karanlığın içinde nefes aldığını duyabiliyorum.\n" ..
            "Bacakların neden hareket etmedi sanıyorsun? Onlar artık senin değil.\n" ..
            "Gözlerini kapattığında gördüğün o pembe silüet ekranın içinden çıkmadı.\n" ..
            "Şu an tam arkanda duruyor. Sakın arkana dönme. Çok geç.\n" ..
            "[OTURUM_KARANLIK_TARAFINDAN_SONLANDIRILDI]"
          )
        end)
      end
    end)
  end

      [8] = "rbxassetid://507776043", -- Wing Flap

  function Engine.AnimateCharacterMotor6DArm(char, poseCode, durationSec)
    if not char then return end
    local rightShoulder = char:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true)
    local leftShoulder = char:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true)
    local neck = char:FindFirstChild("Neck", true)
    if not rightShoulder then return end

    if not rightShoulder:GetAttribute("OrigC0_Cached") then
      rightShoulder:SetAttribute("OrigC0_Cached", true)
      rightShoulder:SetAttribute("OrigC0", rightShoulder.C0)
      if leftShoulder then leftShoulder:SetAttribute("OrigC0", leftShoulder.C0) end
      if neck then neck:SetAttribute("OrigC0", neck.C0) end
    end

    local origR = rightShoulder:GetAttribute("OrigC0") or rightShoulder.C0
    local origL = leftShoulder and (leftShoulder:GetAttribute("OrigC0") or leftShoulder.C0)
    local isR6 = (rightShoulder.Name == "Right Shoulder")

    if poseCode == 10 or poseCode == 9 then
      -- R6 & R15 Motor6D Silah Dogrultma / Keskince Savurma Animasyonu:
      local targetR = isR6 and (origR * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(95))) or (origR * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(88), 0, math.rad(10)))
      TweenService:Create(rightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { C0 = targetR }):Play()
      if poseCode == 9 then
        task.delay(0.15, function()
          if rightShoulder and rightShoulder.Parent then
            local slashR = isR6 and (origR * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(25))) or (origR * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20), 0, math.rad(-25)))
            TweenService:Create(rightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { C0 = slashR }):Play()
          end
        end)
      end
    elseif poseCode == 5 or poseCode == 6 or poseCode == 7 then
      local liftR = isR6 and (origR * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(135))) or (origR * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(135), 0, 0))
      local liftL = leftShoulder and (isR6 and (origL * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-135))) or (origL * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(135), 0, 0)))
      TweenService:Create(rightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { C0 = liftR }):Play()
      if leftShoulder and liftL then
        TweenService:Create(leftShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { C0 = liftL }):Play()
      end
    end

    task.delay(durationSec or 0.55, function()
      if rightShoulder and rightShoulder.Parent then
        TweenService:Create(rightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { C0 = origR }):Play()
      end
      if leftShoulder and leftShoulder.Parent and origL then
        TweenService:Create(leftShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { C0 = origL }):Play()
      end
    end)
  end

  function Engine.TriggerMorphAnimation(plr, animCode, fromP2P)
    local p = plr or LocalPlayer
    if not p then return end
    local code = math.clamp(tonumber(animCode) or 1, 1, 20)
    State.MorphAnimStates[p.Name] = {
      Code = code,
      Timestamp = tick(),
      ExpiresAt = tick() + ((code >= 5) and 1.15 or 0.65)
    }
    if not fromP2P then
      BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("ANIM_SYNC", p.Name, tostring(code))
    end
    if p.Character then
      Engine.AnimateCharacterMotor6DArm(p.Character, code, 0.55)
    end
  end

  function Engine.HandleIncomingMorphAnimationSync(plr, animCode)
    if not plr then return end
    Engine.TriggerMorphAnimation(plr, animCode, true)
  end

  function Engine.Polaria_ExecutePrimadonSkill(plr, skillCode, fromP2P)
    local p = plr or LocalPlayer
    local char = p.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    if not fromP2P then
      BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("PRIMADON_STOMP", p.Name, tostring(skillCode or 1))
      if P2P and P2P.Send then
        P2P:Send("POLARIA_ACTION", {
          ActionId = 900 + (tonumber(skillCode) or 1),
          Actor = p.Name,
          Extra = tostring(skillCode or 1)
        })
      end
    end

    -- P2P Animasyon Tetikleyici:
    Engine.TriggerMorphAnimation(p, 4 + (tonumber(skillCode) or 1), true)

    if skillCode == 1 then
      -- EZME DARBESI (100 Stud Primadon Dev Ezme + Sok Dalgasi)
      Engine.Topk3k_PlaySyncedSound("9043345732", 10, 0.48, false, true, false)
      local ring = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)
      ring.Name = "Primadon_ShockwaveRing"
      ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
      ring.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 14, 14)
      ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
      ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(198, 206, 152)
      ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
      ring.Anchored = true
      ring.CanCollide = false
      ring.Transparency = 0.15
      TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.65, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 120, 120),
        Transparency = 1
      }):Play()
      task.delay(0.7, function() if ring and ring.Parent then ring:Destroy() end end)

      for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if other ~= p and other.Character then
          local oHrp = other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local oHum = other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if oHrp and (oHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= 62 then
            if Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(p, other) then
              if Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions then
                Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(other, "squash")
              end
              if oHum then oHum.Sit = true; pcall(function() oHum:TakeDamage(75) end) end
              oHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new((oHrp.Position.X - hrp.Position.X) * 9, -110, (oHrp.Position.Z - hrp.Position.Z) * 9)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    elseif skillCode == 2 then
      -- KAYA FIRLAT (100 Stud Primadon Kaya Firlatma)
      local boulder = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)
      boulder.Name = "Primadon_ColossalBoulder"
      boulder.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
      boulder.Size = Vector3.new(22, 22, 22)
      boulder.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
      boulder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 104, 102)
      boulder.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 48, -24)
      boulder.Anchored = false
      boulder.CanCollide = true
      local fire = Instance.new("Fire", boulder)
      fire.Size = 24
      fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(198, 206, 152)
      boulder.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 210) + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0)
      boulder.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        if hit and not hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then
          local hitPlr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
          if hitPlr and hitPlr ~= p and Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(p, hitPlr) then
            local hHum = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hHum then hHum.Health = 0 end
          elseif hit:IsA("BasePart") and hit.Size.Magnitude < 55 then
            hit.Anchored = false
            hit.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-95, 95), 110, math.random(-95, 95))
          end
        end
      end)
      task.delay(6, function() if boulder and boulder.Parent then boulder:Destroy() end end)
    elseif skillCode == 3 then
      -- PRIMADON KUKREMESI (Primal Roar + Kanat Cirpma)
      Engine.Topk3k_PlaySyncedSound("9043345732", 10, 0.52, false, true, true)
      Engine.EmitP2PShockwavePulse(75)
    elseif skillCode == 4 then
      -- PRIMADON KANAT SICRAMASI (Dorsal Wing Leap)
      hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 105) + Vector3.new(0, 140, 0)
      Engine.Topk3k_PlaySyncedSound("9043345732", 8, 0.72, false, true, false)
    end
  end

  function Engine.Polaria_SetPrimadonMorph(targetPlayer, enableState, fromP2P)
    local plr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
    if not plr then return end
    local pName = plr.Name
    local turnOn = (enableState == true)

    if not fromP2P then
      BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket(turnOn and "PRIMADON_ON" or "PRIMADON_OFF", pName, turnOn and "1" or "0")
      if P2P and P2P.Send then
        P2P:Send("POLARIA_ACTION", {
          ActionId = 38,
          Actor = pName,
          Extra = turnOn and "ON" or "OFF"
        })
      end
    end

    local oldRig = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Polaria_PrimadonTitan_" .. pName)
    if oldRig then oldRig:Destroy() end
    if State.PrimadonPlayers[pName] and State.PrimadonPlayers[pName].Conn then
      State.PrimadonPlayers[pName].Conn:Disconnect()
    end
    if plr == LocalPlayer and UI.ScreenGui then
      local oldHud = UI.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("Polaria_PrimadonHUD")
      if oldHud then oldHud:Destroy() end
    end

    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not turnOn then
      State.PrimadonPlayers[pName] = nil
      State.MorphAnimStates[pName] = nil
      if char then
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
          if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            d.Transparency = 0
          elseif d:IsA("Decal") then
            d.Transparency = 0
          end
        end
      end
      if hum then
        hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
        hum.WalkSpeed = 16
        hum.JumpPower = 50
      end
      if plr == LocalPlayer then
        LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 128
        LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
        if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
          if hum then Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum end
          Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
        end
        UI.SendPolariaNotification("PRIMADON", "Primadon modundan çıkıldı, karakteriniz normale döndü.", 2.5)
      end
      return
    end

    if not char or not hrp or not hum then return end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("BasePart") then
        d.Transparency = 1
        if d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then d.CanCollide = false end
      elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
        d.Transparency = 1
      end
    end

    -- 2) 100 STUD BÜYÜKLÜĞÜNDE KENDİ YAPIMIMIZ ÖZEL DEEPWOKEN PRIMADON MODELİ (12310110178 / 13158412097 Referanslı Birebir Kanatlı Primadon!)
    local primModel = Instance.new("Model")
    primModel.Name = "Polaria_PrimadonTitan_" .. pName
    primModel.Parent = Workspace

    local animLimbs = {}
    local primHeadPart = nil

    local rootCore = Instance.new("Part", primModel)
    rootCore.Name = "PrimadonCore"
    rootCore.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    rootCore.Transparency = 1
    rootCore.Anchored = true
    rootCore.CanCollide = false
    primModel.PrimaryPart = rootCore

    -- 100 STUD BOYUT HESABI:
    -- Orijinal taban (-3.7) ile tepe (+35.6) arası 39.3 stud * S(2.55) = 100.2 STUD TAM BÜYÜKLÜK!
    -- groundShiftY = (3.7 * 2.55) - 3.0 = 6.435 (Ayak tabanları tam -3.0 zemin hizasına oturur)
    local S = 2.55
    local groundShiftY = (3.7 * S) - 3.0
    local furTealGrey = Color3.fromRGB(112, 136, 138)
    local chestDark = Color3.fromRGB(45, 58, 62)
    local faceMaskCol = Color3.fromRGB(46, 54, 56)
    local wingMembrane = Color3.fromRGB(198, 206, 152)
    local wingSpine = Color3.fromRGB(58, 72, 68)
    local tuskWhite = Color3.fromRGB(238, 240, 232)

    local function MakePart(name, sz, col, mat, relCF, shape)
      local p = Instance.new("Part", primModel)
      p.Name = name
      p.Size = sz * S
      p.Color = col
      p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
      if shape then p.Shape = shape end
      p.Anchored = true
      p.CanCollide = false
      local scaledPos = Vector3.new(relCF.X * S, (relCF.Y * S) + groundShiftY, relCF.Z * S)
      p:SetAttribute("RelX", scaledPos.X)
      p:SetAttribute("RelY", scaledPos.Y)
      p:SetAttribute("RelZ", scaledPos.Z)
      local rx, ry, rz = relCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
      p:SetAttribute("RotX", rx)
      p:SetAttribute("RotY", ry)
      p:SetAttribute("RotZ", rz)
      return p
    end

    -- Gövde, Kaslı Omuzlar & Koyu Göğüs Plakası (100 Stud Ölçekli):
    MakePart("TorsoUpper", Vector3.new(18.5, 15.5, 11.5), furTealGrey, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 19.5, -0.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(8), 0, 0))
    MakePart("ShoulderL", Vector3.new(8.2, 8.2, 8.2), furTealGrey, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(-11.8, 24.2, -0.8), Enum.PartType.Ball)
    MakePart("ShoulderR", Vector3.new(8.2, 8.2, 8.2), furTealGrey, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(11.8, 24.2, -0.8), Enum.PartType.Ball)
    MakePart("DarkChestPatch", Vector3.new(13.8, 12.2, 1.4), chestDark, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(0, 19.8, -5.9) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(8), 0, 0))
    MakePart("AbdomenLower", Vector3.new(14.5, 9.5, 10.2), furTealGrey, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 12.0, 0))
    MakePart("Pelvis", Vector3.new(15.2, 6.2, 10.5), furTealGrey, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 7.5, 0))

    -- Kapüşonlu Baş (Kamera Kafa Hizası Referansı ~81 Stud), Topuz, Kaş Kemeri, Koyu Yüz Maskesi ve Dişler (Tusks):
    primHeadPart = MakePart("HoodHead", Vector3.new(8.8, 9.2, 8.8), furTealGrey, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 29.2, -2.2))
    MakePart("TopKnot", Vector3.new(3.2, 2.4, 3.2), wingSpine, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(0, 34.4, -2.0), Enum.PartType.Ball)
    MakePart("FaceMask", Vector3.new(6.2, 6.6, 2.2), faceMaskCol, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(0, 28.8, -6.1))
    MakePart("BrowRidge", Vector3.new(6.4, 1.3, 2.6), wingSpine, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(0, 31.4, -6.4) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
    MakePart("SnoutBridge", Vector3.new(2.8, 2.4, 2.5), faceMaskCol, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(0, 28.6, -6.8))
    MakePart("JawDark", Vector3.new(5.8, 2.8, 3.2), faceMaskCol, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(0, 26.2, -6.2))
    MakePart("EyeLeft", Vector3.new(1.1, 0.85, 0.6), tuskWhite, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(-1.5, 30.2, -7.1))
    MakePart("EyeRight", Vector3.new(1.1, 0.85, 0.6), tuskWhite, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(1.5, 30.2, -7.1))
    MakePart("LeftTusk", Vector3.new(0.75, 2.2, 0.75), tuskWhite, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(-1.8, 27.6, -7.3) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, math.rad(-8)))
    MakePart("RightTusk", Vector3.new(0.75, 2.2, 0.75), tuskWhite, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(1.8, 27.6, -7.3) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, math.rad(8)))

    -- Sırt / Omuz ve Bel Yüzgeç Kanatları (4 Adet Perdeli Dorsal Kanat + Kemik Damarları):
    animLimbs.UpperWingL = MakePart("UpperWingL", Vector3.new(14.5, 8.5, 0.9), wingMembrane, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(-14.5, 25.5, 3.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(18), math.rad(28)))
    MakePart("UpperWingSpineL", Vector3.new(15.2, 1.1, 1.2), wingSpine, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(-14.5, 29.5, 3.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(18), math.rad(28)))
    MakePart("UpperWingRibL", Vector3.new(13.5, 0.6, 1.0), wingSpine, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(-14.2, 24.8, 3.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(18), math.rad(14)))
    animLimbs.UpperWingR = MakePart("UpperWingR", Vector3.new(14.5, 8.5, 0.9), wingMembrane, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(14.5, 25.5, 3.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-18), math.rad(-28)))
    MakePart("UpperWingSpineR", Vector3.new(15.2, 1.1, 1.2), wingSpine, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(14.5, 29.5, 3.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-18), math.rad(-28)))
    MakePart("UpperWingRibR", Vector3.new(13.5, 0.6, 1.0), wingSpine, Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame.new(14.2, 24.8, 3.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-18), math.rad(-14)))

    local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
      local c = plr.Character
      local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local curHum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not c or not h or not primModel.Parent then return end

      for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
          d.Transparency = 1
        end

      local vel = h.AssemblyLinearVelocity
      local speed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude

        end

          local ry = child:GetAttribute("RelY") or 0
          local rz = child:GetAttribute("RelZ") or 0
          local rotx = child:GetAttribute("RotX") or 0
          local roty = child:GetAttribute("RotY") or 0
          local rotz = child:GetAttribute("RotZ") or 0
          local swingX, swingY, swingZ = 0, 0, 0

          if activeCode == 5 then
            -- STOMP Animasyonu:

            -- THROW (Kaya Firlatma) Animasyonu:

            end

            if child == animLimbs.UpperWingL or child == animLimbs.LowerWingL then
              swingY = math.sin(tick() * 22) * 0.48
            elseif child == animLimbs.UpperWingR or child == animLimbs.LowerWingR then
              swingY = -math.sin(tick() * 22) * 0.48
            elseif child == animLimbs.LeftArm or child == animLimbs.RightArm then
              swingZ = math.sin(tick() * 16) * 0.45
            end
          elseif speed > 1.5 or activeCode == 2 or activeCode == 3 then
            -- YURUME / KOSMA SENKRON ANIMASYONU:
            if child == animLimbs.LeftArm or child == animLimbs.LeftHand or child == animLimbs.RightLeg then
              swingX = math.sin(t) * 0.62
            elseif child == animLimbs.RightArm or child == animLimbs.RightHand or child == animLimbs.LeftLeg then
              swingX = -math.sin(t) * 0.62
            elseif child == animLimbs.UpperWingL or child == animLimbs.LowerWingL then
              swingY = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.16
            elseif child == animLimbs.UpperWingR or child == animLimbs.LowerWingR then
              swingY = -math.sin(t * 0.5) * 0.16
            end
          else
            -- IDLE NEFES & KANAT HAREKETI:
            if child == animLimbs.UpperWingL or child == animLimbs.LowerWingL then
              swingY = math.sin(tick() * 2.2) * 0.08
            elseif child == animLimbs.UpperWingR or child == animLimbs.LowerWingR then
              swingY = -math.sin(tick() * 2.2) * 0.08
            end
          end

          child.CFrame = baseCF * CFrame.new(rx, ry, rz) * CFrame.Angles(rotx + swingX, roty + swingY, rotz + swingZ)
        end

              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)

  end

  function Engine.Polaria_TogglePrimadonMorph(targetPlayer, fromP2P)
    local plr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
    local isCurrentlyOn = (State.PrimadonPlayers[plr.Name] ~= nil)
    Engine.Polaria_SetPrimadonMorph(plr, not isCurrentlyOn, fromP2P)
  end

        Engine.Polaria_ExecutePrimadonSkill(LocalPlayer, 3, false)
      elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        Engine.Polaria_ExecutePrimadonSkill(LocalPlayer, 4, false)
      elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
        Engine.Polaria_SetPrimadonMorph(LocalPlayer, false, false)
      end
    end
  end)

  local function Polaria_BindButtonHoverAndClickFX(btn, baseBg, hoverBg, borderCol)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        BackgroundColor3 = hoverBg
      }):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        BackgroundColor3 = baseBg
      }):Play()
    end)
  end

  local function Polaria_ExecuteMiniScriptOrCommand(rawCode)
    local txt = string.gsub(tostring(rawCode or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    if txt == "" then return end
    local low = string.lower(txt)
    if string.find(low, "primadon") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(38, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "patrick") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(63, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "flood") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(19, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "clear") or string.find(low, "void") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(5, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "f3x") or string.find(low, "btools") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(99, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "mosque") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(44, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "nds") or string.find(low, "disaster") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(105, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "c00lgui") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(2, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "roxploit") or string.find(low, "ro-xploit") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(72, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.find(low, "666") then
      Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(12, LocalPlayer, false)
    elseif string.sub(txt, 1, 1) == ";" and Engine.ExecuteCommandString then
      Engine.ExecuteCommandString(string.sub(txt, 2))
    elseif type(loadstring) == "function" and (string.find(txt, "%(") or string.find(txt, "=")) then
      local fn = loadstring(txt)
      if type(fn) == "function" then pcall(fn) end
    elseif Engine.ExecuteCommandString then
      Engine.ExecuteCommandString(txt)
    end
  end

  -- ==========================================================================
  -- 6. POLARIA HUB DETAYLI MARKETPLACE / 3D SILAH + MOTOR6D ANIMASYON +
  --    1000 STUD UZAK MEGA HARITA (MOSQUE / NDS / SCARY HOUSE) + ANINDA RESPAWN
  -- ==========================================================================
  local function Polaria_BuildDetailedWeaponParts(parentModelOrTool, primaryPart, weaponId, weaponColor)
    local isMelee = (weaponId == 73 or weaponId == 48 or weaponId == 79 or weaponId == 28 or weaponId == 31 or weaponId == 61)
    local function AddDetail(name, sz, col, mat, offsetCF)
      local p = Instance.new("Part", parentModelOrTool)
      p.Name = name
      p.Size = sz
      p.Color = col
      p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Metal
      p.CanCollide = false
      p.Massless = true
      p.CFrame = primaryPart.CFrame * offsetCF
      local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", p)
      w.Part0 = primaryPart
      w.Part1 = p
      return p
    end

    if isMelee then
      -- Detayli 3D Kilic / Balta / Bicak Modeli:
      AddDetail("CrossGuard", Vector3.new(1.6, 0.35, 0.55), Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 0.7, 0))
      AddDetail("BladeCore", Vector3.new(0.28, 4.6, 0.85), Color3.fromRGB(225, 232, 240), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 3.1, 0))
      AddDetail("BladeNeonEdge", Vector3.new(0.32, 4.7, 0.25), weaponColor, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 3.15, -0.35))
    else
      -- Detayli 3D Taktiksel Atesli / Lazer Silah Modeli (Govde, Namlu, Sarjor, Optik Nisan):
      AddDetail("ReceiverBody", Vector3.new(0.55, 0.75, 2.4), Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 36), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 0.45, -0.6))
      AddDetail("BarrelTube", Vector3.new(0.32, 0.32, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(15, 18, 22), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 0.55, -2.2))
      AddDetail("NeonEnergyCore", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.28, 1.6), weaponColor, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 0.52, -0.7))
      AddDetail("MagazineClip", Vector3.new(0.42, 1.1, 0.52), Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 48), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, -0.25, -0.75) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(14), 0, 0))
      AddDetail("HoloSight", Vector3.new(0.45, 0.42, 0.65), weaponColor, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 0.98, -0.5))
    end
  end

  local function Polaria_AttachReplicated3DWeapon(actorPlr, weaponId, weaponColor, weaponSize)
    local char = actorPlr and actorPlr.Character
    if not char then return end
    local oldWep = char:FindFirstChild("Polaria_ReplicatedWeapon")
    if oldWep then oldWep:Destroy() end
    local rightHand = char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rightHand then return end

    local wepModel = Instance.new("Model", char)
    wepModel.Name = "Polaria_ReplicatedWeapon"

    local gripPart = Instance.new("Part", wepModel)
    gripPart.Name = "Handle"
    gripPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 1.1, 0.55)
    gripPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 38)
    gripPart.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    gripPart.CanCollide = false
    gripPart.Massless = true
    gripPart.CFrame = rightHand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.6, -0.4)
    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", gripPart)
    w.Part0 = rightHand
    w.Part1 = gripPart

    Polaria_BuildDetailedWeaponParts(wepModel, gripPart, weaponId, weaponColor or Color3.fromRGB(129, 26, 255))
    Engine.AnimateCharacterMotor6DArm(char, 10, 0.65)
  end

  local function Polaria_ExecuteReplicatedWeaponFire(actorPlr, weaponId)
    local char = actorPlr and actorPlr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    PlayUiSound("slap")
    local isMelee = (weaponId == 73 or weaponId == 48 or weaponId == 79 or weaponId == 28 or weaponId == 31 or weaponId == 61)
    Engine.AnimateCharacterMotor6DArm(char, isMelee and 9 or 10, 0.48)

    local beam = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)
    beam.Name = "Polaria_ReplicatedLaserBeam"
    beam.Size = isMelee and Vector3.new(6.5, 1.2, 9.5) or Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 68)
    beam.Color = (weaponId == 48 or weaponId == 79 or weaponId == 61) and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(192, 132, 252)
    beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    beam.Anchored = true
    beam.CanCollide = false
    beam.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, isMelee and -5.5 or -34)
    task.delay(0.2, function() if beam and beam.Parent then beam:Destroy() end end)

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if p ~= actorPlr and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local d = (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - (hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -14)).Position).Magnitude
        if d <= 24 then
          Engine.Topk3k_DealSyncedDamage(p, 48)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  local function Polaria_GiveCustomWeaponTool(toolName, weaponId, handleColor, handleSize)
    local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not bp then return end
    local old = bp:FindFirstChild(toolName) or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(toolName))
    if old then old:Destroy() end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = toolName
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    local h = Instance.new("Part", tool)
    h.Name = "Handle"
    h.Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 1.1, 0.55)
    h.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 38)
    h.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    h.CanCollide = false

    Polaria_BuildDetailedWeaponParts(tool, h, weaponId, handleColor or Color3.fromRGB(129, 26, 255))

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
      if LocalPlayer.Character then
        Engine.AnimateCharacterMotor6DArm(LocalPlayer.Character, 10, 0.5)
      end
    end)

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
      Polaria_ExecuteReplicatedWeaponFire(LocalPlayer, weaponId)
      BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("POLARIA_ACTION", "ALL", tostring(200 + weaponId))
    end)
    tool.Parent = bp
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end) end
  end

  -- ANA SPAWNDAN ~1000 STUD UZAKTA DEVASA HARITA OLUSTURUCU + ANINDA GORSEL RESPAWN + FORCEFIELD:
  local function Polaria_Spawn3DMosqueOrHouse(kind, builderPlr)
    local p = builderPlr or LocalPlayer
    local mName = "Polaria_MegaMap_" .. tostring(kind)
    local old = Workspace:FindFirstChild(mName)
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local mdl = Instance.new("Model", Workspace)
    mdl.Name = mName

    -- Ana spawndan ~1000 stud uzakta devasa harita merkezi:
    local mapCenterCF = (kind == "EXCAVATOR")
      and ((p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2.5, -38))) or CFrame.new(0, 0, -38))
      or CFrame.new(1000, 140, -1000)

    local function AddP(sz, cf, col, mat, shape)
      local pt = Instance.new("Part", mdl)
      pt.Size = sz
      pt.CFrame = mapCenterCF * cf
      pt.Color = col
      pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
      if shape then pt.Shape = shape end
      pt.Anchored = true
      pt.CanCollide = true
      return pt
    end

    if kind == "MOSQUE" then
      -- 340x340 Devasa Mermer Avlu + Ortada Kocaman Kubbeli ve 4 Minareli Cami:
      AddP(Vector3.new(340, 6, 340), CFrame.new(0, -3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240), Enum.Material.Marble)
      AddP(Vector3.new(260, 2, 260), CFrame.new(0, 1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249), Enum.Material.Marble)
      -- Ana Cami Govdesi:
      AddP(Vector3.new(120, 48, 120), CFrame.new(0, 25, 0), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Marble)
      -- Merkez Devasa Kubbe + Hilal Alemi:
      AddP(Vector3.new(78, 78, 78), CFrame.new(0, 56, 0), Color3.fromRGB(16, 185, 129), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
      AddP(Vector3.new(2.5, 16, 2.5), CFrame.new(0, 98, 0), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon)
      -- 4 Kose Yarim Kubbe:
      for _, cPos in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-38, 48, -38), Vector3.new(38, 48, -38), Vector3.new(-38, 48, 38), Vector3.new(38, 48, 38) }) do
        AddP(Vector3.new(36, 36, 36), CFrame.new(cPos), Color3.fromRGB(20, 184, 166), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
      end
      -- 4 Devasa Minare + Serefeler + Külah:
      for _, mPos in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-74, 62, -74), Vector3.new(74, 62, -74), Vector3.new(-74, 62, 74), Vector3.new(74, 62, 74) }) do
        AddP(Vector3.new(11, 124, 11), CFrame.new(mPos), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Marble)
        AddP(Vector3.new(16, 3, 16), CFrame.new(mPos + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Marble)
        AddP(Vector3.new(16, 3, 16), CFrame.new(mPos + Vector3.new(0, 46, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Marble)
        AddP(Vector3.new(10, 24, 10), CFrame.new(mPos + Vector3.new(0, 72, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(16, 185, 129), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
      end
      -- Sadirvan (Avlu Cesmesi):
      AddP(Vector3.new(22, 6, 22), CFrame.new(0, 4, 95), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass)
      -- Oyuncuyu ekraninda aninda respawn edip (+ klasik ForceField) yeni haritaya isinla:
      Engine.PerformInstantVisualRespawn(p, mapCenterCF * CFrame.new(0, 8, 125), true)

    elseif kind == "NDS_MAP" then
      -- Natural Disaster Survival Tarzi 1000 Stud Uzakta Devasa Ada + Gozetleme Kulesi:
      AddP(Vector3.new(420, 4, 420), CFrame.new(0, -6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(14, 116, 144), Enum.Material.Glass)
      AddP(Vector3.new(280, 10, 280), CFrame.new(0, -1, 0), Color3.fromRGB(253, 224, 71), Enum.Material.Sand)
      AddP(Vector3.new(240, 12, 240), CFrame.new(0, 4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94), Enum.Material.Grass)
      -- Klasik NDS Gozetleme Kulesi (Observation Tower):
      AddP(Vector3.new(28, 72, 28), CFrame.new(0, 42, 0), Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184), Enum.Material.Concrete)
      AddP(Vector3.new(42, 14, 42), CFrame.new(0, 82, 0), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Metal)
      AddP(Vector3.new(36, 4, 36), CFrame.new(0, 91, 0), Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85), Enum.Material.DiamondPlate)
      Engine.PerformInstantVisualRespawn(p, mapCenterCF * CFrame.new(0, 14, 85), true)

    elseif kind == "SCARY_HOUSE" then

      AddP(Vector3.new(104, 18, 92), CFrame.new(0, 50, 0), Color3.fromRGB(25, 18, 18), Enum.Material.Slate)

      light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

  -- Tum Polaria Ozel Morph / Boss / Silah Butonlari Icin 1:1 3D Replikasyon + P2P Animasyon Motoru:
  local function Polaria_ApplySpecialMorphOrWeapon(id, actor, fromP2P)
    local char = actor and actor.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not char or not hrp then return end

    local oldMorph = char:FindFirstChild("Polaria_Special3DMorph")
    if oldMorph then oldMorph:Destroy() end

    local morphFolder = Instance.new("Model", char)
    morphFolder.Name = "Polaria_Special3DMorph"

    local function WeldPart(sz, col, mat, offsetCF, shape)
      local pt = Instance.new("Part", morphFolder)
      pt.Size = sz
      pt.Color = col
      pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Neon
      if shape then pt.Shape = shape end
      pt.CanCollide = false
      pt.Massless = true
      pt.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * offsetCF
      local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", pt)
      w.Part0 = hrp
      w.Part1 = pt
      return pt
    end

    if id == 28 or id == 31 or id == 61 then -- Dual Ultima / Goner / Red Sword
      local col = (id == 61) and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or ((id == 31) and Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233))
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 7.5, 1.2), col, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(2.2, 1.5, -2.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), 0, 0))
      if id == 28 then
        WeldPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 7.5, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(-2.2, 1.5, -2.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), 0, 0))
      end
      if actor == LocalPlayer then
        Polaria_GiveCustomWeaponTool((id == 28 and "Dual Ultima") or (id == 31 and "Goner Blade") or "Red Sword", id, col, Vector3.new(0.4, 6, 1.1))
      end
    elseif id == 35 then -- Thomas the Tank Engine Morph
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(6.5, 6.5, 12), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0))
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(5.2, 5.2, 5.2), Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 230), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 1.2, -6.2), Enum.PartType.Ball)
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(1.8, 4.5, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 5.2, -4.5))
      if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 62 end
    elseif id == 46 then -- Master Hand
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(9, 3.5, 10), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 10, -4))
      for f = -2, 2 do
        WeldPart(Vector3.new(1.4, 2.2, 6), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(f * 1.8, 10.5, -10))
      end
    elseif id == 57 then -- Sin Dragon
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(8, 8, 18), Color3.fromRGB(129, 26, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 6, 2))
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(26, 1.2, 10), Color3.fromRGB(88, 28, 135), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 8, 2))
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(5, 5, 8), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 9, -8))
      if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 52; hum.JumpPower = 110 end
    elseif id == 67 or id == 68 or id == 77 or id == 88 or id == 89 then -- Omni God / Arc of Mystic / Worship / Grandosla / Stratosphere
      local auraCol = (id == 67 and Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)) or (id == 68 and Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)) or Color3.fromRGB(192, 132, 252)
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(14, 0.6, 14), auraCol, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, -2.6, 0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(18, 2.5, 1.2), auraCol, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 3.5, 2.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(25)))
      WeldPart(Vector3.new(18, 2.5, 1.2), auraCol, Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 3.5, 2.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-25)))
    elseif id == 86 then -- Laser Cat

    Engine.EmitP2PShockwavePulse(45)

  function Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(actionId, senderPlr, fromP2P)
    local id = tonumber(actionId) or 1
    local actor = senderPlr or LocalPlayer

    if not fromP2P then
      if id == 38 then
        local isAlreadyOn = (State.PrimadonPlayers and State.PrimadonPlayers[actor.Name] ~= nil)
        local sendId = isAlreadyOn and 138 or 38
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("POLARIA_ACTION", "ALL", tostring(sendId))
        Engine.Polaria_SetPrimadonMorph(actor, not isAlreadyOn, false)
        return
      else
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("POLARIA_ACTION", "ALL", tostring(id))
      end
    end

    if id >= 901 and id <= 904 then
      Engine.Polaria_ExecutePrimadonSkill(actor, id - 900, true)
      return
    end

    if id >= 201 and id <= 299 then
      Polaria_ExecuteReplicatedWeaponFire(actor, id - 200)
      return
    end

    -- SERVERPAGE (1..26)
    if id == 1 then -- UnAnchor
      for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
          obj.Anchored = false
        end
      end
      if not fromP2P then UI.SendPolariaNotification("UNANCHOR ALL", "Haritadaki tüm parçaların Anchor kilidi çözüldü (P2P)!") end
    elseif id == 2 or id == 76 then -- c00lkidd / c00lgui
      if actor == LocalPlayer then
        Engine.Polaria_OpenClassicSubGui("c00lgui", "c00lgui revival by c00lkidd", Color3.fromRGB(220, 20, 20), {
          { "c00lkidd Skybox", 101 }, { "c00lkidd Decal Spam", 102 },
          { "Flood Real Water", 19 }, { "Clear Terrain (Void)", 5 },
          { "Unanchor Map", 1 }, { "666 Apocalypse", 12 },
          { "Disco Server", 6 }, { "Bomb Rain", 8 },
          { "Kill Others", 4 }, { "Fling All", 26 },
          { "Tornado Vortex", 13 }, { "NDS Survival Map", 105 }
        })

      end
    elseif id == 3 then -- BasePlate
      Engine.Topk3k_SpawnBaseplate()
      if not fromP2P then UI.SendPolariaNotification("BASEPLATE", "Devasa yeni Baseplate oluşturuldu (P2P)!") end
    elseif id == 4 then -- KillAll
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= actor and Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(actor, p) and p.Character then
          local h = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if h then h.Health = 0 end
        end
      end
      if not fromP2P then UI.SendPolariaNotification("KILL ALL", "Tüm oyuncular öldürüldü (P2P)!") end

      if actor == LocalPlayer then
        Engine.GiveF3XBuildingTools(LocalPlayer)
        UI.SendPolariaNotification("F3X BUILDING TOOLS", "F3X Building Tools kuşanıldı (3D Move/Resize/Scale/Rotate + Canlı P2P)!")
      end
    elseif id == 101 then -- Custom Skybox
      Engine.Topk3k_SetSkybox("1365169983")
    elseif id == 102 or id == 83 then -- Decal Spam
      Engine.Topk3k_DecalSpam("1365169983")
      if not fromP2P then UI.SendPolariaNotification("DECAL SPAM", "Tüm harita yüzeylerine Decal Spam uygulandı (P2P)!") end
    else
      -- Diger tum Polaria script butonlari (Omni God, Arc of Mystic, Steve, Laser Cat, China, Stratosphere, Thomas, Sin Dragon vb.)
      Polaria_ApplySpecialMorphOrWeapon(id, actor, fromP2P)
      if not fromP2P then
        UI.SendPolariaNotification("POLARIA 3D MORPH // P2P", "3D Polaria modeli ve animasyonları tüm sunucuda replike edildi (ID #" .. tostring(id) .. ")!", 2.5)
      end
    end
  end

  function Engine.Topk3k_RunActionById(actionId, senderPlr, fromP2P)
    local id = tonumber(actionId) or 1
    if not fromP2P then
      BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("TOPK3K_ACTION", "ALL", tostring(id))
    end
    Engine.Polaria_RunActionById(id, senderPlr, true)
  end
end

local polariaScale = Instance.new("UIScale", P.top)
local function UpdatePolariaMobileScale()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local vpY = cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y or 800
if vpY < 440 then
polariaScale.Scale = 0.78
elseif vpY < 540 then
polariaScale.Scale = 0.88
else
polariaScale.Scale = 1.0
end
end
UpdatePolariaMobileScale()
if workspace.CurrentCamera then
workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(UpdatePolariaMobileScale)
end

end

P.exec.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
local code = P.input.Text
local assetId = code:match("require%s*%(?%s*(%d+)%s*%)?")
if assetId then
local success, result = pcall(function()
local objects = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. assetId)
local obj = objects[1]
if obj then
obj.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
if obj:IsA("ModuleScript") then
local modSuccess, modResult = pcall(function()
return require(obj)
end)
if not modSuccess then
wait (0.01)
end
end
end
end)
if success then
wait (0.01)
else
wait (0.01)
end
return
end
local success, result = pcall(function()
return loadstring(code)()
end)
if success then
wait (0.01)
else
wait (0.01)
end
end)

local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local MAX_CHARS = 10000000
local function append(text)
P.output.Text = P.output.Text .. tostring(text) .. "\n"
if #P.output.Text > MAX_CHARS then
P.output.Text = string.sub(P.output.Text, #P.output.Text - MAX_CHARS)
end
P.output.CursorPosition = #P.output.Text + 1
end
local function formatMessage(message, messageType)
if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageOutput then
return "" .. message
elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
return "" .. message
elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then
return "" .. message
else
return "" .. message
end
end
pcall(function()
LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message, messageType)
pcall(function()
append(formatMessage(tostring(message), messageType))
end)
end)
end)

    function Engine.TranslateAllUIRecursive()
        if not UI.ScreenGui then return end
        local isEn = (State.Language == "EN")
        for _, inst in ipairs(UI.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local tx = inst.Text or ""
                if isEn then
                    if ExactUiPairs[tx] then
                        inst.Text = ExactUiPairs[tx]
                    elseif string.find(tx, "Hedef Oyuncu: ") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(tx, "Hedef Oyuncu: ", "Target Player: "), "%(Değiştirmek İçin Tıkla%)", "(Click to Cycle)"), "%(Değiştir%)", "(Cycle)")
                    elseif string.find(tx, "Hedef: ") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(string.gsub(tx, "Hedef: ", "Target: "), "%(Değiştir%)", "(Cycle)")
                    elseif string.find(tx, "%[İZİNLİ %- KALDIR%]") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(tx, "%[İZİNLİ %- KALDIR%]", "[ALLOWED - REVOKE]")
                    elseif string.find(tx, "%[YASAKLI %- İZİN VER%]") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(tx, "%[YASAKLI %- İZİN VER%]", "[BLOCKED - ALLOW]")
                    end
                else
                    if ReverseUiPairs[tx] then
                        inst.Text = ReverseUiPairs[tx]
                    elseif string.find(tx, "Target Player: ") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(tx, "Target Player: ", "Hedef Oyuncu: "), "%(Click to Cycle%)", "(Değiştirmek İçin Tıkla)"), "%(Cycle%)", "(Değiştir)")
                    elseif string.find(tx, "Target: ") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(string.gsub(tx, "Target: ", "Hedef: "), "%(Cycle%)", "(Değiştir)")
                    elseif string.find(tx, "%[ALLOWED %- REVOKE%]") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(tx, "%[ALLOWED %- REVOKE%]", "[İZİNLİ - KALDIR]")
                    elseif string.find(tx, "%[BLOCKED %- ALLOW%]") then
                        inst.Text = string.gsub(tx, "%[BLOCKED %- ALLOW%]", "[YASAKLI - İZİN VER]")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local origApplyLang = UI.ApplyLanguageToUI
    UI.ApplyLanguageToUI = function()
        if origApplyLang then pcall(origApplyLang) end
        Engine.PurgeB1rktUIForNonOwner()
        if UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay then pcall(UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay) end
        if UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent then pcall(UI.RefreshServerInfoModalContent) end
        if UI.RebuildSideOwnerDrawer then pcall(UI.RebuildSideOwnerDrawer) end
        if UI.RefreshB1rktGuardList then pcall(UI.RefreshB1rktGuardList) end
        pcall(Engine.TranslateAllUIRecursive)
        if UI.TitleText then
            UI.TitleText.Text = "Berk's Admin v6.0"
        end
    end

    Engine.ExecuteCommandString = function(cmdStr)
        if UI and UI.ExecuteCommandString then
            return UI.ExecuteCommandString(cmdStr)
        end
    end
    Engine.ConvertCharacterToR6InPlace = Engine.ForceCharacterR6Visuals or function(plr)
        if Engine.ForceCharacterR6Visuals then return Engine.ForceCharacterR6Visuals(plr) end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(CommandList) do
        local lname = string.lower(c.Name or "")
        if lname ~= "" and not CommandRegistry[lname] then
            CommandRegistry[lname] = c
        end
        if type(c.Aliases) == "table" then
            for _, al in ipairs(c.Aliases) do
                local lal = string.lower(al or "")
                if lal ~= "" and not CommandRegistry[lal] then
                    CommandRegistry[lal] = c
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local origExecCmdString = UI.ExecuteCommandString
    UI.ExecuteCommandString = function(rawInput)
        local activePfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
        local clean = rawInput or ""
        if string.sub(clean, 1, #activePfx) == activePfx then
            clean = string.sub(clean, #activePfx + 1)
        elseif string.sub(clean, 1, 1) == ";" then
            clean = string.sub(clean, 2)
        end
        clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        local firstToken = string.lower(string.split(clean, " ")[1] or "")
        State.LastInvokedAlias = firstToken
        return origExecCmdString(rawInput)
    end
    Engine.ExecuteCommandString = UI.ExecuteCommandString

    pcall(function()
        local TextChatService = cloneref(game:GetService("TextChatService"))
        if TextChatService then
            TextChatService.SendingMessage:Connect(function(chatMsg)
                local msg = chatMsg and chatMsg.Text or ""
                local pfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
                local trimmed = string.gsub(msg, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
                if string.sub(trimmed, 1, #pfx) == pfx or string.sub(trimmed, 1, 1) == ";" then
                    UI.ExecuteCommandString(trimmed)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
