    -- 4. Full P2P Synchronization v6.0 (Rig-Matched Carrier Tracks, Real-Time Coordinate & Action Packets, Idempotent State Sync & 1s Continuous Heartbeat)
    State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords = {}
    State.P2PV6.LastStateChangeTime = {}

    local V6GlobalEnvCommands = {
        bloodeclipse = true,
        cyberstorm = true,
        toxicfog = true,
        auroraweather = true,
        lockdownserver = true
    }

    local V6InstantCommands = {
        swapplaces = true,
        chainblink = true,
        temprank = true,
        snapshotstate = true,
        restoresnapshot = true
    }

    function Engine.GenerateP2PTxId()
        State.P2PV6.LocalSeq = State.P2PV6.LocalSeq + 1
        return string.format("%d_%d_%d", LocalPlayer.UserId, math.floor(os.clock() * 1000), State.P2PV6.LocalSeq)
    end

    function Engine.RecordP2PTxId(txId)
        if not txId or txId == "" then return false end
        if State.P2PV6.ProcessedTxIds[txId] then
            State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Deduplicated = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Deduplicated + 1
            return false
        end
        State.P2PV6.ProcessedTxIds[txId] = os.clock()
        table.insert(State.P2PV6.ProcessedTxOrder, txId)
        if #State.P2PV6.ProcessedTxOrder > 600 then
            local oldest = table.remove(State.P2PV6.ProcessedTxOrder, 1)
            if oldest then State.P2PV6.ProcessedTxIds[oldest] = nil end
        end
        return true
    end

    function Engine.ResolveTransformationConflict(plr, newTransformType)
        if not plr then return end
        local key = plr.Name
        if newTransformType ~= "PRIMADON" and State.PrimadonPlayers and State.PrimadonPlayers[key] and Engine.Polaria_SetPrimadonMorph then
            pcall(function() Engine.Polaria_SetPrimadonMorph(plr, false, true) end)
        end
        local prev = State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[key]
        if prev and prev.Type and prev.Type ~= newTransformType and prev.Cleanup then
            pcall(prev.Cleanup)
        end
        State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[key] = { Type = newTransformType, Timestamp = os.clock() }
    end

    function Engine.RegisterTransformationCleanup(plr, transformType, cleanupFn)
        if not plr then return end
        State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[plr.Name] = {
            Type = transformType,
            Timestamp = os.clock(),
            Cleanup = cleanupFn
        }
    end

    function Engine.IsV6CommandActiveOnPlayer(cmdName, targetPlr)
        cmdName = string.lower(tostring(cmdName or ""))
        local pName = V6GlobalEnvCommands[cmdName] and "GLOBAL" or ((targetPlr and targetPlr.Name) or "GLOBAL")
        if cmdName == "godzilla" then
            local s = State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName]
            return (s and s.Active == true) or false
        elseif cmdName == "hallucinations" then
            local s = State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName]
            return (s and s.Active == true) or false
        elseif cmdName == "hallucinationshospital" then
            local s = State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName]
            return (s and s.Active == true) or false
        elseif cmdName == "van" then
            local s = State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName]
            return (s and s.Active == true) or false
        else
            local s = State.P2PV6.ActiveToggles[cmdName .. "_" .. pName]
            return (s and s.Active == true) or false
        end
    end

    -- Upgrade Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack:
    -- Strictly selects natively-looped stock animations matching Humanoid.RigType (R6 vs R15)
    -- and pins TimePosition = 0.05 in a 0.42s RenderStepped keep-alive loop so high-speed
    -- packets (cmdIndex >= 528 and 500,000..899,999) never finish early before replicating!
    local R6LoopedCarriers = {
        "rbxassetid://180435571", -- R6 Idle 1 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://180435792", -- R6 Idle 2 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://180426354", -- R6 Walk (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://180436334", -- R6 Climb (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://180436148", -- R6 Fall (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://182435998", -- R6 Dance 1 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://182436842", -- R6 Dance 2 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://182436935"  -- R6 Dance 3 (Natively Looped)
    }
    local R15LoopedCarriers = {
        "rbxassetid://507766388", -- R15 Idle 1 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507766666", -- R15 Idle 2 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507777826", -- R15 Walk (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507767714", -- R15 Run (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507765644", -- R15 Climb (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507767968", -- R15 Fall (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507771019", -- R15 Dance 1 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507776043", -- R15 Dance 2 (Natively Looped)
        "rbxassetid://507777268"  -- R15 Dance 3 (Natively Looped)
    }

    Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack = function(packetInt, carrierIndex)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
        local isR6 = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6)
        local carrierPool = isR6 and R6LoopedCarriers or R15LoopedCarriers

        State.P2PCarrierRingCursor = ((State.P2PCarrierRingCursor or 0) + (carrierIndex or 1)) % #carrierPool + 1
        local chosenAnimId = carrierPool[State.P2PCarrierRingCursor]
        local clampedPacketInt = math.clamp(math.floor(packetInt or 100), 1, 7999999)
        local encodedSpeed = 8.0 + (clampedPacketInt / 1024.0)

        pcall(function()
            local carrierAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
            carrierAnim.Name = "BerksP2PCarrier_" .. tostring(clampedPacketInt)
            carrierAnim.AnimationId = chosenAnimId
            local track = animator:LoadAnimation(carrierAnim)
            track.Looped = true
            track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            track:Play(0.01, 0.08, encodedSpeed)
            track:AdjustSpeed(encodedSpeed)

            local startHold = os.clock()
            local holdConn
            holdConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if os.clock() - startHold >= 0.42 or not char.Parent or not hum.Parent then
                    if holdConn then holdConn:Disconnect(); holdConn = nil end
                    pcall(function()
                        track:Stop(0.01)
                        carrierAnim:Destroy()
                    end)
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if not track.IsPlaying then
                        track:Play(0.01, 0.08, encodedSpeed)
                    end
                    track.TimePosition = 0.05
                    if math.abs(track.Speed - encodedSpeed) > 0.01 then
                        track:AdjustSpeed(encodedSpeed)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- Helper to resolve a player's P2P slot relative to LocalPlayer
    function Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(targetPlr)
        if not targetPlr then return 98 end
        if targetPlr == LocalPlayer then return 98 end
        local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(targetPlr.Name)
        return (slot and slot > 0) and slot or 98
    end

    -- Broadcast confirmed van coordinates & launch minibus across all P2P peers
    function Engine.BroadcastVanConfirmedP2P(targetPlayer, finalPos)
        if not targetPlayer or not finalPos then return end
        local targetSlot = Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(targetPlayer)
        local cx = math.clamp(math.floor(finalPos.X + 0.5) + 50000, 0, 99999)
        local cy = math.clamp(math.floor(finalPos.Y + 0.5) + 50000, 0, 99999)
        local cz = math.clamp(math.floor(finalPos.Z + 0.5) + 50000, 0, 99999)

        State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Sent = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Sent + 4
        Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(500000 + cx, 1)
        task.delay(0.05, function()
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(600000 + cy, 2)
        end)
        task.delay(0.10, function()
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(700000 + cz, 3)
        end)
        task.delay(0.16, function()
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(800000 + math.clamp(targetSlot, 0, 99), 4)
        end)
        task.delay(0.32, function()
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(800000 + math.clamp(targetSlot, 0, 99), 5)
        end)

        if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
            for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
                if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
                    task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "V6_VAN_CONFIRMED", targetPlayer.Name, finalPos)
                end
            end
        end

        if State.P2PV6.RelayEvent then
            pcall(function()
                State.P2PV6.RelayEvent:FireServer({
                    TxId = Engine.GenerateP2PTxId(),
                    Version = State.P2PV6.LocalSeq,
                    SenderUserId = LocalPlayer.UserId,
                    SenderName = LocalPlayer.Name,
                    CmdName = "van",
                    TargetName = targetPlayer.Name,
                    Args = {
                        targetPlayer.Name,
                        tostring(math.floor(finalPos.X + 0.5)),
                        tostring(math.floor(finalPos.Y + 0.5)),
                        tostring(math.floor(finalPos.Z + 0.5))
                    }
                })
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Broadcast Godzilla live attack action (Roar, Atomic Breath, Tail, Stomp, Bite) to all peers

                if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
                    task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "V6_SPECIAL", pkt)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Apply Idempotent STATE_ENSURE_ON / STATE_ENSURE_OFF from P2P peer
    function Engine.ApplyIncomingV6EnsureState(sender, cmdIndex, targetSlot, desiredActive)
        if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
        local resolvedCmd = CommandList[cmdIndex]
        if not resolvedCmd then return end
        RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, resolvedCmd.Name)
        local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
        if #targets == 0 then targets = { sender } end

        for _, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
            if Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, tPlr) then
                local currentlyActive = Engine.IsV6CommandActiveOnPlayer(resolvedCmd.Name, tPlr)
                if currentlyActive ~= desiredActive then
                    local stateKey = string.lower(resolvedCmd.Name) .. "_" .. tPlr.Name
                    State.P2PV6.LastStateChangeTime[stateKey] = os.clock()
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
                    State.CurrentP2PSender = sender
                    local prevAlias = State.LastInvokedAlias
                    State.LastInvokedAlias = desiredActive and resolvedCmd.Name or ("un" .. resolvedCmd.Name)
                    pcall(function()
                        local tChar = tPlr.Character
                        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        resolvedCmd.Action(tPlr, { tPlr.Name }, tHrp, tHum, Workspace.CurrentCamera)
                    end)
                    State.LastInvokedAlias = prevAlias
                    State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Decode V6 Special Packets (500,000 .. 899,999)
    function Engine.HandleIncomingV6SpecialPacket(sender, packetInt)
        if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
        RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, "P2P_V6")

        -- 500,000 .. 599,999: VAN_COORD_X
        if packetInt >= 500000 and packetInt <= 599999 then
            State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] = State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] or {}
            State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name].X = (packetInt - 500000) - 50000
            return
        -- 600,000 .. 699,999: VAN_COORD_Y
        elseif packetInt >= 600000 and packetInt <= 699999 then
            State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] = State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] or {}
            State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name].Y = (packetInt - 600000) - 50000
            return
        -- 700,000 .. 799,999: VAN_COORD_Z
        elseif packetInt >= 700000 and packetInt <= 799999 then
            State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] = State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] or {}
            State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name].Z = (packetInt - 700000) - 50000
            return
        -- 800,000 .. 800,099: VAN_START_CONFIRMED
        elseif packetInt >= 800000 and packetInt <= 800099 then
            local targetSlot = packetInt - 800000
            local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
            if #targets == 0 then targets = { sender } end
            task.spawn(function()
                local c = State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] or {}
                if not (c.X and c.Y and c.Z) then
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    c = State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[sender.Name] or {}
                end
                for _, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
                    if Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, tPlr) then
                        local existing = State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[tPlr.Name]
                        if not (existing and existing.Active and existing.StartTime and (os.clock() - existing.StartTime) < 3.0) then
                            local tHrp = tPlr.Character and tPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            local fallback = tHrp and (tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -110)).Position or Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
                            local dest = Vector3.new(c.X or fallback.X, c.Y or fallback.Y, c.Z or fallback.Z)
                            if Engine.StartCriminalMinibusSequence then
                                Engine.StartCriminalMinibusSequence(tPlr, dest)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return
        -- 810,000 .. 819,999: GODZILLA_ACTION
        elseif packetInt >= 810000 and packetInt <= 819999 then
            local rem = packetInt - 810000
            local actCode = math.floor(rem / 100)
            local targetSlot = rem % 100
            local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
            local tPlr = (targets and targets[1]) or sender
            local actMap = { [1] = "Roaring", [2] = "SpecialAttack", [3] = "TailAttack", [4] = "Stomp", [5] = "Bite" }
            local actName = actMap[actCode]
            if actName and tPlr then
                local gSession = State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[tPlr.Name]
                if not (gSession and gSession.Active) and Engine.ToggleGodzillaMorph then
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
                    pcall(function() Engine.ToggleGodzillaMorph(tPlr) end)
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
                    gSession = State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[tPlr.Name]
                end
                if gSession and gSession.Active and gSession.TriggerAction then
                    pcall(function() gSession.TriggerAction(actName, true) end)
                end
            end
            return
        -- 820,000 .. 829,999: HALLUCINATION_WAVE
        elseif packetInt >= 820000 and packetInt <= 829999 then
            local rem = packetInt - 820000
            local sc = math.floor(rem / 1000)
            local angleBucket = math.floor((rem % 1000) / 100)
            local targetSlot = rem % 100
            local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
            local tPlr = (targets and targets[1]) or sender
            if tPlr then
                local hSession = State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[tPlr.Name]
                if not (hSession and hSession.Active) and Engine.ToggleHallucinationsSystem then
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
                    pcall(function() Engine.ToggleHallucinationsSystem(tPlr, 1.0) end)
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
                    hSession = State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[tPlr.Name]
                end
                if hSession and hSession.Active and hSession.RunScenarioFromP2P then
                    pcall(function() hSession.RunScenarioFromP2P(sc, angleBucket) end)
                end
            end
            return
        -- 830,000 .. 839,999: V6_ABILITY_PULSE
        elseif packetInt >= 830000 and packetInt <= 839999 then
            local rem = packetInt - 830000
            local abilityCode = math.floor(rem / 100)
            local targetSlot = rem % 100
            local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
            local tPlr = (targets and targets[1]) or sender
            if tPlr and Engine.ExecuteV6AbilityVisualPulse then
                pcall(function() Engine.ExecuteV6AbilityVisualPulse(tPlr, abilityCode, true) end)
            end
            return
        -- 840,000 .. 849,999: STATE_ENSURE_ON (Idempotent Turn-ON & 1s Heartbeat Resync)
        elseif packetInt >= 840000 and packetInt <= 849999 then
            local rem = packetInt - 840000
            local cmdOffset = math.floor(rem / 100)
            local targetSlot = rem % 100
            Engine.ApplyIncomingV6EnsureState(sender, 520 + cmdOffset, targetSlot, true)
            return
        -- 850,000 .. 859,999: STATE_ENSURE_OFF (Idempotent Turn-OFF)
        elseif packetInt >= 850000 and packetInt <= 859999 then
            local rem = packetInt - 850000
            local cmdOffset = math.floor(rem / 100)
            local targetSlot = rem % 100
            Engine.ApplyIncomingV6EnsureState(sender, 520 + cmdOffset, targetSlot, false)
            return
        end
    end

    -- Hook Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed to decode V6 Special Packets & auto-expire SeenAnimationTracks
    local origProcessDecodedTrackSpeed = Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed
    Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed = function(plr, speedVal, trackObj)
        if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return end
        if type(speedVal) ~= "number" or speedVal < 8.0 or speedVal > 8500.0 then return end
        local packetInt = math.floor(((speedVal - 8.0) * 1024.0) + 0.5)
        if trackObj and State.SeenAnimationTracks then
            task.delay(0.46, function()
                if State.SeenAnimationTracks then
                    State.SeenAnimationTracks[trackObj] = nil
                end
            end)
        end
        if packetInt >= 500000 and packetInt <= 899999 then
            local dedupKey = plr.Name .. "_V6PKT_" .. tostring(packetInt)
            local now = tick()
            local win = (packetInt >= 840000 and packetInt <= 849999) and 0.45 or 0.22
            if State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] and (now - State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey]) < win then
                return
            end
            State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] = now
            State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Received = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Received + 1
            Engine.HandleIncomingV6SpecialPacket(plr, packetInt)
            return
        end
        if origProcessDecodedTrackSpeed then
            return origProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, speedVal, trackObj)
        end
    end

    -- Hook _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners for instant same-session / multi-client sync
    local origSharedListener = _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners and _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners[LocalPlayer.Name]
    if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
        _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners[LocalPlayer.Name] = function(senderPlr, packetType, a, b, c)
            if not senderPlr or senderPlr == LocalPlayer then return end
            if packetType == "V6_VAN_CONFIRMED" then
                local tPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(tostring(a or "")) or senderPlr
                if tPlr and typeof(b) == "Vector3" and Engine.StartCriminalMinibusSequence then
                    Engine.StartCriminalMinibusSequence(tPlr, b)
                end
                return
            elseif packetType == "V6_SPECIAL" and type(a) == "number" then
                Engine.HandleIncomingV6SpecialPacket(senderPlr, a)
                return
            end
            if origSharedListener then
                return origSharedListener(senderPlr, packetType, a, b, c)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Hook Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand to prevent premature chat/track race on V6 commands
    local origExecIncomingUniversal = Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand
    Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand = function(sender, cmdIndex, targetSlot, numericArg, customArgsTable)
        if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
        local resolvedCmd = CommandList[cmdIndex]
        if resolvedCmd and resolvedCmd.Name == "van" then
            local ax = tonumber(customArgsTable and customArgsTable[2])
            local ay = tonumber(customArgsTable and customArgsTable[3])
            local az = tonumber(customArgsTable and customArgsTable[4])
            if not (ax and ay and az) then
                -- Ignore premature trigger before sender confirms map coordinates!
                return
            end
        end
        if resolvedCmd and cmdIndex >= 528 and cmdIndex <= 580 and not V6InstantCommands[resolvedCmd.Name] then
            local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
            if #targets == 0 then targets = { sender } end
            local tPlr = targets[1]
            if tPlr then
                local stateKey = string.lower(resolvedCmd.Name) .. "_" .. tPlr.Name
                local lastChange = State.P2PV6.LastStateChangeTime[stateKey] or 0
                if (os.clock() - lastChange) < 0.9 then
                    return
                end
                State.P2PV6.LastStateChangeTime[stateKey] = os.clock()
            end
        end
        if origExecIncomingUniversal then
            return origExecIncomingUniversal(sender, cmdIndex, targetSlot, numericArg, customArgsTable)
        end
    end

    -- Hybrid Server Relay (Works automatically if BerksAdmin_ServerScript is present in ServerScriptService)
    local function InitHybridRelay()
        if not ReplicatedStorage then return end
        local relay = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_P2PRelay")
        if relay and relay:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            State.P2PV6.RelayEvent = relay
            relay.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
                if type(packet) ~= "table" then return end
                if packet.SenderUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then return end
                if not Engine.RecordP2PTxId(packet.TxId) then return end
                local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(packet.SenderUserId or 0) or Players:FindFirstChild(packet.SenderName or "")
                if not sender then return end
                local lastVer = State.P2PV6.PeerVersions[sender.UserId] or 0
                if packet.Version and packet.Version > lastVer + 1 and not packet.IsResync then
                    State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Resyncs = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Resyncs + 1
                end
                if packet.Version then
                    State.P2PV6.PeerVersions[sender.UserId] = packet.Version
                end
                State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Received = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Received + 1
                if packet.CmdName and CommandRegistry[string.lower(packet.CmdName)] then
                    local cmdObj = CommandRegistry[string.lower(packet.CmdName)]
                    local tPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(packet.TargetName or "") or sender
                    if cmdObj.Name == "van" then
                        local ax, ay, az = tonumber(packet.Args and packet.Args[2]), tonumber(packet.Args and packet.Args[3]), tonumber(packet.Args and packet.Args[4])
                        if not (ax and ay and az) then return end
                    end
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
                    State.CurrentP2PSender = sender
                    pcall(function()
                        local tChar = tPlr.Character
                        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        cmdObj.Action(tPlr, packet.Args or {}, tHrp, tHum, Workspace.CurrentCamera)
                    end)
                    State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
                    State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function() pcall(InitHybridRelay) end)
    if ReplicatedStorage then
        pcall(function()
            ReplicatedStorage.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                if ch.Name == "BerksAdmin_P2PRelay" then task.defer(InitHybridRelay) end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local origBroadcastUniversal = Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand
    Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand = function(resolvedCmd, args, targets, rawSelector)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P or not resolvedCmd then return end

        -- For ';van', do NOT broadcast prematurely before the user selects & confirms a map location!
        if resolvedCmd.Name == "van" then
            local ax, ay, az = tonumber(args and args[2]), tonumber(args and args[3]), tonumber(args and args[4])
            if ax and ay and az then
                local tPlr = (targets and targets[1]) or LocalPlayer
                Engine.BroadcastVanConfirmedP2P(tPlr, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az))
            end
            return
        end

        local txId = Engine.GenerateP2PTxId()
        Engine.RecordP2PTxId(txId)
        State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Sent = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Sent + 1
        local firstTargetPlr = (targets and targets[1]) or LocalPlayer
        local firstTarget = firstTargetPlr.Name

        if State.P2PV6.RelayEvent then
            pcall(function()
                State.P2PV6.RelayEvent:FireServer({
                    TxId = txId,
                    Version = State.P2PV6.LocalSeq,
                    SenderUserId = LocalPlayer.UserId,
                    SenderName = LocalPlayer.Name,
                    CmdName = resolvedCmd.Name,
                    TargetName = firstTarget,
                    Args = args
                })
            end)
        end

        -- For toggleable V6 commands (528..580), broadcast idempotent STATE_ENSURE_ON (840000) or STATE_ENSURE_OFF (850000)
        -- with automatic retry pulse so both screens stay 100% in sync and never invert toggle polarity!
        if resolvedCmd.CmdIndex and resolvedCmd.CmdIndex >= 528 and resolvedCmd.CmdIndex <= 580 and not V6InstantCommands[resolvedCmd.Name] then
            local cmdOffset = resolvedCmd.CmdIndex - 520
            local listTargets = (targets and #targets > 0) and targets or { LocalPlayer }
            for idx, tPlr in ipairs(listTargets) do
                local isNowOn = Engine.IsV6CommandActiveOnPlayer(resolvedCmd.Name, tPlr)
                local slot = Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(tPlr)
                local baseCode = isNowOn and 840000 or 850000
                local pkt = baseCode + (cmdOffset * 100) + math.clamp(slot, 0, 99)
                Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(pkt, idx)
                task.delay(0.20, function()
                    if Engine.IsV6CommandActiveOnPlayer(resolvedCmd.Name, tPlr) == isNowOn then
                        Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(pkt, idx + 2)
                    end
                end)
                if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
                    for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
                        if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
                            task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "V6_SPECIAL", pkt)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return
        end

        if origBroadcastUniversal then
            return origBroadcastUniversal(resolvedCmd, args, targets, rawSelector)
        end
    end

    -- 1-Second Continuous P2P State Heartbeat & Resync Loop:
    -- Periodically broadcasts active V6 transformations & toggles so any peer screen
    -- updates every second and never misses an active transformation or effect!
    task.spawn(function()
        local hbCursor = 0
        while task.wait(1.15) do
            pcall(function()
                local activePackets = {}
                for pName, gSess in pairs(State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions) do
                    if gSess and gSess.Active and gSess.InitiatedByLocal then
                        local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                        local c = CommandRegistry["godzilla"]
                        if p and c and c.CmdIndex then
                            table.insert(activePackets, 840000 + ((c.CmdIndex - 520) * 100) + Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(p))
                        end
                    end
                end
                for pName, hSess in pairs(State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions) do
                    if hSess and hSess.Active and hSess.InitiatedByLocal then
                        local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                        local c = CommandRegistry["hallucinations"]
                        if p and c and c.CmdIndex then
                            table.insert(activePackets, 840000 + ((c.CmdIndex - 520) * 100) + Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(p))
                        end
                    end
                end
                for pName, hpSess in pairs(State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions) do
                    if hpSess and hpSess.Active and hpSess.InitiatedByLocal then
                        local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                        local c = CommandRegistry["hallucinationshospital"]
                        if p and c and c.CmdIndex then
                            table.insert(activePackets, 840000 + ((c.CmdIndex - 520) * 100) + Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(p))
                        end
                    end
                end
                for toggleKey, st in pairs(State.P2PV6.ActiveToggles) do
                    if st and st.Active and st.InitiatedByLocal and st.CmdName then
                        local c = CommandRegistry[string.lower(st.CmdName)]
                        local p = (st.TargetName == "GLOBAL") and LocalPlayer or Players:FindFirstChild(st.TargetName or "")
                        if p and c and c.CmdIndex and c.CmdIndex >= 528 and c.CmdIndex <= 580 then
                            table.insert(activePackets, 840000 + ((c.CmdIndex - 520) * 100) + Engine.EncodeTargetPlayerSlot(p))
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #activePackets > 0 then
                    hbCursor = (hbCursor % #activePackets) + 1
                    local pkt = activePackets[hbCursor]
                    if pkt then
                        State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Resyncs = State.P2PV6.PacketStats.Resyncs + 1
                        Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(pkt, (hbCursor % 6) + 1)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    -- Disconnect Recovery
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leavingPlr)
        if not leavingPlr then return end
        local pName = leavingPlr.Name
        State.P2PV6.PeerVersions[leavingPlr.UserId] = nil
        State.P2PV6.PendingVanCoords[pName] = nil
        if State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[pName] and State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[pName].Cleanup then
            pcall(State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[pName].Cleanup)
        end
        State.P2PV6.ConflictGroups[pName] = nil
        if State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName] and State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName].Cleanup then
            pcall(State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName].Cleanup)
        end
        if State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName] and State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName].Cleanup then
            pcall(State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName].Cleanup)
        end
        if State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName] and State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName].Cleanup then
            pcall(State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName].Cleanup)
        end
        if State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName] and State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName].Cleanup then
            pcall(State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName].Cleanup)
        end
    end)

    -- ========================================================================
    -- 5. NEW COMMAND: VAN ("van <isim>") — CRIMINAL MINIBUS TRANSPORT
    -- Masked Criminal Group + Black Minibus with 6 Interior Seats + Map Click
    -- Destination (Full PC + Mobile Touch Support) + Real-Time Frame-Locked P2P
    -- + Constant 50 Speed + Wall-Pass Noclip + Safe Drop-off
    -- ========================================================================
    function Engine.Build3DCriminalNPCModel(parentModel, crimName, suitColor, maskColor, accentColor)
        local npc = {}
        local function mkPart(name, size, col, mat, shape)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = crimName .. "_" .. name
            p.Size = size
            p.Color = col
            p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CastShadow = true
            if shape then p.Shape = shape end
            p.Parent = parentModel
            return p
        end

        npc.Torso = mkPart("Torso", Vector3.new(2.0, 2.0, 1.0), suitColor, Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.Vest = mkPart("TacticalVest", Vector3.new(2.08, 1.45, 1.12), Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26), Enum.Material.Cobblestone)
        npc.Chain = mkPart("NeckBandana", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.35, 1.14), accentColor, Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.Head = mkPart("SkiMaskHead", Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 1.3), maskColor, Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.EyeSlit = mkPart("EyeSlit", Vector3.new(1.02, 0.28, 0.12), Color3.fromRGB(235, 198, 165), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        npc.Glasses = mkPart("DarkGlasses", Vector3.new(1.12, 0.32, 0.18), Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 16), Enum.Material.Glass)
        npc.Beanie = mkPart("BeanieTop", Vector3.new(1.36, 0.42, 1.36), Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22), Enum.Material.Fabric)

        npc.LeftArm = mkPart("LeftArm", Vector3.new(0.95, 1.9, 0.95), suitColor, Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.RightArm = mkPart("RightArm", Vector3.new(0.95, 1.9, 0.95), suitColor, Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.GloveL = mkPart("GloveL", Vector3.new(0.98, 0.45, 0.98), Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        npc.GloveR = mkPart("GloveR", Vector3.new(0.98, 0.45, 0.98), Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

        npc.LeftLeg = mkPart("LeftLeg", Vector3.new(0.95, 1.9, 0.95), Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 34), Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.RightLeg = mkPart("RightLeg", Vector3.new(0.95, 1.9, 0.95), Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 34), Enum.Material.Fabric)
        npc.BootL = mkPart("BootL", Vector3.new(1.0, 0.5, 1.25), Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        npc.BootR = mkPart("BootR", Vector3.new(1.0, 0.5, 1.25), Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

        function npc.SetPose(rootCF, walkPhase, armRaiseDeg, isSitting)
            local swing = math.sin(walkPhase or 0) * math.rad(34)
            local armPitch = math.rad(armRaiseDeg or 0)
            local bobY = isSitting and 0 or math.abs(math.cos(walkPhase or 0)) * 0.16
            local tCF = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, bobY, 0)

            npc.Torso.CFrame = tCF
            npc.Vest.CFrame = tCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, 0)
            npc.Chain.CFrame = tCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.88, 0)

            local hCF = tCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.65, 0)
            npc.Head.CFrame = hCF
            npc.EyeSlit.CFrame = hCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.08, -0.62)
            npc.Glasses.CFrame = hCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -0.66)
            npc.Beanie.CFrame = hCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.56, 0)

            local lArmCF = tCF * CFrame.new(-1.48, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(armPitch - (isSitting and 0 or swing * 0.65), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
            local rArmCF = tCF * CFrame.new(1.48, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(armPitch + (isSitting and 0 or swing * 0.65), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
            npc.LeftArm.CFrame = lArmCF
            npc.RightArm.CFrame = rArmCF
            npc.GloveL.CFrame = lArmCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.82, 0)
            npc.GloveR.CFrame = rArmCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.82, 0)

            if isSitting then
                local lLegSit = tCF * CFrame.new(-0.52, -0.85, -0.75) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(88), 0, 0)
                local rLegSit = tCF * CFrame.new(0.52, -0.85, -0.75) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(88), 0, 0)
                npc.LeftLeg.CFrame = lLegSit
                npc.RightLeg.CFrame = rLegSit
                npc.BootL.CFrame = lLegSit * CFrame.new(0, -0.85, -0.12)
                npc.BootR.CFrame = rLegSit * CFrame.new(0, -0.85, -0.12)
            else
                local lLegWalk = tCF * CFrame.new(-0.52, -1.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.95, 0)
                local rLegWalk = tCF * CFrame.new(0.52, -1.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.95, 0)
                npc.LeftLeg.CFrame = lLegWalk
                npc.RightLeg.CFrame = rLegWalk
                npc.BootL.CFrame = lLegWalk * CFrame.new(0, -0.85, -0.12)
                npc.BootR.CFrame = rLegWalk * CFrame.new(0, -0.85, -0.12)
            end
        end

        return npc
    end

    local function StartCriminalMinibusSequence(targetPlayer, destPos)
        if not targetPlayer then return end
        local pName = targetPlayer.Name
        if State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName] and State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName].Cleanup then
            pcall(State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName].Cleanup)
        end

        local tChar = targetPlayer.Character
        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not tChar or not tHrp or not tHum then return end

        local session = {
            Active = true,
            StartTime = os.clock(),
            Connections = {},
            SavedCollide = {}
        }
        State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName] = session

        for _, p in ipairs(tChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                session.SavedCollide[p] = p.CanCollide
            end
        end

        local vanModel = Instance.new("Model")
        vanModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_CriminalMinibus_" .. pName
        vanModel.Parent = Workspace
        session.Model = vanModel

        -- Destination Marker Beacon on the Map
        local destMarker = Instance.new("Part")
        destMarker.Name = "MinibusDropoffBeacon"
        destMarker.Size = Vector3.new(7, 0.4, 7)
        destMarker.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0))
        destMarker.Anchored = true
        destMarker.CanCollide = false
        destMarker.Color = Color3.fromRGB(16, 185, 129)
        destMarker.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        destMarker.Transparency = 0.25
        destMarker.Parent = vanModel
        Instance.new("CylinderMesh", destMarker)

        local destBeam = Instance.new("Part")
        destBeam.Name = "MinibusDropoffPillar"
        destBeam.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 45, 1.2)
        destBeam.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 22.5, 0))
        destBeam.Anchored = true
        destBeam.CanCollide = false
        destBeam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153)
        destBeam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        destBeam.Transparency = 0.55
        destBeam.Parent = vanModel
        Instance.new("CylinderMesh", destBeam)

        local vanParts = {}
        local function addMinibusPart(name, size, offsetCF, col, mat, trans, shape)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = name
            p.Size = size
            p.Color = col
            p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Transparency = trans or 0
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CastShadow = true
            if shape then p.Shape = shape end
            p.Parent = vanModel
            table.insert(vanParts, { Part = p, Offset = offsetCF })
            return p
        end

        local bodyBlack = Color3.fromRGB(22, 25, 32)
        local trimSilver = Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184)
        local crimsonStripe = Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28)
        local leatherSeat = Color3.fromRGB(38, 24, 24)

        -- Minibus Chassis, Roof, Bumpers & Side Trim
        local floorPart = addMinibusPart("MinibusFloor", Vector3.new(8.8, 0.8, 18.5), CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0), bodyBlack, Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("MinibusRoof", Vector3.new(8.8, 0.6, 16.5), CFrame.new(0, 7.8, 0.8), bodyBlack, Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("RoofRackL", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.35, 14.0), CFrame.new(-3.6, 8.25, 1.0), trimSilver, Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("RoofRackR", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.35, 14.0), CFrame.new(3.6, 8.25, 1.0), trimSilver, Enum.Material.Metal)

        -- Lower Walls + Tinted Panoramic Minibus Windows (so seated criminals & player are visible inside!)
        addMinibusPart("LeftWallLower", Vector3.new(0.5, 3.0, 15.5), CFrame.new(-4.15, 3.1, 1.2), bodyBlack, Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("RightWallLower", Vector3.new(0.5, 3.0, 15.5), CFrame.new(4.15, 3.1, 1.2), bodyBlack, Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("LeftWindowGlass", Vector3.new(0.25, 2.9, 14.8), CFrame.new(-4.15, 6.05, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.52)
        addMinibusPart("RightWindowGlass", Vector3.new(0.25, 2.9, 14.8), CFrame.new(4.15, 6.05, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.52)
        addMinibusPart("LeftStripe", Vector3.new(0.58, 0.45, 15.8), CFrame.new(-4.15, 4.35, 1.0), crimsonStripe, Enum.Material.Neon)
        addMinibusPart("RightStripe", Vector3.new(0.58, 0.45, 15.8), CFrame.new(4.15, 4.35, 1.0), crimsonStripe, Enum.Material.Neon)

        -- Front Hood, Grille, Windshield, Headlights & Steering Wheel
        addMinibusPart("FrontHood", Vector3.new(8.8, 3.2, 3.2), CFrame.new(0, 3.1, -7.6), bodyBlack, Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("FrontGrille", Vector3.new(5.6, 1.8, 0.25), CFrame.new(0, 2.8, -9.22), trimSilver, Enum.Material.DiamondPlate)
        addMinibusPart("FrontBumper", Vector3.new(9.1, 0.9, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, -9.35), Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22), Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("RearBumper", Vector3.new(9.1, 0.9, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 9.35), Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22), Enum.Material.Metal)
        addMinibusPart("Windshield", Vector3.new(8.0, 3.1, 0.35), CFrame.new(0, 6.0, -6.8) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(16), 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.42)
        addMinibusPart("Dashboard", Vector3.new(8.0, 1.2, 1.6), CFrame.new(0, 3.8, -6.1), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addMinibusPart("SteeringWheel", Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 0.25), CFrame.new(-2.1, 4.3, -5.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

        local hlL = addMinibusPart("HeadlightL", Vector3.new(1.3, 0.8, 0.25), CFrame.new(-3.1, 3.1, -9.22), Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195), Enum.Material.Neon)
        local hlR = addMinibusPart("HeadlightR", Vector3.new(1.3, 0.8, 0.25), CFrame.new(3.1, 3.1, -9.22), Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addMinibusPart("TaillightL", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.8, 0.25), CFrame.new(-3.5, 3.1, 9.22), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addMinibusPart("TaillightR", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.8, 0.25), CFrame.new(3.5, 3.1, 9.22), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon)

        for _, hl in ipairs({ hlL, hlR }) do
            local sp = Instance.new("SpotLight")
            sp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 210)
            sp.Brightness = 3
            sp.Range = 48
            sp.Angle = 60
            sp.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
            sp.Parent = hl
        end

        -- 6 Interior Minibus Seats (2 Front + 2 Middle Row + 2 Rear Row)
        local seatPositions = {
            { Name = "DriverSeat", Pos = Vector3.new(-2.1, 2.1, -3.8) },
            { Name = "CoDriverSeat", Pos = Vector3.new(2.1, 2.1, -3.8) },
            { Name = "MidRowSeatL", Pos = Vector3.new(-2.2, 2.1, 0.2) },
            { Name = "MidRowSeatR", Pos = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.1, 0.2) },
            { Name = "RearRowSeatL_Player", Pos = Vector3.new(-2.2, 2.1, 4.2) },
            { Name = "RearRowSeatR", Pos = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.1, 4.2) }
        }
        for _, sInfo in ipairs(seatPositions) do
            addMinibusPart(sInfo.Name .. "_Cushion", Vector3.new(2.3, 0.55, 2.2), CFrame.new(sInfo.Pos), leatherSeat, Enum.Material.Fabric)
            addMinibusPart(sInfo.Name .. "_Backrest", Vector3.new(2.3, 2.4, 0.45), CFrame.new(sInfo.Pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.35, 0.9)), leatherSeat, Enum.Material.Fabric)
        end

        -- 4 Rotating Wheels with Rims
        local wheels = {}
        local wheelOffsets = {
            Vector3.new(-4.35, 1.2, -5.8),
            Vector3.new(4.35, 1.2, -5.8),
            Vector3.new(-4.35, 1.2, 5.6),
            Vector3.new(4.35, 1.2, 5.6)
        }
        for idx, wOff in ipairs(wheelOffsets) do
            local w = Instance.new("Part")
            w.Name = "MinibusWheel_" .. idx
            w.Size = Vector3.new(1.15, 2.9, 2.9)
            w.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16)
            w.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            w.Anchored = true
            w.CanCollide = false
            w.Parent = vanModel
            local m = Instance.new("CylinderMesh", w)
            m.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            table.insert(wheels, { Part = w, Offset = wOff })
        end

        -- Rear Double Doors
        local doorL = Instance.new("Part")
        doorL.Name = "MinibusRearDoorL"
        doorL.Size = Vector3.new(4.1, 6.0, 0.45)
        doorL.Color = bodyBlack
        doorL.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        doorL.Anchored = true
        doorL.CanCollide = false
        doorL.Parent = vanModel

        local doorR = doorL:Clone()
        doorR.Name = "MinibusRearDoorR"
        doorR.Parent = vanModel

        -- Build the Group of 5 Masked Criminals!
        local crimDriver = Engine.Build3DCriminalNPCModel(vanModel, "Criminal_Driver", Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 32), Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28))
        local crimCoDriver = Engine.Build3DCriminalNPCModel(vanModel, "Criminal_CoDriver", Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 38), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25), Color3.fromRGB(217, 119, 6))
        local crimGuardL = Engine.Build3DCriminalNPCModel(vanModel, "Criminal_EscortL", Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 36), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38))
        local crimGuardR = Engine.Build3DCriminalNPCModel(vanModel, "Criminal_EscortR", Color3.fromRGB(28, 24, 32), Color3.fromRGB(18, 15, 22), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248))
        local crimRearBoss = Engine.Build3DCriminalNPCModel(vanModel, "Criminal_RearBoss", Color3.fromRGB(35, 22, 26), Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16), Color3.fromRGB(234, 179, 8))

        -- Sounds
        local engineSnd = Instance.new("Sound")
        engineSnd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9120693399"
        engineSnd.Volume = 1.2
        engineSnd.PlaybackSpeed = 0.85
        engineSnd.Looped = true
        engineSnd.Parent = floorPart
        pcall(function() engineSnd:Play() end)

        local doorOpenAngle = 0
        local wheelSpin = 0
        local currentVanCF = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 38)

        local function updateMinibusTransform(vanCF, dt)
            currentVanCF = vanCF
            wheelSpin = wheelSpin + (dt or 0.016) * 16
            for _, item in ipairs(vanParts) do
                item.Part.CFrame = vanCF * item.Offset
            end
            for _, w in ipairs(wheels) do
                w.Part.CFrame = vanCF * CFrame.new(w.Offset) * CFrame.Angles(wheelSpin, 0, math.rad(90))
            end
            local hingeL = vanCF * CFrame.new(-4.2, 4.4, 9.05)
            local hingeR = vanCF * CFrame.new(4.2, 4.4, 9.05)
            doorL.CFrame = hingeL * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-doorOpenAngle), 0) * CFrame.new(2.05, 0, 0)
            doorR.CFrame = hingeR * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(doorOpenAngle), 0) * CFrame.new(-2.05, 0, 0)

            -- Keep Driver, Co-Driver, and Rear Boss seated inside their minibus seats at all times
            crimDriver.SetPose(vanCF * CFrame.new(-2.1, 3.35, -3.95), 0, 48, true)
            crimCoDriver.SetPose(vanCF * CFrame.new(2.1, 3.35, -3.95), 0, 15, true)
            crimRearBoss.SetPose(vanCF * CFrame.new(2.2, 3.35, 4.05), 0, 10, true)
        end

        session.Cleanup = function()
            session.Active = false
            for _, c in ipairs(session.Connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            session.Connections = {}
            if vanModel and vanModel.Parent then pcall(function() vanModel:Destroy() end) end
            if tChar and tChar.Parent then
                for part, origCanCollide in pairs(session.SavedCollide) do
                    if part and part.Parent then
                        pcall(function() part.CanCollide = origCanCollide end)
                    end
                end
            end
            if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    tHrp.Anchored = false
                    tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    tHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
            if tHum and tHum.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    tHum.Sit = false
                    tHum.PlatformStand = false
                    tHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                end)
            end
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local victimStartCF = tHrp.CFrame
            local stopPickupCF = victimStartCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, 13.5)
            local spawnCF = victimStartCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, 46)

            -- Hold player briefly as minibus pulls up
            tHrp.Anchored = true

            -- PHASE 1: Minibus pulls up behind the player at max 50 speed with smooth braking (32.5 studs)
            local pullUpDist = (stopPickupCF.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude
            local pullUpTraveled = 0
            local pullUpSpeed = 18
            while pullUpTraveled < pullUpDist and session.Active do
                local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                local rem = pullUpDist - pullUpTraveled
                if rem < 16 then
                    local brakeTarget = math.clamp(50 * (rem / 16), 4, 50)
                    pullUpSpeed = pullUpSpeed + (brakeTarget - pullUpSpeed) * math.clamp(dt * 10, 0, 1)
                else
                    pullUpSpeed = math.min(50, pullUpSpeed + 45 * dt)
                end
                pullUpTraveled = math.min(pullUpDist, pullUpTraveled + pullUpSpeed * dt)
                local alpha = pullUpDist > 0.01 and (pullUpTraveled / pullUpDist) or 1
                local cf = spawnCF:Lerp(stopPickupCF, alpha)
                wheelSpin = wheelSpin + dt * (pullUpSpeed * 0.35)
                if engineSnd and engineSnd.Parent then
                    engineSnd.PlaybackSpeed = 0.72 + (pullUpSpeed / 50) * 0.35
                end
                updateMinibusTransform(cf, 0)
                crimGuardL.SetPose(cf * CFrame.new(-2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 12, true)
                crimGuardR.SetPose(cf * CFrame.new(2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 12, true)
            end

            -- PHASE 2: Rear doors swing open & 2 Criminal Escorts step out to grab player (1.05s)
            PlayUiSound("drawerOpen")
            local t1 = os.clock()
            while os.clock() - t1 < 1.05 and session.Active do
                local alpha = (os.clock() - t1) / 1.05
                doorOpenAngle = math.clamp(alpha * 1.4, 0, 1) * 115
                updateMinibusTransform(stopPickupCF, 0)
                local gLStart = stopPickupCF * CFrame.new(-1.8, 2.5, 10.5)
                local gRStart = stopPickupCF * CFrame.new(1.8, 2.5, 10.5)
                local gLEnd = victimStartCF * CFrame.new(-2.1, 0, 0.8)
                local gREnd = victimStartCF * CFrame.new(2.1, 0, 0.8)
                crimGuardL.SetPose(gLStart:Lerp(gLEnd, alpha), alpha * 15, 78, false)
                crimGuardR.SetPose(gRStart:Lerp(gREnd, alpha), alpha * 15 + math.pi, 78, false)
                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            end

            -- PHASE 3: Criminals escort player into the rear passenger seat & sit down themselves (0.95s)
            local rearPlayerSeatOffset = CFrame.new(-2.2, 3.25, 4.05)
            local t2 = os.clock()
            while os.clock() - t2 < 0.95 and session.Active do
                local alpha = (os.clock() - t2) / 0.95
                updateMinibusTransform(stopPickupCF, 0)
                local seatWorldCF = stopPickupCF * rearPlayerSeatOffset
                tHrp.CFrame = victimStartCF:Lerp(seatWorldCF, alpha)
                tHum.Sit = true
                local gLEnd = victimStartCF * CFrame.new(-2.1, 0, 0.8)
                local gREnd = victimStartCF * CFrame.new(2.1, 0, 0.8)
                local gLSeat = stopPickupCF * CFrame.new(-2.2, 3.35, 0.05)
                local gRSeat = stopPickupCF * CFrame.new(2.2, 3.35, 0.05)
                crimGuardL.SetPose(gLEnd:Lerp(gLSeat, alpha), alpha * 14, 45, alpha > 0.75)
                crimGuardR.SetPose(gREnd:Lerp(gRSeat, alpha), alpha * 14 + math.pi, 45, alpha > 0.75)
                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            end

            -- Close rear doors & activate full Noclip (Wall-Pass) for Player + Minibus
            doorOpenAngle = 0
            local noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                if not session.Active or not tChar or not tChar.Parent then return end
                for _, part in ipairs(tChar:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
                if tHrp and tHrp.Parent and targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then
                    tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    tHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    tHrp.CFrame = currentVanCF * rearPlayerSeatOffset
                end
                if tHum and tHum.Parent then
                    tHum.Sit = true
                end
            end)
            table.insert(session.Connections, noclipConn)

            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    UI.Tr("🚐 SUÇLU MİNİBÜSÜ (SABİT 50 HIZ & P2P SENKRON)", "🚐 CRIMINAL MINIBUS (CONSTANT 50 SPEED & P2P SYNC)"),
                    UI.Tr("Minibüs kalkış yapıyor! Sabit 50 hızla duvarlardan geçerek onaylanan konuma gidiliyor...", "Minibus departing! Cruising at a constant 50 speed through walls toward the confirmed destination..."),
                    Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
                    4.0
                )
            end

            -- PHASE 4: Drive straight through walls/obstacles to the confirmed destination!
            -- Constant 50 studs/sec cruising speed regardless of total distance, with smooth launch acceleration & arrival braking
            -- + Real-Time Frame Lock between both screens!
            local startDrivePos = stopPickupCF.Position
            local endDrivePos = destPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
            local driveVec = endDrivePos - startDrivePos
            local totalDist = math.max(0.1, driveVec.Magnitude)
            local driveDirUnit = driveVec.Unit
            local flatDelta = Vector3.new(endDrivePos.X - startDrivePos.X, 0, endDrivePos.Z - startDrivePos.Z)
            local forwardDir = (flatDelta.Magnitude > 0.5) and flatDelta.Unit or stopPickupCF.LookVector
            local startDriveCF = CFrame.lookAt(startDrivePos, startDrivePos + forwardDir)
            local endDriveCF = CFrame.lookAt(endDrivePos, endDrivePos + forwardDir)

            local CONSTANT_CRUISE_SPEED = 50.0 -- Always 50 studs/s cruise speed!
            local ACCEL_RATE = 42.0            -- Smooth launch acceleration (0 -> 50 in ~1.2s)
            local BRAKE_ZONE = math.min(28.0, totalDist * 0.45)
            local traveledDist = 0.0
            local currentSpeed = 2.0

            while traveledDist < totalDist and session.Active do
                local dt = math.clamp(RunService.RenderStepped:Wait(), 0.001, 0.1)
                local remainingDist = totalDist - traveledDist

                if remainingDist <= BRAKE_ZONE and BRAKE_ZONE > 0.1 then
                    local brakeRatio = math.clamp(remainingDist / BRAKE_ZONE, 0, 1)
                    local targetBrakeSpeed = math.clamp(CONSTANT_CRUISE_SPEED * math.sqrt(brakeRatio), 3.5, CONSTANT_CRUISE_SPEED)
                    currentSpeed = math.min(currentSpeed + ACCEL_RATE * dt, targetBrakeSpeed)
                else
                    currentSpeed = math.min(CONSTANT_CRUISE_SPEED, currentSpeed + ACCEL_RATE * dt)
                end

                traveledDist = math.min(totalDist, traveledDist + currentSpeed * dt)

                -- Real-Time Peer Frame-Lock: if targetPlayer is another P2P peer whose client is replicating their HRP along the drive path,
                -- blend our traveledDist tightly with their live replicated HRP position so both screens match every single frame!
                if targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer and tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                    local peerVanCenter = (CFrame.lookAt(tHrp.Position, tHrp.Position + forwardDir) * rearPlayerSeatOffset:Inverse()).Position
                    local peerProjDist = (peerVanCenter - startDrivePos):Dot(driveDirUnit)
                    if peerProjDist > 2.5 and peerProjDist <= totalDist + 5 and math.abs(peerProjDist - traveledDist) < 85 then
                        traveledDist = math.clamp(traveledDist + (peerProjDist - traveledDist) * math.clamp(dt * 18, 0.2, 1.0), 0, totalDist)
                    end
                end

                local linearAlpha = traveledDist / totalDist
                local curCF = startDriveCF:Lerp(endDriveCF, linearAlpha)

                wheelSpin = wheelSpin + dt * (currentSpeed * 0.35)
                if engineSnd and engineSnd.Parent then
                    engineSnd.PlaybackSpeed = 0.72 + (currentSpeed / CONSTANT_CRUISE_SPEED) * 0.38
                end
                updateMinibusTransform(curCF, 0)

                crimGuardL.SetPose(curCF * CFrame.new(-2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 10, true)
                crimGuardR.SetPose(curCF * CFrame.new(2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 10, true)
                if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                    tHrp.CFrame = curCF * rearPlayerSeatOffset
                end
            end

            -- PHASE 5: Arrive at marked destination, open rear doors & drop off player safely!
            PlayUiSound("drawerOpen")
            if noclipConn then pcall(function() noclipConn:Disconnect() end) end

            local t4 = os.clock()
            while os.clock() - t4 < 0.85 and session.Active do
                local alpha = (os.clock() - t4) / 0.85
                doorOpenAngle = alpha * 115
                updateMinibusTransform(endDriveCF, 0)
                crimGuardL.SetPose(endDriveCF * CFrame.new(-2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 10, true)
                crimGuardR.SetPose(endDriveCF * CFrame.new(2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 10, true)
                local seatWorld = endDriveCF * rearPlayerSeatOffset
                local dropWorld = CFrame.lookAt(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0), destPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0) + forwardDir)
                if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                    tHrp.CFrame = seatWorld:Lerp(dropWorld, alpha)
                end
                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            end

            -- Safely restore player collision & standing state at destination
            if tChar and tChar.Parent then
                for part, origCanCollide in pairs(session.SavedCollide) do
                    if part and part.Parent then
                        pcall(function() part.CanCollide = origCanCollide end)
                    end
                end
            end
            if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                tHrp.Anchored = false
                tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                tHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                tHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0), destPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0) + forwardDir)
            end
            if tHum and tHum.Parent then
                tHum.Sit = false
                tHum.PlatformStand = false
                pcall(function() tHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
            end

            if destMarker and destMarker.Parent then destMarker:Destroy() end
            if destBeam and destBeam.Parent then destBeam:Destroy() end

            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    UI.Tr("✅ HEDEF NOKTAYA BIRAKILDINIZ", "✅ DROPPED OFF AT DESTINATION"),
                    UI.Tr("Suçlu minibüsü sizi onayladığınız konuma sabit 50 hızla getirip güvenli şekilde bıraktı!", "The criminal minibus safely dropped you off at your confirmed destination!"),
                    Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
                    3.5
                )
            end

            -- PHASE 6: Criminals close doors and accelerate smoothly up to 50 speed as they drive away (55 studs)
            local driveAwayCF = endDriveCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -55)
            local awayDist = 55.0
            local awayTraveled = 0.0
            local awaySpeed = 2.0
            while awayTraveled < awayDist and session.Active do
                local dt = math.clamp(RunService.RenderStepped:Wait(), 0.001, 0.1)
                awaySpeed = math.min(50.0, awaySpeed + 42.0 * dt)
                awayTraveled = math.min(awayDist, awayTraveled + awaySpeed * dt)
                local alpha = awayTraveled / awayDist
                doorOpenAngle = math.max(0, (1 - alpha * 3.0) * 115)
                local curCF = endDriveCF:Lerp(driveAwayCF, alpha)
                wheelSpin = wheelSpin + dt * (awaySpeed * 0.35)
                if engineSnd and engineSnd.Parent then
                    engineSnd.PlaybackSpeed = 0.72 + (awaySpeed / 50.0) * 0.38
                end
                updateMinibusTransform(curCF, 0)
                crimGuardL.SetPose(curCF * CFrame.new(-2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 10, true)
                crimGuardR.SetPose(curCF * CFrame.new(2.2, 3.35, 0.05), 0, 10, true)
            end

            session.Cleanup()
            State.P2PV6.MinibusSessions[pName] = nil
        end)
    end
    Engine.StartCriminalMinibusSequence = StartCriminalMinibusSequence

    function Engine.ExecuteCriminalMinibusTransport(targetPlayer, args)
        targetPlayer = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local tChar = targetPlayer.Character
        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHrp then return end

        -- If explicit coordinates were passed in args (e.g. ';van me 100 10 200' or Hybrid Relay), run immediately
        local ax, ay, az = tonumber(args and args[2]), tonumber(args and args[3]), tonumber(args and args[4])
        if ax and ay and az then
            StartCriminalMinibusSequence(targetPlayer, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az))
            return
        end

        -- If triggered from P2P without explicit coordinates (e.g. premature chat hook), wait for VAN_START_CONFIRMED!
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            return
        end

        -- ====================================================================
        -- 3-STAGE TACTICAL TOP-DOWN MAP -> CLOSE-UP STREET VIEW -> CONFIRMATION
        -- WITH FULL MOBILE TOUCH + PC MOUSE/KEYBOARD SUPPORT!
        -- 1. OVERHEAD: Top-down satellite view of the map. Tap/Click any area
        --    or aim the Center Crosshair (🎯) with Touch-Drag / Virtual D-Pad!
        -- 2. LOCAL_VIEW: Camera swoops down to that area at street/eye level
        --    ("sanki oradaymışız gibi gözüksün"). Tap/Click or aim with D-Pad!
        -- 3. CONFIRM: Confirmation modal pops up ("ONAYLA VE GÖTÜR / YENİDEN SEÇ / İPTAL").
        -- ====================================================================
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then
            local fallbackPos = (tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -110)).Position
            Engine.BroadcastVanConfirmedP2P(targetPlayer, fallbackPos)
            StartCriminalMinibusSequence(targetPlayer, fallbackPos)
            return
        end

        local origCamType = cam.CameraType
        local origCamSubject = cam.CameraSubject
        local origCamCFrame = cam.CFrame
        local origCamFOV = cam.FieldOfView

        if UI.ScreenGui then
            local oldGui = UI.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("BerksMinibusTacticalSelector")
            if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end
        end

        local stage = "OVERHEAD" -- "OVERHEAD" | "TRANSITION" | "LOCAL_VIEW" | "CONFIRM"
        local resolved = false
        local connections = {}
        local isTouchDevice = UserInputService.TouchEnabled

        -- Overhead Map Camera State
        local overheadFocus = Vector3.new(tHrp.Position.X, tHrp.Position.Y, tHrp.Position.Z)
        local overheadHeight = 290.0

        -- Close-Up Street View Camera State ("sanki oradaymışız gibi")
        local localAreaAnchor = overheadFocus
        local localCamPos = overheadFocus + Vector3.new(0, 14, 24)
        local localYaw = 0
        local localPitch = math.rad(-22)

        -- Virtual Mobile D-Pad & Zoom Hold States
        local touchMoveX, touchMoveZ, touchZoomDir = 0, 0, 0
        local lastUiButtonPressClock = 0

        -- Selected exact destination
        local hoveredGroundPos = (tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -80)).Position
        local selectedFinalPos = hoveredGroundPos

        -- 3D Preview Marker & Drop-off Hologram Pillar
        local previewModel = Instance.new("Model")
        previewModel.Name = "BerksMinibusMapPreview"
        previewModel.Parent = Workspace

        local previewRing = Instance.new("Part")
        previewRing.Name = "PreviewRing"
        previewRing.Size = Vector3.new(8.5, 0.4, 8.5)
        previewRing.Anchored = true
        previewRing.CanCollide = false
        previewRing.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        previewRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        previewRing.Transparency = 0.2
        previewRing.Parent = previewModel
        Instance.new("CylinderMesh", previewRing)

        local previewCore = Instance.new("Part")
        previewCore.Name = "PreviewCore"
        previewCore.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 26, 2.2)
        previewCore.Anchored = true
        previewCore.CanCollide = false
        previewCore.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        previewCore.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        previewCore.Transparency = 0.55
        previewCore.Parent = previewModel
        Instance.new("CylinderMesh", previewCore)

        local previewBillboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        previewBillboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 44)
        previewBillboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
        previewBillboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        previewBillboard.Parent = previewRing

        local previewTag = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        previewTag.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        previewTag.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42)
        previewTag.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        previewTag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        previewTag.TextSize = 12
        previewTag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
        previewTag.Text = UI.Tr("📍 BÖLGE SEÇ", "📍 SELECT AREA")
        previewTag.Parent = previewBillboard
        Instance.new("UICorner", previewTag).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local pStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", previewTag)
        pStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        pStroke.Thickness = 1.5

        -- Build Responsive HUD & Mobile Touch Controls Overlay
        local rootOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
        rootOverlay.Name = "BerksMinibusTacticalSelector"
        rootOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        rootOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rootOverlay.ZIndex = 900
        if UI.ScreenGui then
            rootOverlay.Parent = UI.ScreenGui
        end

        -- Top Instruction Banner (Responsive for Mobile & Desktop)
        local bannerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        bannerFrame.Name = "TopBanner"
        bannerFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        bannerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, 64)
        bannerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10)
        bannerFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(11, 17, 30)
        bannerFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
        bannerFrame.ZIndex = 905
        bannerFrame.Parent = rootOverlay
        Instance.new("UICorner", bannerFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local bannerMax = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint", bannerFrame)
        bannerMax.MaxSize = Vector2.new(640, 80)
        local bannerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", bannerFrame)
        bannerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)

        local function makeHoldButton(parent, name, txt, pos, size, onPress, onRelease)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Name = name
            b.Size = size
            b.Position = pos
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            b.TextSize = 15
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
            b.Text = txt
            b.ZIndex = 910
            b.Parent = parent
            Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            Instance.new("UIStroke", b).Color = Color3.fromRGB(71, 85, 105)
            b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                onPress()
            end)
            b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
                lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
                onRelease()
            end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
                onRelease()
            end)
            return b
        end

        -- Raycast helpers (Supports ScreenPointToRay for Touch taps, ViewportPointToRay for Center Crosshair & Mouse)
        local function performMapRay(unitRay)
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local filter = { previewModel }
            if LocalPlayer.Character then table.insert(filter, LocalPlayer.Character) end
            if targetPlayer.Character then table.insert(filter, targetPlayer.Character) end
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
            local res = Workspace:Raycast(unitRay.Origin, unitRay.Direction * 3500, rp)
            if res and res.Position then
                return res.Position
            else
                local dirY = unitRay.Direction.Y
                if math.abs(dirY) > 0.001 then
                    local t = (tHrp.Position.Y - unitRay.Origin.Y) / dirY
                    if t > 0 and t < 3800 then
                        return unitRay.Origin + unitRay.Direction * t
                    end
                end
            end
            return hoveredGroundPos
        end

        local function raycastAtScreenPos(sx, sy)
            if not cam then return hoveredGroundPos end
            return performMapRay(cam:ScreenPointToRay(sx, sy))
        end

        local function raycastCenterViewport()
            if not cam then return hoveredGroundPos end
            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            return performMapRay(cam:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5))
        end

        local function raycastMapActiveAim()
            if not cam then return hoveredGroundPos end
            if isTouchDevice or touchMoveX ~= 0 or touchMoveZ ~= 0 then
                return raycastCenterViewport()
            end
            local mLoc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            return performMapRay(cam:ViewportPointToRay(mLoc.X, mLoc.Y))
        end

        local function isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, frameObj)
            if not frameObj or not frameObj.Visible then return false end
            local p = frameObj.AbsolutePosition
            local s = frameObj.AbsoluteSize
            return screenVec2.X >= p.X - 6 and screenVec2.X <= p.X + s.X + 6 and screenVec2.Y >= p.Y - 6 and screenVec2.Y <= p.Y + s.Y + 6
        end

        local function isPointOnSelectorHUD(screenVec2)
            return isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, bannerFrame)
                or isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, topBtnBar)
                or isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, centerSelectBtn)
                or isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, dpadFrame)
                or isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, zoomFrame)
                or isPointInsideGuiFrame(screenVec2, confirmModal)
        end

        -- Switch to Stage 2: Street-Level / Close-Up "As If You Are There" View
        local function enterLocalCloseUpStage(clickedRegionPos)
            stage = "TRANSITION"
            confirmModal.Visible = false
            backToOverheadBtn.Visible = true
            centerSelectBtn.Visible = true
            dpadFrame.Visible = true
            zoomFrame.Visible = true
            crosshairFrame.Visible = true

            localAreaAnchor = clickedRegionPos

            local toArea = clickedRegionPos - Vector3.new(tHrp.Position.X, clickedRegionPos.Y, tHrp.Position.Z)
            local lookDir = (toArea.Magnitude > 1) and toArea.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            localYaw = math.atan2(-lookDir.X, -lookDir.Z)
            localPitch = math.rad(-18)

            local targetEyePos = clickedRegionPos - lookDir * 18 + Vector3.new(0, 11.5, 0)
            local targetLookAt = clickedRegionPos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
            local targetCF = CFrame.lookAt(targetEyePos, targetLookAt)
            localCamPos = targetEyePos
            hoveredGroundPos = clickedRegionPos

            bannerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
            stepTitleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(251, 191, 36)
            stepTitleLbl.Text = UI.Tr("📍 ADIM 2/3 — YAKIN GÖRÜNÜM (SEÇTİĞİNİZ BÖLGEDESİNİZ!)", "📍 STEP 2/3 — STREET-LEVEL VIEW (AT SELECTED AREA!)")
            stepSubLbl.Text = UI.Tr("Şu an o bölgedesiniz! Parmağınızı sürükleyerek etrafa bakın, ▲▼◄► ile gezin, bırakılacağınız yere DOKUNUN veya alttaki Sarı Butona basın!", "You are there! Drag finger / Right-Click to look around, use ▲▼◄► to move, TAP the exact spot or press the Amber Button below!")

            previewRing.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
            previewCore.Color = Color3.fromRGB(251, 191, 36)
            pStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
            previewTag.Text = UI.Tr("📍 BURAYI SEÇ (DOKUN/TIKLA)", "📍 PICK THIS EXACT SPOT (TAP/CLICK)")
            PlayUiSound("drawerOpen")

            local startCF = cam.CFrame
            local t0 = os.clock()
            task.spawn(function()
                while os.clock() - t0 < 0.45 and not resolved and stage == "TRANSITION" do
                    local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / 0.45, 0, 1)
                    local ease = 1 - math.pow(1 - alpha, 3)
                    cam.CFrame = startCF:Lerp(targetCF, ease)
                    cam.FieldOfView = 70
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                end
                if not resolved and stage == "TRANSITION" then
                    stage = "LOCAL_VIEW"
                end
            end)
        end

            cmDesc.Text = UI.Tr(
                string.format("Seçilen Konum: (%d, %d, %d)  •  Mesafe: %d stud\nSabit Sürüş Hızı: 50 stud/sn (Tahmini Varış: ~%d sn · Tam P2P)", math.floor(pickedPos.X), math.floor(pickedPos.Y), math.floor(pickedPos.Z), distStuds, estSeconds),
                string.format("Selected Coords: (%d, %d, %d)  •  Distance: %d studs\nConstant Cruise Speed: 50 studs/s (Est. Travel: ~%ds · Full P2P)", math.floor(pickedPos.X), math.floor(pickedPos.Y), math.floor(pickedPos.Z), distStuds, estSeconds)
            )

            previewCore.Color = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153)

            local viewOffset = (localCamPos - pickedPos)
            local flatView = Vector3.new(viewOffset.X, 0, viewOffset.Z)
            local backDir = (flatView.Magnitude > 1) and flatView.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
            local confirmCamPos = pickedPos + backDir * 16 + Vector3.new(0, 9.5, 0)
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(confirmCamPos, pickedPos + Vector3.new(0, 2.0, 0))
            PlayUiSound("command")
        end

        local function cleanupSelectorAndRestoreCamera()
            if resolved then return end
            resolved = true
            for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
                pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
            end
            connections = {}
            if previewModel and previewModel.Parent then
                pcall(function() previewModel:Destroy() end)
            end
            if rootOverlay and rootOverlay.Parent then
                pcall(function() rootOverlay:Destroy() end)
            end
            if cam then
                pcall(function()
                    cam.CameraType = origCamType
                    cam.CameraSubject = (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) or origCamSubject
                    cam.CFrame = origCamCFrame
                    cam.FieldOfView = origCamFOV
                end)
            end
        end

        -- Button Callbacks
        centerSelectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if resolved then return end
            lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
            local aimPos = raycastCenterViewport()
            if stage == "OVERHEAD" then
                enterLocalCloseUpStage(aimPos)
            elseif stage == "LOCAL_VIEW" then
                enterConfirmationStage(aimPos)
            end
        end)

        backToOverheadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if resolved then return end
            lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
            enterOverheadStage()
        end)

        cancelMapBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if resolved then return end
            lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
            cleanupSelectorAndRestoreCamera()
            if UI.SendNotification then
