                UI.SendNotification("VAN", UI.Tr("Minibüs hedef seçimi iptal edildi.", "Minibus destination selection cancelled."), Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184), 2.5)
            end
        end)

        reselectLocalBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if resolved then return end
            lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
            enterLocalCloseUpStage(selectedFinalPos)
        end)

        reselectTopMapBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if resolved then return end
            lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
            enterOverheadStage()
        end)

        confirmGoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if resolved then return end
            lastUiButtonPressClock = os.clock()
            local finalPos = selectedFinalPos
            cleanupSelectorAndRestoreCamera()
            PlayUiSound("command")
            -- Broadcast confirmed (X, Y, Z) coordinates over FE Animator Track P2P Carrier + SharedListeners + RelayEvent!
            Engine.BroadcastVanConfirmedP2P(targetPlayer, finalPos)
            StartCriminalMinibusSequence(targetPlayer, finalPos)
        end)

        -- Initialize Camera to Scriptable Top-Down Overhead Map View
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        enterOverheadStage()

        -- Camera & Cursor/Crosshair Preview Render Loop
        local renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if resolved or not cam then return end

            -- Combine Keyboard WASD/Arrows + Mobile Virtual D-Pad
            local moveX, moveZ = touchMoveX, touchMoveZ
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then moveZ = moveZ - 1 end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) then moveZ = moveZ + 1 end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) then moveX = moveX - 1 end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then moveX = moveX + 1 end

            if stage == "OVERHEAD" then
                if touchZoomDir ~= 0 then
                    overheadHeight = math.clamp(overheadHeight - touchZoomDir * 185 * dt, 85, 750)
                end
                local panSpeed = math.clamp(overheadHeight * 0.85, 90, 420)
                overheadFocus = overheadFocus + Vector3.new(moveX * panSpeed * dt, 0, moveZ * panSpeed * dt)
                local camTopPos = overheadFocus + Vector3.new(0, overheadHeight, 0)
                cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camTopPos, overheadFocus, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
                cam.FieldOfView = 70

                local hitPos = raycastMapActiveAim()
                hoveredGroundPos = hitPos
                previewRing.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0))
                previewCore.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0))

            elseif stage == "LOCAL_VIEW" then
                if UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
                    local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
                    localYaw = localYaw - delta.X * 0.0045
                    localPitch = math.clamp(localPitch - delta.Y * 0.0045, math.rad(-75), math.rad(35))
                end

                local rotCF = CFrame.Angles(0, localYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(localPitch, 0, 0)
                if touchZoomDir ~= 0 then
                    localCamPos = localCamPos + rotCF.LookVector * (touchZoomDir * 38.0 * dt)
                end
                local walkSpeed = 48.0
                local flatLook = Vector3.new(rotCF.LookVector.X, 0, rotCF.LookVector.Z)
                local forwardFlat = (flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01) and flatLook.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                local moveVec = (rotCF.RightVector * moveX) + (forwardFlat * (-moveZ))
                if moveVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                    localCamPos = localCamPos + moveVec * (walkSpeed * dt)
                end

                cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(localCamPos) * rotCF
                cam.FieldOfView = 70

                local hitPos = raycastMapActiveAim()
                hoveredGroundPos = hitPos
                previewRing.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0))
                previewCore.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0))
            end
        end)
        table.insert(connections, renderConn)

        -- Touch Drag (Mobile Pan in OVERHEAD & Look Rotation in LOCAL_VIEW) + Touch Tap / Mouse Click Selection
        local activeTouchObj = nil
        local touchStartPos = nil
        local touchLastPos = nil
        local touchMaxDelta = 0

        local inputBeganConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
            if resolved then return end
            if os.clock() - lastUiButtonPressClock < 0.12 then return end

            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local pt = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                if isPointOnSelectorHUD(pt) then return end
                activeTouchObj = input
                touchStartPos = pt
                touchLastPos = pt
                touchMaxDelta = 0
            elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and not gameProcessed then
                local pt = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                if isPointOnSelectorHUD(pt) then return end
                if stage == "OVERHEAD" then
                    local regionPos = raycastMapActiveAim()
                    enterLocalCloseUpStage(regionPos)
                elseif stage == "LOCAL_VIEW" then
                    local exactSpot = raycastMapActiveAim()
                    enterConfirmationStage(exactSpot)
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(connections, inputBeganConn)

        local inputChangedConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
            if resolved then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and not gameProcessed then
                if stage == "OVERHEAD" then
                    overheadHeight = math.clamp(overheadHeight - input.Position.Z * 32, 85, 750)
                elseif stage == "LOCAL_VIEW" then
                    localCamPos = localCamPos + cam.CFrame.LookVector * (input.Position.Z * 4.5)
                end
            elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == activeTouchObj and touchLastPos then
                local curPt = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                local delta = curPt - touchLastPos
                touchLastPos = curPt
                if touchStartPos then
                    touchMaxDelta = math.max(touchMaxDelta, (curPt - touchStartPos).Magnitude)
                end
                if stage == "OVERHEAD" then
                    -- Dragging finger on Overhead Map smoothly pans the map!
                    local panScale = math.clamp(overheadHeight * 0.0022, 0.18, 1.4)
                    overheadFocus = overheadFocus - Vector3.new(delta.X * panScale, 0, delta.Y * panScale)
                elseif stage == "LOCAL_VIEW" then
                    -- Dragging finger in Close-Up Street View rotates camera look direction!
                    localYaw = localYaw - delta.X * 0.0055
                    localPitch = math.clamp(localPitch - delta.Y * 0.0055, math.rad(-75), math.rad(35))
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(connections, inputChangedConn)

        local inputEndedConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if resolved then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == activeTouchObj then
                local endPt = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                local wasQuickTap = (touchMaxDelta < 16)
                activeTouchObj = nil
                touchStartPos = nil
                touchLastPos = nil
                if wasQuickTap and (os.clock() - lastUiButtonPressClock >= 0.12) and not isPointOnSelectorHUD(endPt) then
                    local tappedWorldPos = raycastAtScreenPos(endPt.X, endPt.Y)
                    hoveredGroundPos = tappedWorldPos
                    if stage == "OVERHEAD" then
                        enterLocalCloseUpStage(tappedWorldPos)
                    elseif stage == "LOCAL_VIEW" then
                        enterConfirmationStage(tappedWorldPos)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(connections, inputEndedConn)
    end

    -- ========================================================================
    -- 6. NEW COMMAND: GODZILLA ("godzilla <isim>")
    -- Colossal Multi-Part 3D Procedural Godzilla Rig, 7-Segment Tail, Animated
    -- Dorsal Spines, Jaws/Eyes, 10 Smooth Animations, Footstep Shake & Atomic Breath
    -- Full Real-Time P2P Sync + On-Screen Mobile/PC Action Bar
    -- ========================================================================
    function Engine.ToggleGodzillaMorph(targetPlr)
        if not targetPlr then return end
        local pName = targetPlr.Name
        local existing = State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName]
        local isForceOff = State.LastInvokedAlias and string.sub(State.LastInvokedAlias, 1, 2) == "un"
        if (existing and existing.Active) or isForceOff then
            if existing and existing.Cleanup then pcall(existing.Cleanup) end
            State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName] = nil
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    "GODZILLA",
                    UI.Tr(pName .. " Godzilla dönüşümünden çıktı, eski karakteri geri yüklendi.", pName .. " exited Godzilla transformation; original character restored."),
                    Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
                    3.5
                )
            end
            return
        end

        local char = targetPlr.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end

        Engine.ResolveTransformationConflict(targetPlr, "GODZILLA")

        local session = {
            Active = true,
            InitiatedByLocal = not State.IsExecutingFromP2P,
            AnimState = "Idle",
            ActionLockUntil = 0,
            Connections = {},
            SavedTransparency = {},
            SavedWalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed,
            SavedJumpPower = hum.JumpPower
        }
        State.P2PV6.GodzillaSessions[pName] = session

        for _, inst in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if (inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:IsA("Decal")) and inst ~= hrp then
                session.SavedTransparency[inst] = inst.Transparency
                inst.Transparency = 1
            end
        end

        hum.WalkSpeed = 24
        hum.JumpPower = 65

        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "BerksGodzillaKaiju_" .. pName
        model.Parent = Workspace
        session.Model = model

        local darkScale = Color3.fromRGB(28, 33, 38)
        local bellyScale = Color3.fromRGB(45, 52, 58)
        local atomicBlue = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)

        local function makeKaijuPart(name, size, col, mat)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = name
            p.Size = size
            p.Color = col or darkScale
            p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Slate
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CastShadow = true
            p.Parent = model
            return p
        end

        local lowerTorso = makeKaijuPart("LowerTorso", Vector3.new(11, 12, 9), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local upperTorso = makeKaijuPart("UpperTorso", Vector3.new(13, 13, 10), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local bellyPlate = makeKaijuPart("BellyPlate", Vector3.new(9.5, 18, 2), bellyScale, Enum.Material.Cobblestone)

        local neck = makeKaijuPart("Neck", Vector3.new(7.5, 7, 7.5), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local head = makeKaijuPart("Head", Vector3.new(7, 5.5, 9.5), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local lowerJaw = makeKaijuPart("LowerJaw", Vector3.new(6.2, 2.2, 8.8), bellyScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local eyeL = makeKaijuPart("EyeLeft", Vector3.new(0.9, 0.8, 1.4), atomicBlue, Enum.Material.Neon)
        local eyeR = makeKaijuPart("EyeRight", Vector3.new(0.9, 0.8, 1.4), atomicBlue, Enum.Material.Neon)

        local thighL = makeKaijuPart("ThighL", Vector3.new(5.5, 10, 6.5), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local thighR = makeKaijuPart("ThighR", Vector3.new(5.5, 10, 6.5), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local shinL = makeKaijuPart("ShinL", Vector3.new(4.8, 9, 5.5), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local shinR = makeKaijuPart("ShinR", Vector3.new(4.8, 9, 5.5), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local footL = makeKaijuPart("FootL", Vector3.new(6, 2.8, 8.5), bellyScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local footR = makeKaijuPart("FootR", Vector3.new(6, 2.8, 8.5), bellyScale, Enum.Material.Slate)

        local armL = makeKaijuPart("ArmL", Vector3.new(3.6, 8.5, 3.8), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local armR = makeKaijuPart("ArmR", Vector3.new(3.6, 8.5, 3.8), darkScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local clawL = makeKaijuPart("ClawL", Vector3.new(3.2, 3.5, 3.5), bellyScale, Enum.Material.Slate)
        local clawR = makeKaijuPart("ClawR", Vector3.new(3.2, 3.5, 3.5), bellyScale, Enum.Material.Slate)

        local tailSegments = {}
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local factor = 1 - (i * 0.11)
            local seg = makeKaijuPart(
                "TailSeg_" .. i,
                Vector3.new(math.max(1.8, 8.5 * factor), math.max(1.8, 7.5 * factor), 6.5),
                darkScale,
                Enum.Material.Slate
            )
            table.insert(tailSegments, seg)
        end

        local dorsalSpines = {}
        for i = 1, 9 do
            local h = (i <= 5) and (4.5 + i * 0.7) or (8.5 - (i - 5) * 1.1)
            local sp = makeKaijuPart("DorsalSpine_" .. i, Vector3.new(1.6, h, 3.4), Color3.fromRGB(38, 60, 78), Enum.Material.Glass)
            table.insert(dorsalSpines, sp)
        end

        local roarSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        roarSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114221580"
        roarSound.Volume = 2.4
        roarSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.52
        roarSound.Parent = head

        local stompSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        stompSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9120693399"
        stompSound.Volume = 1.6
        stompSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.65
        stompSound.Parent = lowerTorso

        local function emitFootstepImpact(footCF, intensity)
            pcall(function() stompSound:Play() end)
            local dust = Instance.new("Part")
            dust.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.4, 2)
            dust.CFrame = footCF * CFrame.new(0, -1.2, 0)
            dust.Anchored = true
            dust.CanCollide = false
            dust.Transparency = 0.45
            dust.Color = Color3.fromRGB(145, 135, 120)
            dust.Material = Enum.Material.Sand
            dust.Parent = Workspace
            Instance.new("CylinderMesh", dust)
            TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = Vector3.new(22 * intensity, 0.2, 22 * intensity),
                Transparency = 1
            }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(dust, 0.65)

            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHrp and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                local dist = (myHrp.Position - footCF.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < 135 then
                    local mag = math.clamp((1 - dist / 135) * 1.35 * intensity, 0.08, 2.0)
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for _ = 1, 5 do
                            Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new((math.random() - 0.5) * mag, (math.random() - 0.5) * mag, 0)
                            task.wait(0.025)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        session.TriggerAction = function(act, fromP2P)
            if not session.Active then return end
            if not fromP2P then
                Engine.BroadcastGodzillaActionP2P(targetPlr, act)
            end
            session.AnimState = act
            local dur = 1.5
            if act == "Roaring" then
                dur = 2.3
                pcall(function() roarSound:Play() end)
                for _, sp in ipairs(dorsalSpines) do
                    sp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    sp.Color = atomicBlue
                end
                emitFootstepImpact(hrp.CFrame, 1.8)
            elseif act == "SpecialAttack" then
                dur = 3.0
                pcall(function() roarSound:Play() end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    for i = #dorsalSpines, 1, -1 do
                        if dorsalSpines[i] then
                            dorsalSpines[i].Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            dorsalSpines[i].Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 225, 255)
                        end
                        task.wait(0.07)
                    end
                    local beam = makeKaijuPart("AtomicBreath", Vector3.new(4.5, 4.5, 110), atomicBlue, Enum.Material.Neon)
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while os.clock() - t0 < 1.7 and session.Active do
                        beam.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1, -58)
                        emitFootstepImpact(head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -28), 0.65)
                        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    end
                    if beam and beam.Parent then beam:Destroy() end
                end)
            elseif act == "Stomp" then
                dur = 1.2
                task.delay(0.4, function()
                    if session.Active then emitFootstepImpact(footR.CFrame, 2.1) end
                end)
            elseif act == "TailAttack" then
                dur = 1.35
            elseif act == "Bite" then
                dur = 1.1
            end
            session.ActionLockUntil = os.clock() + dur
            task.delay(dur, function()
                if session.Active then
                    for _, sp in ipairs(dorsalSpines) do
                        sp.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                        sp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 60, 78)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        if targetPlr == LocalPlayer then
            local kb = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
                if gp or not session.Active or os.clock() < session.ActionLockUntil then return end
                if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
                    session.TriggerAction("Roaring", false)
                elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
                    session.TriggerAction("SpecialAttack", false)
                elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
                    session.TriggerAction("TailAttack", false)
                elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
                    session.TriggerAction("Stomp", false)
                elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
                    session.TriggerAction("Bite", false)
                end
            end)
            table.insert(session.Connections, kb)

            -- On-Screen Godzilla Mobile/PC Action Bar so mobile players and target players can trigger all 5 attacks
            if UI.ScreenGui then
                local actionBar = Instance.new("Frame")
                actionBar.Name = "BerksGodzillaActionBar"
                actionBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 440, 0, 44)
                actionBar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -220, 1, -110)
                actionBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 24)
                actionBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
                actionBar.ZIndex = 880
                actionBar.Parent = UI.ScreenGui
                Instance.new("UICorner", actionBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
                local abStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                abStroke.Color = atomicBlue
                abStroke.Thickness = 1.5
                abStroke.Parent = actionBar
                session.ActionBar = actionBar

                local actionsList = {
                    { Act = "Roaring", Label = UI.Tr("[R] Kükre", "[R] Roar"), Col = Color3.fromRGB(30, 64, 175) },
                    { Act = "SpecialAttack", Label = UI.Tr("[F] Atomik", "[F] Atomic"), Col = Color3.fromRGB(2, 132, 199) },
                    { Act = "TailAttack", Label = UI.Tr("[T] Kuyruk", "[T] Tail"), Col = Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85) },
                    { Act = "Stomp", Label = UI.Tr("[G] Ezme", "[G] Stomp"), Col = Color3.fromRGB(180, 83, 9) },
                    { Act = "Bite", Label = UI.Tr("[B] Isırık", "[B] Bite"), Col = Color3.fromRGB(153, 27, 27) }
                }
                for idx, item in ipairs(actionsList) do
                    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, -8, 1, -10)
                    btn.Position = UDim2.new((idx - 1) * 0.2, 4, 0, 5)
                    btn.BackgroundColor3 = item.Col
                    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    btn.TextSize = 11
                    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    btn.Text = item.Label
                    btn.ZIndex = 881
                    btn.Parent = actionBar
                    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
                    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if session.Active and os.clock() >= session.ActionLockUntil then
                            session.TriggerAction(item.Act, false)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        local stepTimer = 0
        local lastFoot = "L"
        local lastYaw = 0
        local animConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not session.Active or not char.Parent or not hrp.Parent then
                if session.Cleanup then pcall(session.Cleanup) end
                return
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local flatSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
            local _, curYaw, _ = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
            local yawDelta = math.abs(curYaw - lastYaw)
            lastYaw = curYaw

            if now >= session.ActionLockUntil then
                if flatSpeed > 20 then
                    session.AnimState = "Running"
                elseif flatSpeed > 1.5 then
                    session.AnimState = "Walking"
                elseif yawDelta > 0.025 then
                    session.AnimState = "Turning"
                else
                    session.AnimState = "Idle"
                end
            end

            local st = session.AnimState
            local freq = (st == "Running") and 5.2 or ((st == "Walking") and 3.1 or 1.4)
            stepTimer = stepTimer + dt * freq

            local baseCF = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 11.5, 0)
            local bobY = math.sin(stepTimer * 2) * ((flatSpeed > 1.5) and 1.1 or 0.35)
            local torsoRoll = math.sin(stepTimer) * ((flatSpeed > 1.5) and math.rad(5) or math.rad(1))
            local torsoPitch = (st == "Roaring" or st == "SpecialAttack") and math.rad(-28) or ((st == "Bite") and math.rad(-35) or math.rad(-14))

            local rootCF = baseCF * CFrame.new(0, bobY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(torsoPitch, 0, torsoRoll)
            lowerTorso.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -3.5, 0)
            upperTorso.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 6.5, -1.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), 0, 0)
            bellyPlate.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, -4.8)

            local headPitch = (st == "Roaring" or st == "SpecialAttack") and math.rad(22) or math.sin(stepTimer) * math.rad(4)
            local jawOpen = (st == "Roaring" or st == "SpecialAttack") and math.rad(-34) or ((st == "Bite") and math.sin(now * 18) * math.rad(28) or math.rad(-4))
            neck.CFrame = upperTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 7.5, -2.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(12), 0, 0)
            head.CFrame = neck.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.8, -3.6) * CFrame.Angles(headPitch, 0, 0)
            lowerJaw.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2.2, -0.4) * CFrame.Angles(jawOpen, 0, 0)
            eyeL.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-2.8, 1.1, -2.2)
            eyeR.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(2.8, 1.1, -2.2)

            local legSwing = (flatSpeed > 1.5) and (math.sin(stepTimer) * math.rad(28)) or 0
            local stompLift = (st == "Stomp") and math.abs(math.sin(now * 6)) * 8 or 0
            thighL.CFrame = lowerTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-5.8, -4.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(legSwing, 0, 0)
            shinL.CFrame = thighL.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -7.5, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(-math.abs(legSwing) * 0.5, 0, 0)
            footL.CFrame = shinL.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -5.2, -1.8)

            thighR.CFrame = lowerTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(5.8, -4.5 + stompLift * 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-legSwing, 0, 0)
            shinR.CFrame = thighR.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -7.5 + stompLift * 0.5, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(-math.abs(legSwing) * 0.5, 0, 0)
            footR.CFrame = shinR.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -5.2, -1.8)

            if flatSpeed > 1.5 then
                local ph = math.sin(stepTimer)
                if ph > 0.92 and lastFoot ~= "R" then
                    lastFoot = "R"
                    emitFootstepImpact(footR.CFrame, (st == "Running") and 1.35 or 0.9)
                elseif ph < -0.92 and lastFoot ~= "L" then
                    lastFoot = "L"
                    emitFootstepImpact(footL.CFrame, (st == "Running") and 1.35 or 0.9)
                end
            end

            local armWave = math.cos(stepTimer) * math.rad(16)
            armL.CFrame = upperTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-7.4, 1.5, -2.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35) + armWave, 0, math.rad(-12))
            clawL.CFrame = armL.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -5.2, -0.8)
            armR.CFrame = upperTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(7.4, 1.5, -2.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35) - armWave, 0, math.rad(12))
            clawR.CFrame = armR.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -5.2, -0.8)

            local prevTailCF = lowerTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -3.5, 4.5)
            local tailMult = (st == "TailAttack") and 4.2 or 1.0
            for i, seg in ipairs(tailSegments) do
                local sway = math.sin(stepTimer - i * 0.55) * math.rad(12 * tailMult)
                local segCF = prevTailCF * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-3), sway, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, 5.4)
                seg.CFrame = segCF
                prevTailCF = segCF
            end

            for i = 1, 5 do
                if dorsalSpines[i] then
                    dorsalSpines[i].CFrame = upperTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 6.5 - (i * 2.7), 5.6) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), 0, 0)
                end
            end
            for i = 6, 9 do
                local tSeg = tailSegments[i - 5]
                if dorsalSpines[i] and tSeg then
                    dorsalSpines[i].CFrame = tSeg.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.8, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, 0)
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(session.Connections, animConn)

        session.Cleanup = function()
            session.Active = false
            for _, c in ipairs(session.Connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            if session.ActionBar and session.ActionBar.Parent then pcall(function() session.ActionBar:Destroy() end) end
            if session.Model and session.Model.Parent then session.Model:Destroy() end
            for inst, origT in pairs(session.SavedTransparency) do
                if inst and inst.Parent then pcall(function() inst.Transparency = origT end) end
            end
            if hum and hum.Parent then
                hum.WalkSpeed = session.SavedWalkSpeed or 16
                hum.JumpPower = session.SavedJumpPower or 50
            end
        end

        Engine.RegisterTransformationCleanup(targetPlr, "GODZILLA", session.Cleanup)
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification(
                "GODZILLA KAIJU",
                UI.Tr(
                    pName .. " devasa GODZILLA formuna dönüştü! (Tuşlar/Butonlar: R=Kükreme, F=Atomik Nefes, T=Kuyruk, G=Ezme, B=Isırık)",
                    pName .. " transformed into colossal GODZILLA! (Keys/Buttons: R=Roar, F=Atomic Breath, T=Tail, G=Stomp, B=Bite)"
                ),
                Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
                5
            )
        end
    end

    -- ========================================================================
    -- 7. NEW COMMAND: HALLUCINATIONS ("hallucinations <isim>")
    -- Terrifying Server-Player Clone Hallucinations (Full Real-Time P2P Sync!):
    -- * Clones actual players in the server (in front, beside, behind, surrounding)
    -- * Synchronized across both screens via BroadcastHallucinationWaveP2P
    -- * Clones continuously stare at & track the target player's eyes
    -- * As soon as the target player looks at a watching clone, its head violently
    --   twitches, eyes flare blood-red, and it vanishes into black smoke!
    -- ========================================================================
    function Engine.ToggleHallucinationsSystem(targetPlr, intensityMult)
        if not targetPlr then return end
        local pName = targetPlr.Name
        local mult = tonumber(intensityMult) or 1.0
        local existing = State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName]
        local isForceOff = State.LastInvokedAlias and string.sub(State.LastInvokedAlias, 1, 2) == "un"

        if (existing and existing.Active and mult == 1.0) or isForceOff then
            if existing and existing.Cleanup then pcall(existing.Cleanup) end
            State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName] = nil
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    "HALLUCINATIONS",
                    UI.Tr(pName .. " için Halüsinasyon sistemi durduruldu ve tüm etkiler temizlendi.", "Hallucinations system stopped for " .. pName .. "; all effects restored."),
                    Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
                    3.5
                )
            end
            return
        elseif existing and existing.Active and mult > 1.0 then
            existing.Intensity = mult
            return
        end

        local session = {
            Active = true,
            InitiatedByLocal = not State.IsExecutingFromP2P,
            Intensity = mult,
            Escalation = 1.0,
            LastScenario = 0,
            LastWaveClock = 0,
            SpawnedObjects = {},
            Connections = {},
            SavedCameraMode = targetPlr.CameraMode,
            SavedFOV = Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView or 70
        }
        State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName] = session

        local ccEffect, whisperSound, heartbeatSound, stingSound, glitchOverlay
        if targetPlr == LocalPlayer then
            pcall(function() targetPlr.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson end)
            ccEffect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
            ccEffect.Name = "BerksHallucinationCC"
            ccEffect.Saturation = -0.45
            ccEffect.Contrast = 0.35
            ccEffect.Brightness = -0.07
            ccEffect.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 220, 225)
            ccEffect.Parent = Lighting
            table.insert(session.SpawnedObjects, ccEffect)

            whisperSound = Instance.new("Sound")
            whisperSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114221580"
            whisperSound.Volume = 0.45
            whisperSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.62
            whisperSound.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            table.insert(session.SpawnedObjects, whisperSound)

            heartbeatSound = Instance.new("Sound")
            heartbeatSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9120693399"
            heartbeatSound.Volume = 0.55
            heartbeatSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.72
            heartbeatSound.Looped = true
            heartbeatSound.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            pcall(function() heartbeatSound:Play() end)
            table.insert(session.SpawnedObjects, heartbeatSound)

            stingSound = Instance.new("Sound")
            stingSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9043345732"
            stingSound.Volume = 0.65
            stingSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.35
            stingSound.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            table.insert(session.SpawnedObjects, stingSound)

            if UI.ScreenGui then
                glitchOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
                glitchOverlay.Name = "BerksHallucinationGlitchFlash"
                glitchOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                glitchOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 15, 25)
                glitchOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                glitchOverlay.ZIndex = 920
                glitchOverlay.Parent = UI.ScreenGui
                table.insert(session.SpawnedObjects, glitchOverlay)
            end
        end

        local function triggerVanishHorrorFlash(clonePos, rushCamera)
            if targetPlr == LocalPlayer then
                if stingSound then
                    stingSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.15 + math.random() * 0.45
                    pcall(function() stingSound:Play() end)
                end
                if ccEffect and ccEffect.Parent then
                    ccEffect.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
                    ccEffect.Contrast = 0.85
                    task.delay(0.14, function()
                        if ccEffect and ccEffect.Parent then
                            ccEffect.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 220, 225)
                            ccEffect.Contrast = 0.35
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if glitchOverlay and glitchOverlay.Parent then
                    glitchOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72
                    TweenService:Create(glitchOverlay, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
                end
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for _ = 1, 4 do
                            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4), math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4), 0)
                            task.wait(0.02)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            if clonePos then
                local smokePart = Instance.new("Part")
                smokePart.Size = Vector3.new(3.5, 6.2, 3.5)
                smokePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(clonePos)
                smokePart.Anchored = true
                smokePart.CanCollide = false
                smokePart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
                smokePart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                smokePart.Transparency = 0.25
                smokePart.Parent = Workspace
                TweenService:Create(smokePart, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Size = Vector3.new(8.5, 10.5, 8.5),
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
                Debris:AddItem(smokePart, 0.35)
            end
        end

        -- Builds a terrifying clone of a real player currently in the server!
        local function spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, horrorStyle, deterministicIdx)
            local allPlrs = Players:GetPlayers()
            table.sort(allPlrs, function(a, b) return a.UserId < b.UserId end)
            local candidates = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(allPlrs) do
                if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    if p ~= targetPlr or #allPlrs == 1 then
                        table.insert(candidates, p)
                    end
                end
            end
            if #candidates == 0 and targetPlr.Character then
                table.insert(candidates, targetPlr)
            end

            local pickIdx = (#candidates > 0) and (((deterministicIdx or math.random(1, #candidates)) - 1) % #candidates + 1) or 1
            local chosenPlr = candidates[pickIdx] or targetPlr
            local srcChar = chosenPlr and chosenPlr.Character
            local cloneModel = nil
            local partOffsets = {}
            local headOffset = CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0)
            local headPart = nil
            local eyeL, eyeR = nil, nil

            if srcChar and srcChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local srcHrp = srcChar.HumanoidRootPart
                local origArch = srcChar.Archivable
                pcall(function() srcChar.Archivable = true end)
                local okC, cloned = pcall(function() return srcChar:Clone() end)
                pcall(function() srcChar.Archivable = origArch end)

                if okC and cloned then
                    cloneModel = cloned
                    cloneModel.Name = "BerksHorrorPlayerClone_" .. chosenPlr.Name
                    for _, desc in ipairs(cloneModel:GetDescendants()) do
                        if desc:IsA("Script") or desc:IsA("LocalScript") or desc:IsA("Sound") or desc:IsA("ForceField") or desc:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                            pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
                        elseif desc:IsA("Humanoid") then
                            desc.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                            desc.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                        elseif desc:IsA("JointInstance") or desc:IsA("Motor6D") or desc:IsA("Weld") or desc:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                            pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end)
                        elseif desc:IsA("BasePart") then
                            desc.Anchored = true
                            desc.CanCollide = false
                            desc.CastShadow = true
                            local rel = srcHrp.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(desc.CFrame)
                            partOffsets[desc] = rel
                            if desc.Name == "Head" then
                                headPart = desc
                                headOffset = rel
                            end
                            if horrorStyle == "SHADOW_CORPSE" then
                                desc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
                            elseif horrorStyle == "PALE_STALKER" then
                                desc.Color = desc.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(195, 200, 210), 0.55)
                            elseif horrorStyle == "BLOOD_GLITCH" then
                                desc.Color = desc.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(45, 10, 14), 0.65)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if not cloneModel then
                cloneModel = Instance.new("Model")
                cloneModel.Name = "BerksHorrorPlayerClone_Fallback"
                local torso = Instance.new("Part")
                torso.Name = "Torso"
                torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
                torso.Anchored = true
                torso.CanCollide = false
                torso.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
                torso.Parent = cloneModel
                partOffsets[torso] = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)

                headPart = Instance.new("Part")
                headPart.Name = "Head"
                headPart.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
                headPart.Anchored = true
                headPart.CanCollide = false
                headPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28)
                headPart.Parent = cloneModel
                headOffset = CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0)
                partOffsets[headPart] = headOffset
            end

            local eyeColor = (horrorStyle == "BLOOD_GLITCH") and Color3.fromRGB(255, 25, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 240)
            eyeL = Instance.new("Part")
            eyeL.Name = "HorrorEyeL"
            eyeL.Size = Vector3.new(0.17, 0.11, 0.12)
            eyeL.Anchored = true
            eyeL.CanCollide = false
            eyeL.Color = eyeColor
            eyeL.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            eyeL.Parent = cloneModel

            eyeR = eyeL:Clone()
            eyeR.Name = "HorrorEyeR"
            eyeR.Parent = cloneModel

            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 16)
            hl.OutlineColor = (horrorStyle == "BLOOD_GLITCH") and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184)
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.25
            hl.Parent = cloneModel

            if headPart and chosenPlr then
                local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 24)
                bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
                bg.AlwaysOnTop = false
                bg.Parent = headPart
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
                lbl.TextSize = 11
                lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
                lbl.Text = "👁 " .. chosenPlr.Name .. " 👁"
                lbl.Parent = bg
            end

            local currentRootCF = cf
            local function setCloneCFrame(newRootCF, targetLookPos, headTiltRad, twitchScale)
                currentRootCF = newRootCF
                local jitter = twitchScale and Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * twitchScale, (math.random() - 0.5) * twitchScale, (math.random() - 0.5) * twitchScale) or Vector3.zero
                local rootWithJitter = newRootCF + jitter
                for part, relCF in pairs(partOffsets) do
                    if part and part.Parent and part ~= headPart then
                        part.CFrame = rootWithJitter * relCF
                    end
                end
                if headPart and headPart.Parent then
                    local defaultHeadWorld = (rootWithJitter * headOffset).Position
                    local hCF
                    if targetLookPos then
                        hCF = CFrame.lookAt(defaultHeadWorld, targetLookPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, headTiltRad or 0)
                    else
                        hCF = rootWithJitter * headOffset * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, headTiltRad or 0)
                    end
                    headPart.CFrame = hCF
                    if eyeL and eyeL.Parent then eyeL.CFrame = hCF * CFrame.new(-0.24, 0.12, -0.58) end
                    if eyeR and eyeR.Parent then eyeR.CFrame = hCF * CFrame.new(0.24, 0.12, -0.58) end
                end
            end

            setCloneCFrame(cf, nil, math.rad(math.random(-18, 18)), 0)
            cloneModel.Parent = Workspace
            table.insert(session.SpawnedObjects, cloneModel)

            return {
                Model = cloneModel,
                GetPosition = function() return currentRootCF.Position end,
                GetCFrame = function() return currentRootCF end,
                SetPose = setCloneCFrame,
                SetEyesBloodRed = function()
                    if eyeL and eyeL.Parent then eyeL.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); eyeL.Size = Vector3.new(0.24, 0.16, 0.16) end
                    if eyeR and eyeR.Parent then eyeR.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); eyeR.Size = Vector3.new(0.24, 0.16, 0.16) end
                    if hl and hl.Parent then hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 0) end
                end
            }
        end

        local function getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, fixedDist, angleDeg)
            local dist = math.clamp(fixedDist, 3, 95)
            local baseCF = (targetPlr == LocalPlayer and Workspace.CurrentCamera) and Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame or hrp.CFrame
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(baseCF.LookVector.X, 0, baseCF.LookVector.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.05 then flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
            local yawCF = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + flatLook) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(angleDeg), 0)
            local candidatePos = hrp.Position + yawCF.LookVector * dist

            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local exclude = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character then table.insert(exclude, p.Character) end
            end
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
            local rayRes = Workspace:Raycast(candidatePos + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0), Vector3.new(0, -45, 0), rp)
            local finalY = rayRes and (rayRes.Position.Y + 3.0) or hrp.Position.Y
            local finalPos = Vector3.new(candidatePos.X, finalY, candidatePos.Z)
            return CFrame.lookAt(finalPos, Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, finalY, hrp.Position.Z))
        end

        local function watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, maxLifeSec, lookDotThreshold, minNoticeTime, rushBeforeVanish)
            task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                local headTilt = math.rad(math.random(-22, 22))
                if math.abs(headTilt) < 0.12 then headTilt = math.rad(16) end
                local noticedFrames = 0

                while os.clock() - t0 < (maxLifeSec or 7.0) and cloneObj.Model and cloneObj.Model.Parent and session.Active do
                    local char = targetPlr.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if not hrp then break end

                    local cPos = cloneObj.GetPosition()
                    local lookTarget = (head and head.Position) or (hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
                    local facePlayerCF = CFrame.lookAt(cPos, Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, cPos.Y, hrp.Position.Z))
                    cloneObj.SetPose(facePlayerCF, lookTarget, headTilt, 0.03)

                    local cam = (targetPlr == LocalPlayer) and Workspace.CurrentCamera or nil
                    local viewerCF = cam and cam.CFrame or (head and head.CFrame) or hrp.CFrame
                    local toClone = (cPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)) - viewerCF.Position
                    local dist = toClone.Magnitude
                    local dot = (dist > 0.1) and viewerCF.LookVector:Dot(toClone.Unit) or 1

                    if (os.clock() - t0 >= (minNoticeTime or 0.32) and dot >= (lookDotThreshold or 0.84)) or dist < 4.2 then
                        noticedFrames = noticedFrames + 1
                        if noticedFrames >= 3 then
                            cloneObj.SetEyesBloodRed()
                            local twitchStart = os.clock()
                            while os.clock() - twitchStart < 0.14 and cloneObj.Model.Parent and session.Active do
                                local curPos = cloneObj.GetPosition()
                                if rushBeforeVanish and hrp.Parent then
                                    curPos = curPos:Lerp(hrp.Position + (curPos - hrp.Position).Unit * 2.4, 0.38)
                                end
                                local snapCF = CFrame.lookAt(curPos, Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, curPos.Y, hrp.Position.Z))
                                cloneObj.SetPose(snapCF, lookTarget, math.rad(math.random(-48, 48)), 0.35)
                                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                            end
                            local vanishPos = cloneObj.GetPosition()
                            if cloneObj.Model and cloneObj.Model.Parent then
                                cloneObj.Model:Destroy()
                            end
                            triggerVanishHorrorFlash(vanishPos, rushBeforeVanish)
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        noticedFrames = 0
                    end

                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                end
                if cloneObj.Model and cloneObj.Model.Parent then
                    cloneObj.Model:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end

        local function runOneScenario(forcedSc, forcedAngleBucket)
            if not session.Active then return end
            local char = targetPlr.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then return end

            local sc = forcedSc
            local angleBucket = forcedAngleBucket
            if not sc then
                local pool = {}
                for i = 1, 8 do
                    if i ~= session.LastScenario then table.insert(pool, i) end
                end
                sc = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
                angleBucket = math.random(0, 35)
                -- Broadcast this exact hallucination wave over P2P so every peer renders the identical clones around targetPlr!
                Engine.BroadcastHallucinationWaveP2P(targetPlr, sc, angleBucket)
            end
            session.LastScenario = sc
            session.LastWaveClock = os.clock()
            session.Escalation = math.min(2.5, session.Escalation + 0.12)

            if whisperSound then pcall(function() whisperSound:Play() end) end
            local seedIdx = (angleBucket % 8) + 1

            if sc == 1 then
                local angle = (angleBucket % 2 == 0) and (-28 - (angleBucket % 10)) or (28 + (angleBucket % 10))
                local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 13, angle)
                local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, "PALE_STALKER", seedIdx)
                watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 7.5, 0.90, 0.38, false)

            elseif sc == 2 then
                for idx, sideAngle in ipairs({ -72, 72 }) do
                    local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 9, sideAngle)
                    local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, "SHADOW_CORPSE", seedIdx + idx)
                    watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 8.5, 0.82, 0.22, false)
                end

            elseif sc == 3 then
                local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 17, (angleBucket % 15) - 7)
                local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, "BLOOD_GLITCH", seedIdx)
                watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 6.5, 0.92, 0.45, true)

            elseif sc == 4 then
                for i = 1, 4 do
                    local ang = (i - 1) * 90 + ((angleBucket % 12) - 6)
                    local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 13, ang)
                    local style = (i % 2 == 0) and "PALE_STALKER" or "SHADOW_CORPSE"
                    local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, style, seedIdx + i)
                    watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 9.0, 0.85, 0.30, i == 2)
                end

            elseif sc == 5 then
                local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 7, 180 + ((angleBucket % 16) - 8))
                local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, "BLOOD_GLITCH", seedIdx)
                watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 8.0, 0.78, 0.15, true)

            elseif sc == 6 then
                local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 21, (angleBucket % 2 == 0) and -45 or 45)
                local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, "SHADOW_CORPSE", seedIdx)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while os.clock() - t0 < 7.5 and cloneObj.Model and cloneObj.Model.Parent and session.Active do
                        local cPos = cloneObj.GetPosition()
                        local cam = (targetPlr == LocalPlayer) and Workspace.CurrentCamera or nil
                        local viewerCF = cam and cam.CFrame or hrp.CFrame
                        local toClone = cPos - viewerCF.Position
                        local dot = (toClone.Magnitude > 0.1) and viewerCF.LookVector:Dot(toClone.Unit) or 1
                        if dot < 0.55 and toClone.Magnitude > 5.0 then
                            local stepDir = (hrp.Position - cPos).Unit
                            local nextPos = Vector3.new(cPos.X + stepDir.X * 0.25, cPos.Y, cPos.Z + stepDir.Z * 0.25)
                            cloneObj.SetPose(CFrame.lookAt(nextPos, Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, nextPos.Y, hrp.Position.Z)), hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), math.rad(18), 0.02)
                        end
                        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    end
                end)
                watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 7.5, 0.85, 0.25, true)

            elseif sc == 7 then
                local runnerStart = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 14, -42)
                local runnerEnd = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 14, 42)
                local runnerClone = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(runnerStart, "SHADOW_CORPSE", seedIdx)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while os.clock() - t0 < 0.75 and runnerClone.Model and runnerClone.Model.Parent and session.Active do
                        local a = (os.clock() - t0) / 0.75
                        local curPos = runnerStart.Position:Lerp(runnerEnd.Position, a)
                        local runCF = CFrame.lookAt(curPos, runnerEnd.Position + (runnerEnd.Position - runnerStart.Position))
                        runnerClone.SetPose(runCF, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), math.rad(-25), 0.08)
                        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    end
                    if runnerClone.Model and runnerClone.Model.Parent then runnerClone.Model:Destroy() end
                end)
                local sideCF = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 8, 58)
                local watcherClone = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(sideCF, "PALE_STALKER", seedIdx + 1)
                watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(watcherClone, 7.0, 0.84, 0.25, false)

            elseif sc == 8 then
                local cf = getSmartGroundHallucinationCF(hrp, 10, (angleBucket % 24) - 12)
                local cloneObj = spawnServerPlayerHorrorClone(cf, "BLOOD_GLITCH", seedIdx)
                watchPlayerAndVanishOnLook(cloneObj, 6.0, 0.88, 0.35, true)
                if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and hum and hum.Parent then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local tPulse = os.clock()
                        while os.clock() - tPulse < 0.85 and session.Active and hum.Parent do
                            hum:Move(Vector3.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1)), true)
                            task.wait(0.14)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        session.RunScenarioFromP2P = function(sc, angleBucket)
            if not session.Active then return end
            -- Avoid duplicate execution if local loop just fired within 0.8s
            if os.clock() - (session.LastWaveClock or 0) < 0.8 then return end
            pcall(function() runOneScenario(sc, angleBucket) end)
        end

        -- Authoritative wave scheduler: runs on targetPlr's client (or on initiator's client if targetPlr hasn't sent waves)
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(1.2)
            while session.Active do
                if not targetPlr.Parent then break end
                local isTargetSelf = (targetPlr == LocalPlayer)
                local timeSinceLastWave = os.clock() - (session.LastWaveClock or 0)
                if isTargetSelf or (session.InitiatedByLocal and timeSinceLastWave >= 4.2) then
                    pcall(function() runOneScenario(nil, nil) end)
                end
                local minW = math.max(3, math.floor(6 / (session.Intensity * session.Escalation)))
                local maxW = math.max(minW + 3, math.floor(13 / (session.Intensity * session.Escalation)))
                local waitSec = math.random(minW, maxW)
                local el = 0
                while el < waitSec and session.Active do
                    task.wait(0.4)
                    el = el + 0.4
                end
            end
        end)

        session.Cleanup = function()
            session.Active = false
            for _, c in ipairs(session.Connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            for _, obj in ipairs(session.SpawnedObjects) do
                if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
            end
            if targetPlr == LocalPlayer then
                pcall(function()
                    targetPlr.CameraMode = session.SavedCameraMode or Enum.CameraMode.Classic
                    if Workspace.CurrentCamera then Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = session.SavedFOV or 70 end
                end)
            end
        end

        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification(
                "👁 HALLUCINATIONS (P2P SYNC)",
                UI.Tr(
                    pName .. " için Korkunç Sunucu Klonlu Halüsinasyonlar başlatıldı! (Etrafındaki klonlar P2P senkronize şekilde her iki ekranda da görünür ve bakınca kaybolur)",
                    "Terrifying Server-Player Clone Hallucinations started for " .. pName .. "! (Synchronized across all P2P screens)"
                ),
                Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
                4.5
            )
        end
    end

    -- ========================================================================
    -- 8. NEW COMMAND: HALLUCINATIONSHOSPITAL ("hallucinationshospital <isim>")
    -- Procedural Abandoned Horror Hospital + 30s Exploration + 2x Hallucinations
    -- + Poltergeist Doors, Tipping Chairs, Lockers & Flickering Lights (Full P2P!)
    -- ========================================================================
    function Engine.ToggleHallucinationsHospitalSystem(targetPlr)
        if not targetPlr then return end
        local pName = targetPlr.Name
        local existing = State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName]
        local isForceOff = State.LastInvokedAlias and string.sub(State.LastInvokedAlias, 1, 2) == "un"
        if (existing and existing.Active) or isForceOff then
            if existing and existing.Cleanup then pcall(existing.Cleanup) end
            State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName] = nil
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    "HORROR HOSPITAL",
                    UI.Tr(pName .. " Korku Hastanesinden çıkarıldı ve eski konumuna döndürüldü.", pName .. " returned from the Horror Hospital and all instances were cleaned up."),
                    Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
                    4
                )
            end
            return
        end

        local char = targetPlr.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        local hSession = {
            Active = true,
            InitiatedByLocal = not State.IsExecutingFromP2P,
            OriginCF = hrp.CFrame,
            Doors = {},
            Props = {},
            Lights = {}
        }
        State.P2PV6.HospitalSessions[pName] = hSession

        local basePos = Vector3.new(3500, 850, 3500 + (targetPlr.UserId % 400) * 15)
        local hospModel = Instance.new("Model")
        hospModel.Name = "BerksHorrorHospital_" .. pName
        hospModel.Parent = Workspace
        hSession.Model = hospModel

        local function addPart(name, size, cf, col, mat)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = name
            p.Size = size
            p.CFrame = cf
            p.Anchored = true
            p.Color = col
            p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Concrete
            p.Parent = hospModel
            return p
        end

        local wallCol = Color3.fromRGB(42, 48, 46)
        local floorCol = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 34)
        addPart("CorridorFloor", Vector3.new(56, 2, 180), CFrame.new(basePos), floorCol, Enum.Material.Slate)
        addPart("CorridorCeiling", Vector3.new(56, 2, 180), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 16, 0)), wallCol, Enum.Material.Concrete)
        addPart("WallWest", Vector3.new(2, 16, 180), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(-28, 8, 0)), wallCol, Enum.Material.Concrete)
        addPart("WallEast", Vector3.new(2, 16, 180), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(28, 8, 0)), wallCol, Enum.Material.Concrete)
        addPart("WallNorth", Vector3.new(56, 16, 2), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 8, -90)), wallCol, Enum.Material.Concrete)
        addPart("WallSouth", Vector3.new(56, 16, 2), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 8, 90)), wallCol, Enum.Material.Concrete)
        addPart("NurseStation", Vector3.new(10, 4.2, 14), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 3, -10)), Color3.fromRGB(55, 45, 40), Enum.Material.Wood)

        for i = -3, 2 do
            local zPos = i * 26 + 12
            for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                local doorX = side * 9
                local roomX = side * 18
                local closedCF = CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(doorX, 5.5, zPos))
                local openCF = closedCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(side * 78), 0)
                local door = addPart("RoomDoor", Vector3.new(0.6, 9, 5.5), closedCF, Color3.fromRGB(68, 52, 42), Enum.Material.Wood)
                table.insert(hSession.Doors, { Part = door, ClosedCF = closedCF, OpenCF = openCF, IsOpen = false })

                local chair = addPart("HospitalChair", Vector3.new(2.6, 3.2, 2.6), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(roomX - side * 2, 2.6, zPos + 4)), Color3.fromRGB(65, 50, 42), Enum.Material.Wood)
                table.insert(hSession.Props, { Part = chair, BaseCF = chair.CFrame, Type = "Chair" })

                local bed = addPart("PatientBed", Vector3.new(7, 2.4, 4.2), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(roomX + side * 3, 2.2, zPos - 4)), Color3.fromRGB(90, 95, 100), Enum.Material.Metal)
                table.insert(hSession.Props, { Part = bed, BaseCF = bed.CFrame, Type = "Bed" })
            end
            local fix = addPart("LightFixture", Vector3.new(4, 0.4, 1.5), CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 14.8, zPos)), Color3.fromRGB(215, 235, 225), Enum.Material.Neon)
            local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
            pl.Brightness = 1.1
            pl.Range = 28
            pl.Parent = fix
            table.insert(hSession.Lights, { Fixture = fix, Light = pl })
        end

        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 72))
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification(
                "HORROR HOSPITAL",
                UI.Tr(pName .. " Terk Edilmiş Korku Hastanesine ışınlandı! (30 sn keşif süresi başladı)", pName .. " teleported to the Abandoned Horror Hospital! (30s exploration phase started)"),
                Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
                5
            )
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local t0 = os.clock()
            local phase2 = false
            while hSession.Active do
                if not targetPlr.Parent then break end
                if os.clock() - t0 >= 30 and not phase2 then
                    phase2 = true
                    Engine.ToggleHallucinationsSystem(targetPlr, 2.0)
                    if UI.SendNotification then
                        UI.SendNotification(
                            "HORROR HOSPITAL — 2X",
                            UI.Tr("30 saniye doldu! 2 kat yoğun halüsinasyonlar ve poltergeist olaylar başladı!", "30s elapsed! 2x intensity hallucinations and poltergeist objects triggered!"),
                            Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
                            5
                        )
                    end
                end
                if #hSession.Lights > 0 then
                    local l = hSession.Lights[math.random(1, #hSession.Lights)]
                    if l and l.Light then l.Light.Enabled = (math.random() > (phase2 and 0.5 or 0.2)) end
                end
                if phase2 then
                    if #hSession.Doors > 0 then
                        local d = hSession.Doors[math.random(1, #hSession.Doors)]
                        if d and d.Part and d.Part.Parent then
                            d.IsOpen = not d.IsOpen
                            TweenService:Create(d.Part, TweenInfo.new(0.45), { CFrame = d.IsOpen and d.OpenCF or d.ClosedCF }):Play()
                        end
                    end
                    if #hSession.Props > 0 then
                        local pr = hSession.Props[math.random(1, #hSession.Props)]
                        if pr and pr.Part and pr.Part.Parent then
                            local targetCF = CFrame.new(basePos.X + math.random(-4, 4), pr.BaseCF.Y - 0.5, pr.BaseCF.Z) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(80), math.rad(math.random(-50, 50)), 0)
                            TweenService:Create(pr.Part, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { CFrame = targetCF }):Play()
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(phase2 and 1.8 or 3.0)
            end
        end)

        hSession.Cleanup = function()
            hSession.Active = false
            local hal = State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName]
            if hal and hal.Cleanup then
                pcall(hal.Cleanup)
                State.P2PV6.HallucinationSessions[pName] = nil
            end
            if hSession.Model and hSession.Model.Parent then hSession.Model:Destroy() end
            local c = targetPlr.Character
            local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if r and hSession.OriginCF then r.CFrame = hSession.OriginCF end
        end
    end

    -- ========================================================================
    -- 9. UNIFIED DISPATCHER FOR THE 50 CATEGORIZED COMMANDS (FULL P2P SYNC!)
    -- Real functionality, parameter checks, conflict checks, instance cleanup & safe restore
    -- ========================================================================
    local function runThemedMorph(st, targetPlr, cmdName, col1, col2, mat, spd, jmp, hasWings)
        local char = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not hrp or not hum then return end
        Engine.ResolveTransformationConflict(targetPlr, cmdName)
        Engine.RegisterTransformationCleanup(targetPlr, cmdName, st.Cleanup)
        local origSpd, origJmp = hum.WalkSpeed, hum.JumpPower
        hum.WalkSpeed = spd
        hum.JumpPower = jmp
        st.OnRestore = function()
            if hum and hum.Parent then
                hum.WalkSpeed = origSpd
                hum.JumpPower = origJmp
            end
        end
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.FillColor = col1
        hl.OutlineColor = col2
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.25
        hl.Parent = char
        table.insert(st.Instances, hl)

        local core = Instance.new("Part")
        core.Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 3.6, 2.2)
        core.Color = col1
        core.Material = mat
        core.Anchored = true
        core.CanCollide = false
        core.Parent = char
        table.insert(st.Instances, core)

        local ring = Instance.new("Part")
        ring.Size = Vector3.new(7, 0.25, 7)
        ring.Color = col2
        ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        ring.Anchored = true
        ring.CanCollide = false
        ring.Parent = char
        Instance.new("CylinderMesh", ring)
        table.insert(st.Instances, ring)

        local wingL, wingR
        if hasWings then
            wingL = Instance.new("Part")
            wingL.Size = Vector3.new(6.5, 4.2, 0.4)
            wingL.Color = col2
            wingL.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            wingL.Anchored = true
            wingL.CanCollide = false
            wingL.Parent = char
            wingR = wingL:Clone()
            wingR.Parent = char
            table.insert(st.Instances, wingL)
            table.insert(st.Instances, wingR)
        end

        local t = 0
        table.insert(st.Connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not hrp.Parent then return end
            t = t + dt * 3.5
            core.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0)
            ring.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2.7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t, 0)
            if wingL and wingR then
                local flap = math.sin(t * 1.8) * math.rad(28)
                wingL.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(-3.8, 1.2, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, flap, math.rad(15))
                wingR.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(3.8, 1.2, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, -flap, math.rad(-15))
            end
        end))
    end

    -- Synchronized Visual + Physics Ability Pulse for grappleswing (1), airdash (2), groundslam (3), chronoshift (4)
    function Engine.ExecuteV6AbilityVisualPulse(targetPlr, abilityCode, fromP2P)
        local char = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
        if not fromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastV6AbilityPulseP2P(targetPlr, abilityCode)
        end
        local isSelf = (targetPlr == LocalPlayer)
        local cam = isSelf and Workspace.CurrentCamera or nil
        local dir = (cam and cam.CFrame.LookVector) or hrp.CFrame.LookVector

        if abilityCode == 1 then
            -- GrappleSwing Pulse
            local beam = Instance.new("Part")
            beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 48)
            beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position + dir * 24, hrp.Position + dir * 48)
            beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
            beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            beam.Anchored = true
            beam.CanCollide = false
            beam.Parent = Workspace
            TweenService:Create(beam, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(beam, 0.38)
            if isSelf then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * 125 + Vector3.new(0, 48, 0)
            end
        elseif abilityCode == 2 then
            -- AirDash Pulse
            local ring = Instance.new("Part")
            ring.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.4, 2)
            ring.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
            ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
            ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            ring.Anchored = true
            ring.CanCollide = false
            ring.Parent = Workspace
            Instance.new("CylinderMesh", ring)
            TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.45), { Size = Vector3.new(16, 0.2, 16), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.48)
            if isSelf then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * 135 + Vector3.new(0, 24, 0)
            end
        elseif abilityCode == 3 then
            -- GroundSlam Pulse
            task.spawn(function()
                if isSelf then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 85, 0)
                end
                task.wait(0.28)
                if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
                if isSelf then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -185, 0)
                end
                task.wait(0.26)
                if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
                local wave = Instance.new("Part")
                wave.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.5, 4)
                wave.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2.6, 0)
                wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22)
                wave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                wave.Anchored = true
                wave.CanCollide = false
                wave.Parent = Workspace
                Instance.new("CylinderMesh", wave)
                TweenService:Create(wave, TweenInfo.new(0.55), { Size = Vector3.new(34, 0.3, 34), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                Debris:AddItem(wave, 0.6)
            end)
        elseif abilityCode == 4 then
            -- ChronoShift Flash
            local flash = Instance.new("Part")
            flash.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            flash.Size = Vector3.new(3.5, 3.5, 3.5)
            flash.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
            flash.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
            flash.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            flash.Anchored = true
            flash.CanCollide = false
            flash.Parent = Workspace
            TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(flash, 0.45)
        end
    end

    function Engine.V6_RunCommand(cmdName, targetPlr, args)
        local pName = V6GlobalEnvCommands[cmdName] and "GLOBAL" or (targetPlr and targetPlr.Name or "GLOBAL")
        local toggleKey = cmdName .. "_" .. pName
        local existing = State.P2PV6.ActiveToggles[toggleKey]
        local invokedAlias = State.LastInvokedAlias or ""
        local isUnAlias = (string.sub(invokedAlias, 1, 2) == "un" and invokedAlias ~= cmdName)

        -- Instant non-toggle commands (Full FE P2P Compatible!)
        if cmdName == "swapplaces" then
            -- When received via P2P, targetPlr is LocalPlayer and CurrentP2PSender is the sender who initiated the swap!
            local peerPlr = (targetPlr == LocalPlayer and State.CurrentP2PSender) or targetPlr
            if peerPlr and peerPlr.Character and LocalPlayer.Character then
                local h1 = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h2 = peerPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if h1 and h2 then
                    local tmp = h1.CFrame
                    h1.CFrame = h2.CFrame
                    h2.CFrame = tmp
                end
            end
            return
        elseif cmdName == "chainblink" then
            local hrp = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character and targetPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local orig = hrp.CFrame
                    for i = 1, 5 do
                        local stepCF = orig * CFrame.new(((i % 2 == 0) and 6 or -6), 1.5, -i * 10)
                        local ghost = Instance.new("Part")
                        ghost.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 5.2, 1.2)
                        ghost.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
                        ghost.Anchored = true
                        ghost.CanCollide = false
                        ghost.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                        ghost.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        ghost.Transparency = 0.35
                        ghost.Parent = Workspace
                        TweenService:Create(ghost, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                        Debris:AddItem(ghost, 0.38)
                        if targetPlr == LocalPlayer or not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
                            hrp.CFrame = stepCF
                        end
                        task.wait(0.07)
                    end
                end)
            end
            return
        elseif cmdName == "temprank" then
            if not targetPlr then return end
            local reqTier = tonumber(args and (args[2] or args[1])) or 3
            local durSec = math.clamp(tonumber(args and (args[3] or args[2])) or 60, 5, 3600)
            if reqTier >= 10 and not Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) then reqTier = 5 end
            local prevLvl = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(targetPlr)
            Engine.SetPlayerRankInTable(targetPlr, reqTier)
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification("TEMPRANK", string.format("%s -> Tier %d (%ds)", targetPlr.Name, reqTier, durSec), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3.5)
            end
            task.delay(durSec, function()
                if targetPlr and targetPlr.Parent then
                    Engine.SetPlayerRankInTable(targetPlr, prevLvl)
                end
            end)
            return
        elseif cmdName == "snapshotstate" then
            local snap = { ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime, Gravity = Workspace.Gravity, Players = {} }
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local r = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if r then
                    snap.Players[p.Name] = { CFrame = r.CFrame, Health = h and h.Health or 100 }
                end
            end
            State.P2PV6.Snapshots["latest"] = snap
            if UI.SendNotification then UI.SendNotification("SNAPSHOT", UI.Tr("Sunucu durumu kaydedildi.", "Server state snapshot saved."), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3) end
            return
        elseif cmdName == "restoresnapshot" then
            local snap = State.P2PV6.Snapshots["latest"]
            if snap then
                Lighting.ClockTime = snap.ClockTime or 14
                Workspace.Gravity = snap.Gravity or 196.2
                for n, data in pairs(snap.Players or {}) do
                    local p = Players:FindFirstChild(n)
                    local r = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local h = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if r and data.CFrame then r.CFrame = data.CFrame end
                    if h and data.Health then h.Health = data.Health end

            elseif UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification("SNAPSHOT", UI.Tr("Henüz kaydedilmiş bir snapshot yok! Önce ;snapshotstate kullanın.", "No snapshot saved yet! Run ;snapshotstate first."), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 3)
            end
            return
        end

            return
