    local prevExecuteCommandStringV6 = UI.ExecuteCommandString
    UI.ExecuteCommandString = function(rawInput)
        local activePfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
        local clean = tostring(rawInput or "")
        local usedPfx = ""
        if string.sub(clean, 1, #activePfx) == activePfx then
            usedPfx = activePfx
            clean = string.sub(clean, #activePfx + 1)
        elseif string.sub(clean, 1, 1) == ";" then
            usedPfx = ";"
            clean = string.sub(clean, 2)
        end
        clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        local tokens = string.split(clean, " ")
        if #tokens >= 2 then
            local twoWord = string.lower(tokens[1] .. " " .. tokens[2])
            local mapped = MultiWordCommandMap[twoWord]
            if mapped then
                local rest = {}
                for i = 3, #tokens do
                    table.insert(rest, tokens[i])
                end
                local rebuilt = usedPfx .. mapped .. (#rest > 0 and (" " .. table.concat(rest, " ")) or "")
                return prevExecuteCommandStringV6(rebuilt)
            end
        end
        return prevExecuteCommandStringV6(rawInput)
    end
    Engine.ExecuteCommandString = UI.ExecuteCommandString

    -- [10.B] PER-PLAYER (<ISIM>) VS ALL ESP, TRACERS, BOXESP, NAMEESP, HEALTHESP, CHAMS
    State.V6ESP = {
        Targets = {
            ESP = {},
            Tracers = {},
            BoxESP = {},
            NameESP = {},
            HealthESP = {},
            Chams = {}
        },
        AllMode = {
            ESP = false,
            Tracers = false,
            BoxESP = false,
            NameESP = false,
            HealthESP = false,
            Chams = false
        },
        TracerLines2D = {},
        BoxFrames2D = {},
        BoxAdornments3D = {},
        Billboards = {}
    }

    function Engine.ResolveESPFilterPlayers(rawArg, fallbackTargetPlr)
        local sel = string.lower( string.gsub(tostring(rawArg or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") )
        if sel == "" or sel == "all" or sel == "herkes" or sel == "others" or sel == "digerleri" or sel == "*" then
            local list = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                    table.insert(list, p)
                end
            end
            return true, list, "ALL"
        end
        if sel == "me" or sel == "ben" then
            return false, { LocalPlayer }, LocalPlayer.Name
        end
        local matched = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local uLow = string.lower(p.Name)
            local dLow = string.lower(p.DisplayName or p.Name)
            if uLow == sel or dLow == sel or string.sub(uLow, 1, #sel) == sel or string.sub(dLow, 1, #sel) == sel or string.find(uLow, sel, 1, true) or string.find(dLow, sel, 1, true) then
                table.insert(matched, p)
            end
        end
        if #matched == 0 and fallbackTargetPlr and fallbackTargetPlr ~= LocalPlayer then
            table.insert(matched, fallbackTargetPlr)
        end
        local labelNames = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(matched) do table.insert(labelNames, p.Name) end
        return false, matched, (#labelNames > 0 and table.concat(labelNames, ", ") or sel)
    end

    function Engine.CleanupSinglePlayerESPVisuals(pName)
        local espState = State.V6ESP
        if espState.TracerLines2D[pName] then
            pcall(function() espState.TracerLines2D[pName].Line:Destroy() end)
            pcall(function() espState.TracerLines2D[pName].Dot:Destroy() end)
            pcall(function() espState.TracerLines2D[pName].Label:Destroy() end)
            espState.TracerLines2D[pName] = nil
        end
        if espState.BoxFrames2D[pName] then
            pcall(function() espState.BoxFrames2D[pName]:Destroy() end)
            espState.BoxFrames2D[pName] = nil
        end
        if espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName] then
            pcall(function() espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName]:Destroy() end)
            espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName] = nil
        end
        if espState.Billboards[pName] then
            pcall(function() espState.Billboards[pName].Gui:Destroy() end)
            espState.Billboards[pName] = nil
        end
        local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
        if p and p.Character then
            local hl = p.Character:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_ESP_Highlight")
            if hl then pcall(function() hl:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end

    function Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature(featureKey, plr)
        if not plr then return false end
        local espState = State.V6ESP
        if espState.AllMode[featureKey] then
            return plr ~= LocalPlayer
        end
        return espState.Targets[featureKey] and espState.Targets[featureKey][plr.Name] == true
    end

    function Engine.SetESPFeatureForTarget(featureKey, enable, rawArg, fallbackTargetPlr, isToggleCmd)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then return end
        local espState = State.V6ESP
        local isAll, matchedList, labelStr = Engine.ResolveESPFilterPlayers(rawArg, fallbackTargetPlr)

        if isAll then
            local finalEnable = enable
            if isToggleCmd and enable == nil then
                finalEnable = not espState.AllMode[featureKey]
            end
            espState.AllMode[featureKey] = finalEnable
            espState.Targets[featureKey] = {}
            if finalEnable then
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                        espState.Targets[featureKey][p.Name] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    string.upper(featureKey) .. " [ALL]",
                    finalEnable and UI.Tr("Tüm oyuncular (ALL) için " .. featureKey .. " aktif edildi!", featureKey .. " enabled for ALL players!")
                        or UI.Tr("Tüm oyuncular (ALL) için " .. featureKey .. " kapatıldı!", featureKey .. " disabled for ALL players!"),
                    finalEnable and Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248) or Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184),
                    2.8
                )
            end
        else
            if #matchedList == 0 then
                if UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        string.upper(featureKey),
                        UI.Tr("Oyuncu bulunamadı: " .. tostring(rawArg), "Player not found: " .. tostring(rawArg)),
                        Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
                        2.8
                    )
                end
                return
            end
            local anyEnabled = false
            for _, p in ipairs(matchedList) do
                local curOn = espState.AllMode[featureKey] or (espState.Targets[featureKey][p.Name] == true)
                local targetOn = enable
                if isToggleCmd and enable == nil then
                    targetOn = not curOn
                end
                if not targetOn and espState.AllMode[featureKey] then
                    -- Converting from ALL mode to specific players minus this one
                    espState.AllMode[featureKey] = false
                    for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if other ~= LocalPlayer and other ~= p then
                            espState.Targets[featureKey][other.Name] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                espState.Targets[featureKey][p.Name] = targetOn and true or nil
                if targetOn then anyEnabled = true end
            end
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    string.upper(featureKey) .. " [" .. labelStr .. "]",
                    anyEnabled and UI.Tr(labelStr .. " için " .. featureKey .. " aktif edildi!", featureKey .. " enabled for " .. labelStr .. "!")
                        or UI.Tr(labelStr .. " için " .. featureKey .. " kapatıldı!", featureKey .. " disabled for " .. labelStr .. "!"),
                    anyEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128) or Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184),
                    2.8
                )
            end
        end

        -- Sync legacy flags for backward compatibility
        State.ESP = espState.AllMode.ESP or (next(espState.Targets.ESP) ~= nil)
        State.Tracers = espState.AllMode.Tracers or (next(espState.Targets.Tracers) ~= nil)
        State.BoxESP = espState.AllMode.BoxESP or (next(espState.Targets.BoxESP) ~= nil)
        State.NameESP = espState.AllMode.NameESP or (next(espState.Targets.NameESP) ~= nil)
        State.HealthESP = espState.AllMode.HealthESP or (next(espState.Targets.HealthESP) ~= nil)
        State.Chams = espState.AllMode.Chams or (next(espState.Targets.Chams) ~= nil)
    end

    end

            end
        end

    -- [10.C] FULL 3D GRAVITATIONAL BLACK HOLE SINGULARITY ("blackhole [isim]" / "black hole [isim]" / "unblackhole")
    -- Features:
    -- * 3D Dark Event Horizon Sphere + Rotating Neon Accretion Disk + Swirling Particle Vortex + Relativistic Jets
    -- * Pulls all unanchored Workspace parts into a high-speed swirling orbital vortex around the Black Hole
    -- * Pulls nearby players toward the singularity (FE network compatible)
    -- * Full P2P Synchronization across all peers
    -- * On-Screen Mobile Touch & PC Control Bar (Tap-to-Move Singularity, Supernova Burst, Toggle Follow/Free, Close)
    State.BlackHoleSession = nil

    function Engine.StopBlackHolePartAttractor()
        State.BlackHoleActive = false
        State.BlackHoleTarget = nil
        if State.BlackHoleSession then
            local s = State.BlackHoleSession
            State.BlackHoleSession = nil
            s.Active = false
            for _, conn in ipairs(s.Connections or {}) do
                pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
            end
            for bp, forces in pairs(s.CapturedParts or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                    if forces.BP and forces.BP.Parent then forces.BP:Destroy() end
                    if forces.BG and forces.BG.Parent then forces.BG:Destroy() end
                    if bp and bp.Parent then bp.CanCollide = true end
                end)
            end
            if s.HudBar and s.HudBar.Parent then
                pcall(function() s.HudBar:Destroy() end)
            end
            if s.Model and s.Model.Parent then
                pcall(function() s.Model:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        if UI.SendNotification and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            UI.SendNotification(
                "⚫ BLACK HOLE",
                UI.Tr("Karadelik tekilliği kapatıldı ve çekilen parçalar serbest bırakıldı.", "Black Hole singularity closed and all captured parts released."),
                Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184),
                3.0
            )
        end
    end

    Engine.StartBlackHolePartAttractor = function(targetPlayer)

            Engine.StopBlackHolePartAttractor()

        end

        if State.BlackHoleSession then
            Engine.StopBlackHolePartAttractor()
        end

        local tPlr = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        State.BlackHoleActive = true
        State.BlackHoleTarget = tPlr
        Engine.MaximizeNetworkSimulationRadius()

        local tChar = tPlr.Character
        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local startPos = (tHrp and (tHrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 14, -18))) or Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)

        local function scanWorkspaceUnanchoredParts()
            if not session.Active then return end
            Engine.MaximizeNetworkSimulationRadius()
            local count = 0
            for _, p in pairs( session.CapturedParts ) do
                count = count + 1
            end
            for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if count >= 85 then break end
                if desc:IsA("BasePart") and not desc.Anchored and not session.CapturedParts[desc] then
                    local isPlayerChar = false
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if plr.Character and desc:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
                            isPlayerChar = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not isPlayerChar and not desc:IsDescendantOf(bhModel) and desc.Name ~= "Terrain" then
                        local bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
                        bp.Name = "BerksBH_BodyPos"
                        bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
                        bp.P = 25000
                        bp.D = 900
                        bp.Position = session.CorePos
                        bp.Parent = desc

                        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
                        bg.Name = "BerksBH_BodyGyro"
                        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
                        bg.P = 12000
                        bg.Parent = desc

                        desc.CanCollide = false
                        session.CapturedParts[desc] = {
                            BP = bp,
                            BG = bg,
                            OrbitRadius = math.random(9, 26),
                            OrbitSpeed = 2.4 + math.random() * 3.2,
                            OrbitPhase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
                            OrbitHeight = (math.random() - 0.5) * 10
                        }
                        count = count + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        scanWorkspaceUnanchoredParts()

        local function triggerSupernovaExplosion()
            if not session.Active then return end
            PlayUiSound("fling")
            local flash = Instance.new("Part")
            flash.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            flash.Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
            flash.CFrame = CFrame.new(session.CorePos)
            flash.Color = Color3.fromRGB(251, 146, 60)
            flash.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            flash.Anchored = true
            flash.CanCollide = false
            flash.Parent = Workspace
            TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = Vector3.new(65, 65, 65),
                Transparency = 1
            }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(flash, 0.6)

            for bp, info in pairs(session.CapturedParts) do
                if bp and bp.Parent then
                    if info.BP and info.BP.Parent then info.BP:Destroy() end
                    if info.BG and info.BG.Parent then info.BG:Destroy() end
                    local outDir = (bp.Position - session.CorePos)
                    if outDir.Magnitude < 0.5 then outDir = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) end
                    bp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = outDir.Unit * 240 + Vector3.new(0, 65, 0)
                end
            end
            session.CapturedParts = {}
            task.delay(1.2, function()
                if session.Active then scanWorkspaceUnanchoredParts() end
            end)
        end

            btnClose.Position = UDim2.new(0.78, 3, 0, 5)

                session.FollowTarget = not session.FollowTarget
                if session.FollowTarget then session.TouchMoveMode = false end
                btnFollow.Text = session.FollowTarget and UI.Tr("🔄 Hedefi Takip: AÇIK", "🔄 Follow Target: ON") or UI.Tr("🔄 Hedefi Takip: KAPALI", "🔄 Follow Target: OFF")
                btnFollow.BackgroundColor3 = session.FollowTarget and Color3.fromRGB(109, 40, 217) or Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85)
                btnTapMove.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 58, 138)
            end)

            btnTapMove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                session.TouchMoveMode = not session.TouchMoveMode
                if session.TouchMoveMode then
                    session.FollowTarget = false
                    btnFollow.Text = UI.Tr("🔄 Hedefi Takip: KAPALI", "🔄 Follow Target: OFF")
                    btnFollow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85)
                end

                btnTapMove.Text = session.TouchMoveMode and UI.Tr("🎯 Ekrana Dokun!", "🎯 Tap Screen!") or UI.Tr("🎯 Dokunarak Taşı", "🎯 Tap-to-Move")

                if gp or not session.Active or not session.TouchMoveMode then return end
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if cam then
                        local pos2D = inp.Position
                        local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(pos2D.X, pos2D.Y)
                        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
                        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { bhModel, LocalPlayer.Character }
                        local res = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 450, rp)
                        local hitPos = (res and (res.Position + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0))) or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 45)
                        session.CorePos = hitPos
                    end
                end
            end)
            table.insert(session.Connections, inputConn)
        end

        local rotAngle = 0
        local lastRescan = os.clock()
        local bhConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not session.Active or not State.BlackHoleActive then
                Engine.StopBlackHolePartAttractor()
                return
            end
            rotAngle = rotAngle + dt * 4.5
            if os.clock() - lastRescan >= 2.2 then
                lastRescan = os.clock()
                scanWorkspaceUnanchoredParts()
            end

            local tgt = State.BlackHoleTarget or LocalPlayer
            local tgtHrp = tgt and tgt.Character and tgt.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if session.FollowTarget and tgtHrp then
                local desiredPos = tgtHrp.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(rotAngle * 0.35) * 14, 15, math.sin(rotAngle * 0.35) * 14)
                session.CorePos = session.CorePos:Lerp(desiredPos, math.clamp(dt * 6, 0, 1))
            end

            local cPos = session.CorePos
            core.CFrame = CFrame.new(cPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, rotAngle, 0)
            local pulse = 13.0 + math.sin(rotAngle * 2.5) * 1.1
            photonRing.Size = Vector3.new(pulse, pulse, pulse)
            photonRing.CFrame = CFrame.new(cPos) * CFrame.Angles(rotAngle * 0.7, -rotAngle, 0)
            diskInner.CFrame = CFrame.new(cPos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(16), rotAngle * 1.8, math.rad(-10))
            diskOuter.CFrame = CFrame.new(cPos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(16), -rotAngle * 1.1, math.rad(-10))

            for i, sh in ipairs(shards) do
                local a = rotAngle * 2.2 + (i * math.pi * 2 / #shards)
                sh.CFrame = CFrame.new(cPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 14, math.sin(rotAngle * 3 + i) * 3.5, math.sin(a) * 14))
            end

            -- Swirl all captured unanchored parts around the Black Hole singularity
            for bp, info in pairs(session.CapturedParts) do
                if not bp or not bp.Parent or bp.Anchored then
                    if info.BP and info.BP.Parent then info.BP:Destroy() end
                    if info.BG and info.BG.Parent then info.BG:Destroy() end
                    session.CapturedParts[bp] = nil
                else
                    info.OrbitPhase = info.OrbitPhase + dt * info.OrbitSpeed
                    local r = info.OrbitRadius + math.sin(info.OrbitPhase * 0.7) * 3.0
                    local orbitPos = cPos + Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(info.OrbitPhase) * r,
                        info.OrbitHeight + math.cos(info.OrbitPhase * 1.3) * 2.5,
                        math.sin(info.OrbitPhase) * r
                    )
                    if info.BP and info.BP.Parent then
                        info.BP.Position = orbitPos
                    end
                    if info.BG and info.BG.Parent then
                        info.BG.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(info.OrbitPhase, info.OrbitPhase * 0.8, 0)
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Gravitational attraction on players within 55 studs (unless AdminMode immune)
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    if not (State.AdminModePlayers and State.AdminModePlayers[plr.Name]) then
                        local pHrp = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        local toCore = cPos - pHrp.Position
                        local dist = toCore.Magnitude
                        if dist < 55 and dist > 4.5 and (plr ~= LocalPlayer or tgt ~= LocalPlayer) then
                            pHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = pHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity + toCore.Unit * (dt * 78)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(session.Connections, bhConn)

        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification(
                "⚫ BLACK HOLE SINGULARITY",
                UI.Tr(
                    tPlr.Name .. " etrafında 3B Karadelik Tekilliği başlatıldı! (Mobil & PC kontrol çubuğu ile taşıyabilir veya Süpernova patlatabilirsiniz)",
                    "3D Black Hole Singularity active around " .. tPlr.Name .. "! (Use the bottom control bar to move or trigger Supernova)"
                ),
                Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247),
                4.0
            )
        end
    end

    -- [10.D] MOBILE TOUCH UPGRADE FOR BTOOLS, TELEKINESIS, CLICKTP & LASEREYES
    State.MobileLastTouchWorldPos = nil
    State.MobileLastTouchPart = nil

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local p2d = inp.Position
                local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(p2d.X, p2d.Y)
                local rp = RaycastParams.new()
                rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character }
                local res = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 500, rp)
                if res then
                    State.MobileLastTouchWorldPos = res.Position
                    State.MobileLastTouchPart = res.Instance
                else
                    State.MobileLastTouchWorldPos = ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 120
                    State.MobileLastTouchPart = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local function getCrossPlatformAimTargetAndHit()
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled and mouse and mouse.Hit then
            return mouse.Target, mouse.Hit.Position
        end
        if State.MobileLastTouchWorldPos then
            return State.MobileLastTouchPart, State.MobileLastTouchWorldPos
        end
        if cam then
            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character }
            local res = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 500, rp)
            if res then
                return res.Instance, res.Position
            end
            return nil, ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 85
        end
        return nil, Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
    end

    Engine.GiveClientBuildingTools = function()
        for _, mode in ipairs({ "Delete", "Clone", "Move" }) do
            local toolName = "Berk's " .. mode
            local old = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
            tool.Name = toolName
            tool.RequiresHandle = false
            tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                local target, hitPos = getCrossPlatformAimTargetAndHit()
                if not target or not target:IsA("BasePart") or target.Locked then return end
                PlayUiSound("click")
                if mode == "Delete" then
                    target.Parent = nil
                    table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, target)
                elseif mode == "Clone" then
                    local c = target:Clone()
                    c.CFrame = target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, target.Size.Y, 0)
                    c.Parent = Workspace
                elseif mode == "Move" and hitPos then
                    target.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos + Vector3.new(0, target.Size.Y / 2, 0))
                end
            end)
            tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
        end
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification("BTOOLS", UI.Tr("Delete, Clone ve Move araçları çantanıza eklendi (Mobil Dokunma & PC Fare uyumlu).", "Delete, Clone, and Move tools added to Backpack (Mobile Touch & PC compatible)."), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3)
        end
    end

    Engine.GiveTelekinesisTool = function()
        local old = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Berk's Telekinesis")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = "Berk's Telekinesis"
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        local heldPart = nil
        local dist = 16
        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local target, _ = getCrossPlatformAimTargetAndHit()
            if heldPart then
                PlayUiSound("fling")
                if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                    heldPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * 240
                end
                heldPart = nil
            elseif target and target:IsA("BasePart") and not target.Anchored then
                PlayUiSound("command")
                heldPart = target
            end
        end)
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if heldPart and heldPart.Parent and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                heldPart.CFrame = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist)
                heldPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end)
        tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification("TELEKINESIS", UI.Tr("Telekinezi aracı çantanıza eklendi (Parçaya dokunun/tıklayın, fırlatmak için tekrar dokunun).", "Telekinesis tool added to Backpack (Tap/Click part to grab, tap again to throw)."), Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247), 3)
        end
    end

    -- [10.E] IMPLEMENT ALL PREVIOUSLY STUBBED ENGINE FUNCTIONS (RADAR, DEX, REMOTESPY, CHATLOGS, ANTIAFK, ANTIKICK, FIRETOUCHINTERESTS)
    Engine.TriggerAllTouchInterests = function()
        local myHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return end
        local count = 0
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("TouchTransmitter") and v.Parent and v.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                count = count + 1
                if type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
                    pcall(firetouchinterest, myHrp, v.Parent, 0)
                    pcall(firetouchinterest, myHrp, v.Parent, 1)
                else
                    local saved = myHrp.CFrame
                    myHrp.CFrame = v.Parent.CFrame
                    task.delay(0.05, function() if myHrp and myHrp.Parent then myHrp.CFrame = saved end end)
                end
            end
        end
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification("TOUCH INTERESTS", string.format(UI.Tr("%d adet TouchInterest tetiklendi.", "Triggered %d TouchInterests."), count), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 2.8)
        end
    end

    Engine.EnableAntiAFKProtection = function()
        if State.AntiAFKEnabled then return end
        State.AntiAFKEnabled = true

            local vu = cloneref(game:GetService("VirtualUser"))
            LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
                if vu then
                    vu:CaptureController()
                    vu:ClickButton2(Vector2.zero)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification("ANTI-AFK", UI.Tr("20 dakika hareketsizlik koruması (Anti-AFK) aktif edildi!", "Anti-AFK protection enabled!"), Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128), 3)
        end
    end

    Engine.EnableLocalAntiKickHook = function()
        State.AntiKickEnabled = true
        pcall(function()
            if type(hookmetamethod) == "function" and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
                local oldNamecall
                oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
                    local method = getnamecallmethod()
                    if self == LocalPlayer and (method == "Kick" or method == "kick") then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
                end)
            end
        end)
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification("ANTI-KICK", UI.Tr("Yerel script Kick() çağrılarına karşı koruma aktif edildi!", "Local script Kick() protection enabled!"), Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128), 3)
        end
    end

    State.FreecamAngles = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    State.FreecamPos = nil
    State.MobileVerticalInput = 0 -- -1 (Down), 0, +1 (Up) controlled by On-Screen Mobile Flight Pad!

    Engine.StartFreecamMode = function(spd)
        State.Freecam = true
        State.FreecamSpeed = tonumber(spd) or 55
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            State.FreecamPos = cam.CFrame.Position
            local rx, ry, _ = cam.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
            State.FreecamAngles = Vector2.new(rx, ry)
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        end
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
        end
    end

    Engine.StopFreecamMode = function()
        State.Freecam = false
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
        end
        if Workspace.CurrentCamera and LocalPlayer.Character then
            Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        end
    end

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if not State.Freecam then return end
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local delta = inp.Delta
            if UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local pitch = math.clamp(State.FreecamAngles.X - delta.Y * 0.0045, -math.rad(85), math.rad(85))
                local yaw = State.FreecamAngles.Y - delta.X * 0.0045
                State.FreecamAngles = Vector2.new(pitch, yaw)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- [10.G] UNIVERSAL MOBILE VERTICAL & FLIGHT CONTROL PAD
    -- Automatically appears on-screen whenever Fly, VFly, CFFly, AirWalk, AirFly, Freecam, or Jetpack is active!
    local mobileFlightPad = nil
    local function ensureMobileFlightControlPad()
        if not UI.ScreenGui then return nil end
        if mobileFlightPad and mobileFlightPad.Parent then return mobileFlightPad end

        local pad = Instance.new("Frame")
        pad.Name = "BerksUniversalMobileFlightPad"
        pad.Size = UDim2.new(0, 128, 0, 134)
        pad.Position = UDim2.new(1, -142, 0.5, -67)
        pad.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 18, 32)
        pad.BackgroundTransparency = 0.14
        pad.Visible = false
        pad.ZIndex = 875
        pad.Parent = UI.ScreenGui
        Instance.new("UICorner", pad).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        local ps = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        ps.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        ps.Thickness = 1.5
        ps.Parent = pad

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20)
        title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
        title.TextSize = 10
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        title.Text = "FLIGHT / CAM"
        title.ZIndex = 876
        title.Parent = pad

        local btnUp = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btnUp.Name = "AscendBtn"
        btnUp.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 32)
        btnUp.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 25)
        btnUp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(2, 132, 199)
        btnUp.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btnUp.TextSize = 11
        btnUp.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btnUp.Text = "▲ YÜKSEL / UP"
        btnUp.ZIndex = 876
        btnUp.Parent = pad
        Instance.new("UICorner", btnUp).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

        local btnDown = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btnDown.Name = "DescendBtn"
        btnDown.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 32)
        btnDown.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 61)
        btnDown.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 58, 138)
        btnDown.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btnDown.TextSize = 11
        btnDown.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btnDown.Text = "▼ ALÇAL / DOWN"
        btnDown.ZIndex = 876
        btnDown.Parent = pad
        Instance.new("UICorner", btnDown).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

        local btnStop = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btnStop.Name = "StopFlightBtn"
        btnStop.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 28)
        btnStop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 98)
        btnStop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28)
        btnStop.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btnStop.TextSize = 11
        btnStop.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btnStop.Text = "✖ DURDUR / OFF"
        btnStop.ZIndex = 876
        btnStop.Parent = pad
        Instance.new("UICorner", btnStop).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

        btnUp.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() State.MobileVerticalInput = 1 end)
        btnUp.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() if State.MobileVerticalInput == 1 then State.MobileVerticalInput = 0 end end)
        btnUp.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if State.MobileVerticalInput == 1 then State.MobileVerticalInput = 0 end end)

        btnDown.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() State.MobileVerticalInput = -1 end)
        btnDown.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() if State.MobileVerticalInput == -1 then State.MobileVerticalInput = 0 end end)
        btnDown.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if State.MobileVerticalInput == -1 then State.MobileVerticalInput = 0 end end)

        btnStop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            State.MobileVerticalInput = 0
            if State.Flying or State.VehicleFlying or State.CFFly then
                Engine.StopFlightEngine(LocalPlayer)
            end
            if State.AirWalk or State.AirFly then
                Engine.ToggleAirWalkPlatform(false, LocalPlayer)
            end
            if State.Freecam then
                Engine.StopFreecamMode()
            end
            if State.JetpackPlayers and State.JetpackPlayers[LocalPlayer.Name] then
                State.JetpackPlayers[LocalPlayer.Name] = nil
                local jp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("BerksJetpackModel")
                if jp then jp:Destroy() end
            end
            if State.HoverboardPlayers and State.HoverboardPlayers[LocalPlayer.Name] then
                State.HoverboardPlayers[LocalPlayer.Name] = nil
                local hb = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("BerksHoverboardModel")
                if hb then hb:Destroy() end
            end
        end)

        mobileFlightPad = pad
        return pad
    end

    -- [10.H] MASTER 60 FPS RUNTIME LOOP FOR ESP/TRACERS + ALL BASE STATE FLAGS + MOBILE CONTROLS
    local esp2DCanvas = nil
    local lastAutoClickClock = 0
    local lastLoopKillClock = 0
    local lastLoopFlingClock = 0
    local lastSafeAntiVoidCF = nil
    local lastSafeAntiTpCF = nil

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local espState = State.V6ESP

        -- 1. Universal Mobile Flight / Vertical Control Pad visibility & vertical physics boost
        local pad = ensureMobileFlightControlPad()
        local isAnyFlightActive = State.Flying or State.CFFly or State.AirWalk or State.AirFly or State.Freecam or (State.JetpackPlayers and State.JetpackPlayers[LocalPlayer.Name] == true)
        if pad then
            pad.Visible = (isAnyFlightActive == true)
        end
        if not isAnyFlightActive then
            State.MobileVerticalInput = 0
        end

        if State.MobileVerticalInput ~= 0 and myHrp then
            if State.Flying then
                local bv = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity")
                if bv then
                    bv.Velocity = bv.Velocity + Vector3.new(0, State.MobileVerticalInput * (State.FlySpeed or 65), 0)
                end
            elseif State.CFFly then
                myHrp.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, State.MobileVerticalInput * (State.CFFlySpeed or 55) * dt, 0)
            elseif State.AirWalk or State.AirFly then
                State.AirWalkY = (State.AirWalkY or myHrp.Position.Y) + State.MobileVerticalInput * 32 * dt
            end
        end

        -- 2. Freecam 60 FPS Movement (Mobile Thumbstick + PC WASD + Touch/Mouse Look)
        if State.Freecam and cam then
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            local rotCF = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(State.FreecamAngles.X, State.FreecamAngles.Y, 0)
            local spd = (State.FreecamSpeed or 55) * dt
            local moveLocal = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or State.MobileVerticalInput > 0 then
                moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or State.MobileVerticalInput < 0 then
                moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
            end
            if myHum and myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                moveLocal = moveLocal + Vector3.new(myHum.MoveDirection.X, 0, myHum.MoveDirection.Z)
            end
            local basePos = State.FreecamPos or cam.CFrame.Position
            local worldDelta = (rotCF.RightVector * moveLocal.X + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * moveLocal.Y - rotCF.LookVector * moveLocal.Z)
            if worldDelta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                basePos = basePos + worldDelta.Unit * spd
            end
            State.FreecamPos = basePos
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePos) * rotCF
        end

        -- 3. SpiderClimb (;spider), WaterWalk (;waterwalk), Moonwalk (;moonwalk)
        if State.SpiderClimb and myHrp and myHum then
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { myChar }
            local lookDir = myHrp.CFrame.LookVector
            local res = Workspace:Raycast(myHrp.Position, lookDir * 3.6, rp)
            if res and res.Instance and res.Instance.CanCollide then
                local climbingUp = (myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)
                myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X * 0.4, climbingUp and 24 or 2, myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z * 0.4)
            end
        end

        if State.WaterWalk and myHrp and myHum then
            local wwPart = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksWaterWalkPlatform")
            if not wwPart then
                wwPart = Instance.new("Part")
                wwPart.Name = "BerksWaterWalkPlatform"
                wwPart.Size = Vector3.new(12, 0.5, 12)
                wwPart.Anchored = true
                wwPart.CanCollide = true
                wwPart.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                wwPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                wwPart.Transparency = 0.45
                wwPart.Parent = Workspace
            end
            local footY = myHrp.Position.Y - ((myHum.HipHeight or 2) + (myHrp.Size.Y * 0.5) + 0.25)
            local waterLevelY = math.max(0, math.min(footY, 2.5))
            wwPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHrp.Position.X, (footY < 4) and footY or waterLevelY, myHrp.Position.Z)
        else
            local oldWW = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksWaterWalkPlatform")
            if oldWW then oldWW:Destroy() end
        end

        if State.Moonwalk and myHrp and myHum and myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local backLook = -Vector3.new(myHum.MoveDirection.X, 0, myHum.MoveDirection.Z).Unit
            myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myHrp.Position, myHrp.Position + backLook)
        end

        -- 4. Magnet (;magnet), LoopFling (;loopfling), LoopKill (;loopkill)
        if State.MagnetTarget and State.MagnetTarget.Parent == Players and myHrp then
            local tHrp = State.MagnetTarget.Character and State.MagnetTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if tHrp and not (State.AdminModePlayers and State.AdminModePlayers[State.MagnetTarget.Name]) then
                tHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame:Lerp(myHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4.2), math.clamp(dt * 10, 0, 1))
                tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end

        if State.LoopFlingTarget and State.LoopFlingTarget.Parent == Players and (os.clock() - lastLoopFlingClock) >= 1.35 then
            lastLoopFlingClock = os.clock()
            if not (State.AdminModePlayers and State.AdminModePlayers[State.LoopFlingTarget.Name]) then
                pcall(function() Engine.ExecuteAngularVelocityFling(State.LoopFlingTarget) end)
            end
        end

        if State.LoopKillTargets and (os.clock() - lastLoopKillClock) >= 0.85 then
            lastLoopKillClock = os.clock()
            for pName, active in pairs(State.LoopKillTargets) do
                if active and not (State.AdminModePlayers and State.AdminModePlayers[pName]) then
                    local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                    if p and p.Character then
                        local h = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if h and h.Health > 0 then
                            pcall(function() Engine.ExecutePlayerKill(p) end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- 5. AntiFling, AntiVoid, AntiStun, AntiTeleport, HitboxDesync, AutoClicker, AutoGrabTools, LoopFullbright
        if State.AntiFling then
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if myHrp and myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 175 and not State.Flying and not State.CFFly then
                myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end

        if State.AntiVoid and myHrp and myHum then
            if myHrp.Position.Y > (Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 65) and myHum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                lastSafeAntiVoidCF = myHrp.CFrame
            elseif myHrp.Position.Y < (Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 48) then
                myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                myHrp.CFrame = lastSafeAntiVoidCF or CFrame.new(0, 40, 0)
            end
        end

        if State.AntiStun and myHum then
            if myHum.PlatformStand and not State.Flying then myHum.PlatformStand = false end
            if myHum.Sit and not myHum.SeatPart then myHum.Sit = false end
        end

        if State.AntiTeleport and myHrp then
            if lastSafeAntiTpCF and (myHrp.Position - lastSafeAntiTpCF.Position).Magnitude > 140 and not State.IsInsideCommandExecution then
                myHrp.CFrame = lastSafeAntiTpCF
            else
                lastSafeAntiTpCF = myHrp.CFrame
            end
        end

        if State.HitboxDesync and myHrp then
            myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.sin(os.clock() * 45) * 35, 0)
        end

        if State.AutoClicker and myChar then
            local cps = math.clamp(tonumber(State.AutoClickCPS) or 15, 1, 60)
            if os.clock() - lastAutoClickClock >= (1 / cps) then
                lastAutoClickClock = os.clock()
                local tool = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool then pcall(function() tool:Activate() end) end
            end
        end

        if State.AutoGrabTools and myHum then
            for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
                    pcall(function() myHum:EquipTool(v) end)
                end
            end
        end

        if State.LoopFullbright then
            Lighting.Brightness = 2.5
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        end

        -- 6. Jetpack (;jetpack), Hoverboard (;hoverboard), IceCube (;icecube)
        if State.JetpackPlayers then
            for pName, active in pairs(State.JetpackPlayers) do
                local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                local c = p and p.Character
                local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if active and c and r then
                    local jp = c:FindFirstChild("BerksJetpackModel")
                    if not jp then
                        jp = Instance.new("Part")
                        jp.Name = "BerksJetpackModel"
                        jp.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 2.2, 0.9)
                        jp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240)
                        jp.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
                        jp.Anchored = true
                        jp.CanCollide = false
                        jp.Parent = c
                        local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
                        fire.Size = 4
                        fire.Heat = -8
                        fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                        fire.Parent = jp
                    end
                    jp.CFrame = r.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0.9)
                    if p == LocalPlayer and (UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or State.MobileVerticalInput > 0 or (h and h.Jump)) then
                        r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 46, r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                    end
                elseif c and c:FindFirstChild("BerksJetpackModel") then
                    c.BerksJetpackModel:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end

        if State.HoverboardPlayers then
            for pName, active in pairs(State.HoverboardPlayers) do
                local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                local c = p and p.Character
                local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if active and c and r then
                    local hb = c:FindFirstChild("BerksHoverboardModel")
                    if not hb then
                        hb = Instance.new("Part")
                        hb.Name = "BerksHoverboardModel"
                        hb.Size = Vector3.new(2.8, 0.35, 6.2)
                        hb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                        hb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        hb.Anchored = true
                        hb.CanCollide = false
                        hb.Parent = c
                    end
                    hb.CFrame = r.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -2.85 + math.sin(os.clock() * 6) * 0.18, 0)
                    if h and h.WalkSpeed < 38 then h.WalkSpeed = 42 end
                elseif c and c:FindFirstChild("BerksHoverboardModel") then
                    c.BerksHoverboardModel:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end

        if State.IceCubePlayers then
            for pName, active in pairs(State.IceCubePlayers) do
                local p = Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
                local c = p and p.Character
                local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if active and c and r then
                    local ice = c:FindFirstChild("BerksIceCubeBlock")
                    if not ice then
                        ice = Instance.new("Part")
                        ice.Name = "BerksIceCubeBlock"
                        ice.Size = Vector3.new(6.2, 7.5, 6.2)
                        ice.Color = Color3.fromRGB(125, 211, 252)
                        ice.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                        ice.Transparency = 0.42
                        ice.Anchored = true
                        ice.CanCollide = false
                        ice.Parent = c
                    end
                    ice.CFrame = r.CFrame
                elseif c and c:FindFirstChild("BerksIceCubeBlock") then
                    c.BerksIceCubeBlock:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end

        -- 7. Live 2D Player Radar Update (;radar)
        if State.Radar2DActive and UI.ScreenGui and myHrp then
            local radar = UI.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("Berks2DPlayerRadar")
            local dotsFolder = radar and radar:FindFirstChild("RadarDots")
            if dotsFolder then
                for _, ch in ipairs(dotsFolder:GetChildren()) do ch:Destroy() end
                local myPos = myHrp.Position
                local camYaw = cam and select(2, cam.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()) or 0
                local cosY, sinY = math.cos(camYaw), math.sin(camYaw)
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        local delta = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myPos
                        local rx = (delta.X * cosY - delta.Z * sinY) / 220
                        local rz = (delta.X * sinY + delta.Z * cosY) / 220
                        local mag = math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz)
                        if mag > 0.44 then
                            rx = (rx / mag) * 0.44
                            rz = (rz / mag) * 0.44
                        end
                        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
                        dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
                        dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + rx, 0, 0.5 + rz, 0)
                        dot.BackgroundColor3 = GetTierData(ResolvePlayerRankLevel(plr)).Color
                        dot.ZIndex = 844
                        dot.Parent = dotsFolder
                        Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- 8. 60 FPS PER-PLAYER (<ISIM>) & ALL ESP / TRACERS / BOXESP / NAMEESP / HEALTHESP / CHAMS RENDERER
        if UI.ScreenGui and cam then
            if not esp2DCanvas or not esp2DCanvas.Parent then
                esp2DCanvas = Instance.new("Folder")
                esp2DCanvas.Name = "BerksV6ESP2DCanvas"
                esp2DCanvas.Parent = UI.ScreenGui
            end

            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            local origin2D = Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y - 12)
            local activePlayerSet = {}

            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local pName = plr.Name
                activePlayerSet[pName] = true
                local char = plr.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

                local wantESP = Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature("ESP", plr)
                local wantTracers = Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature("Tracers", plr)
                local wantBox = Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature("BoxESP", plr)
                local wantName = Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature("NameESP", plr) or wantESP
                local wantHealth = Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature("HealthESP", plr) or wantESP
                local wantChams = Engine.IsPlayerTargetedByESPFeature("Chams", plr)

                local rankColor = GetTierData(ResolvePlayerRankLevel(plr)).Color
                if plr.TeamColor and not wantESP then
                    rankColor = plr.TeamColor.Color
                end

                if not char or not hrp or (hum and hum.Health <= 0) then
                    Engine.CleanupSinglePlayerESPVisuals(pName)
                else
                    local distStuds = myHrp and math.floor((hrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0

                    -- A) Highlight / Chams
                    local hl = char:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_ESP_Highlight")
                    if wantESP or wantChams then
                        if not hl then
                            hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            hl.Name = "BerksAdmin_ESP_Highlight"
                            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                            hl.Parent = char
                        end
                        hl.FillColor = rankColor
                        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        hl.FillTransparency = wantChams and 0.22 or 0.62
                        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.08
                    elseif hl then
                        pcall(function() hl:Destroy() end)
                    end

                    -- B) 2D Tracers (Snaplines from bottom-center to target player)
                    local screenVec, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                    if wantTracers then
                        local tObj = espState.TracerLines2D[pName]
                        if not tObj or not tObj.Line.Parent then
                            local line = Instance.new("Frame")
                            line.Name = "TracerLine_" .. pName
                            line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                            line.BorderSizePixel = 0
                            line.ZIndex = 810
                            line.Parent = esp2DCanvas

                            local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
                            dot.Name = "TracerDot_" .. pName
                            dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
                            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                            dot.ZIndex = 811
                            dot.Parent = esp2DCanvas
                            Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

                            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                            lbl.Name = "TracerTag_" .. pName
                            lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 16)
                            lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
                            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
                            lbl.TextSize = 11
                            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
                            lbl.ZIndex = 812
                            lbl.Parent = esp2DCanvas

                            tObj = { Line = line, Dot = dot, Label = lbl }
                            espState.TracerLines2D[pName] = tObj
                        end

                        local tx, ty = screenVec.X, screenVec.Y
                        if screenVec.Z < 0 then
                            -- Target is behind camera: project toward bottom/side edge so tracer still points toward them
                            tx = vp.X - tx
                            ty = vp.Y - 6
                        end
                        tx = math.clamp(tx, 12, vp.X - 12)
                        ty = math.clamp(ty, 12, vp.Y - 12)

                        local target2D = Vector2.new(tx, ty)
                        local delta2D = target2D - origin2D
                        local len = delta2D.Magnitude
                        local mid = (origin2D + target2D) * 0.5
                        local ang = math.deg(math.atan2(delta2D.Y, delta2D.X))

                        tObj.Line.Visible = (len > 2)
                        tObj.Line.Size = UDim2.new(0, len, 0, 2)
                        tObj.Line.Position = UDim2.new(0, mid.X, 0, mid.Y)
                        tObj.Line.Rotation = ang
                        tObj.Line.BackgroundColor3 = rankColor

                        tObj.Dot.Visible = true
                        tObj.Dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, target2D.X, 0, target2D.Y)
                        tObj.Dot.BackgroundColor3 = rankColor

                        tObj.Label.Visible = true
                        tObj.Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, target2D.X, 0, target2D.Y - 5)
                        tObj.Label.TextColor3 = rankColor
                        tObj.Label.Text = string.format("%s [%dm]", plr.DisplayName or pName, distStuds)
                    elseif espState.TracerLines2D[pName] then
                        pcall(function() espState.TracerLines2D[pName].Line:Destroy() end)
                        pcall(function() espState.TracerLines2D[pName].Dot:Destroy() end)
                        pcall(function() espState.TracerLines2D[pName].Label:Destroy() end)
                        espState.TracerLines2D[pName] = nil
                    end

                    -- C) 3D + 2D BoxESP
                    if wantBox then
                        local box3D = espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName]
                        if not box3D or not box3D.Parent then
                            box3D = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                            box3D.Name = "BerksBoxESP3D_" .. pName
                            box3D.Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 5.8, 2.2)
                            box3D.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            box3D.ZIndex = 5
                            box3D.Transparency = 0.55
                            box3D.Parent = esp2DCanvas
                            espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName] = box3D
                        end
                        box3D.Adornee = hrp
                        box3D.Color3 = rankColor

                        local box2D = espState.BoxFrames2D[pName]
                        if not box2D or not box2D.Parent then
                            box2D = Instance.new("Frame")
                            box2D.Name = "BerksBoxESP2D_" .. pName
                            box2D.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            box2D.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                            box2D.ZIndex = 809
                            box2D.Parent = esp2DCanvas
                            local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                            st.Thickness = 1.6
                            st.Parent = box2D
                            espState.BoxFrames2D[pName] = box2D
                        end
                        if onScreen and screenVec.Z > 1 then
                            local scale = 1 / (screenVec.Z * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView * 0.5)) * 2) * vp.Y
                            local w = math.clamp(4.4 * scale, 18, vp.X * 0.8)
                            local h = math.clamp(6.2 * scale, 26, vp.Y * 0.85)
                            box2D.Visible = true
                            box2D.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
                            box2D.Position = UDim2.new(0, screenVec.X, 0, screenVec.Y)
                            local st = box2D:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                            if st then st.Color = rankColor end
                        else
                            box2D.Visible = false
                        end
                    else
                        if espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName] then
                            pcall(function() espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName]:Destroy() end)
                            espState.BoxAdornments3D[pName] = nil
                        end
                        if espState.BoxFrames2D[pName] then
                            pcall(function() espState.BoxFrames2D[pName]:Destroy() end)
                            espState.BoxFrames2D[pName] = nil
                        end
                    end

                    -- D) Billboard NameESP & HealthESP
                    if wantName or wantHealth then
                        local bb = espState.Billboards[pName]
                        if not bb or not bb.Gui.Parent then
                            local bGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                            bGui.Name = "BerksV6ESPBillboard_" .. pName
                            bGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 44)
                            bGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.8, 0)
                            bGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            bGui.Parent = esp2DCanvas

                            local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                            nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
                            nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                            nameLbl.TextSize = 11
                            nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
                            nameLbl.Parent = bGui

                            local hpBg = Instance.new("Frame")
                            hpBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 12)
                            hpBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -65, 0, 22)
                            hpBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42)
                            hpBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
                            hpBg.Parent = bGui
                            Instance.new("UICorner", hpBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

                            local hpFill = Instance.new("Frame")
                            hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                            hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)
                            hpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
                            hpFill.Parent = hpBg
                            Instance.new("UICorner", hpFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

                            local hpTxt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                            hpTxt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                            hpTxt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            hpTxt.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
                            hpTxt.TextSize = 9
                            hpTxt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            hpTxt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
                            hpTxt.Parent = hpBg

                            bb = { Gui = bGui, NameLabel = nameLbl, HpBg = hpBg, HpFill = hpFill, HpText = hpTxt }
                            espState.Billboards[pName] = bb
                        end
                        bb.Gui.Adornee = head or hrp
                        bb.NameLabel.Visible = wantName
                        if wantName then
                            local tierLvl = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(plr)
                            bb.NameLabel.TextColor3 = rankColor
                            bb.NameLabel.Text = string.format("[T%d] %s (@%s) · %dm", tierLvl, plr.DisplayName or pName, pName, distStuds)
                        end
                        bb.HpBg.Visible = wantHealth
                        if wantHealth and hum then
                            local curHp = math.max(0, math.floor(hum.Health))
                            local maxHp = math.max(1, math.floor(hum.MaxHealth))
                            local ratio = math.clamp(curHp / maxHp, 0, 1)
                            bb.HpFill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 1, 0)
                            bb.HpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128), ratio)
                            bb.HpText.Text = string.format("HP: %d / %d (%d%%)", curHp, maxHp, math.floor(ratio * 100))
                        end
                    elseif espState.Billboards[pName] then
                        pcall(function() espState.Billboards[pName].Gui:Destroy() end)
                        espState.Billboards[pName] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Clean up visuals for any player who left the server
            for pName, _ in pairs(espState.TracerLines2D) do
                if not activePlayerSet[pName] then Engine.CleanupSinglePlayerESPVisuals(pName) end
            end
            for pName, _ in pairs(espState.BoxFrames2D) do
                if not activePlayerSet[pName] then Engine.CleanupSinglePlayerESPVisuals(pName) end
            end
            for pName, _ in pairs(espState.Billboards) do
                if not activePlayerSet[pName] then Engine.CleanupSinglePlayerESPVisuals(pName) end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Enforce B1rkt UI Purge on Startup (Language modal available on startup & inside IY Settings)
    task.defer(function()
        Engine.PurgeB1rktUIForNonOwner()
        task.delay(0.8, function()
            Engine.ShowStartupWelcomeLanguageModal()
        end)
    end)
end


	-- Refresh Infinite Yield's searchable command list so all [BA] commands appear immediately!
	UI.RefreshCommandListUI("")

	-- ==========================================================================
	-- [SECTION 13] STARTUP P2P HANDSHAKE, OVERHEAD BADGE SYNC & READY BANNER
	-- ==========================================================================
	task.defer(function()
		pcall(function()
			BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("HANDSHAKE", "ALL", tostring(State.LocalRankLevel))
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(p)
			end
		end)
		notify(
			"Berk's Admin v6.5 (IY Core)",
			UI.Tr(
				"Infinite Yield 6.4.2 + Berk's Admin Full P2P Hazır! (Prefix: " .. tostring(prefix) .. ")",
				"Infinite Yield 6.4.2 + Berk's Admin Full P2P Ready! (Prefix: " .. tostring(prefix) .. ")"
			),
			5
		)
		task.spawn(function()
			while task.wait(8) do
				pcall(function()
					BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("HANDSHAKE", "ALL", tostring(State.LocalRankLevel))
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end
